n-m-h3-prob-02.topic: Probability: conditional probability, ịnọ onwe na ịdabere, echiche udi Bayes, ịtọ sample space
n-m-h3-prob-02.title: Ihe Abụọ Na-enweghị Ike Ime Ọnụ: Ha Ọ̀ Nọ Onwe Ha?
n-m-h3-prob-02.goal: Kewaa "enweghị ike ime ọnụ" na "nọ onwe ha," ma kọwaa ihe kpatara site n'iji ihe ịnọ onwe ha pụtara (ịmara otu anaghị agbanwe probability nke nke ọzọ).
n-m-h3-prob-02.material: A na-agba dice ziri ezi otu ugboro. Ihe omume A bụ "ọnụọgụ ahụ bụ 1 ma ọ bụ 2," B bụkwa "ọnụọgụ ahụ bụ 3 ma ọ bụ 4." Ihe omume abụọ ahụ enweghị ike ime n'otu oge. Jimin lere nke a ma mee nkwupụta dị n'okpuru.
n-m-h3-prob-02.thinking.0: Kpee ikpe ma nkwupụta ziri ezi site n'iji ihe akaebe
n-m-h3-prob-02.thinking.1: Lelee ịnọ onwe ha site n'iji ịmụba
n-m-h3-prob-02.thinking.2: Kọwaa ihe kpatara site n'iji conditional probability
n-m-h3-prob-02.prereq.0: Nkọwa nke ihe omume nọ onwe ha
n-m-h3-prob-02.prereq.1: Ihe ihe omume na-agbapụ ibe ha pụtara
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.prompt: Jimin kwuru, "Ihe omume A na B enweghị ike ime n'otu oge, ya mere ha anaghị emetụta ibe ha. Ya mere ha nọ onwe ha." Kedu nyocha kacha kwesị ekwesị nke nkwupụta Jimin?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.hint.0: Chee n'onwe gị ihe na-eme ohere B ozugbo ị mara na A emeela.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ọ bụrụ na ha nọ onwe ha, ịmara A ga-ahapụ probability nke B otu ihe ahụ dịka na mbụ. Tụnyere ma ọ bụ otú ahụ n'ọnọdụ a.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.a: Ezighị ezi. Ọ bụrụ na ị maara na A emeela, B enweghịzi ike ime, ya mere probability nke B dị iche n'ihe ọ bụ na mbụ.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.b: Ziri ezi. Ebe ihe omume abụọ ahụ anaghị eme ọnụ, otu anaghị agbanwe probability nke nke ọzọ.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.b: Ị gụrụ "enweghị ike ime ọnụ" dịka "anaghị emetụta ibe ha." Na otu ihe omume ime na-eme nke ọzọ ghọọ ihe na-ekwe omume bụ n'onwe ya mmetụta siri ike.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.c: Ziri ezi. Ebe A na B nwere otu probability, otu anaghị emetụta nke ọzọ.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.c: Probabilities ịbụ otu nha na ịnọ onwe ha bụ ihe dị iche. Ịnọ onwe ha bụ banyere ma probability nke otu na-agbanwe mgbe ị maara nke ọzọ.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.d: Ezighị ezi. Ebe A na B nwere probabilities dị iche, otu na-emetụta nke ọzọ.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.d: Probabilities dị iche apụtaghị na ihe omume ahụ anaghị anọ onwe ha. Ihe ị kwesịrị ịtụnyere bụ ma probability nke otu na-agbanwe mgbe ị maara nke ọzọ.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na A na B enweghị ike ime n'otu oge ma nke ọ bụla nwere probability karịrị 0, mgbe ahụ ịmara na A emeela na-agbanwe probability nke B ruo 0. Ọ bụrụ na ha nọ onwe ha, P(B|A)=P(B) ga-ejide, ya mere ha anaghị anọ onwe ha. N'dice, mgbe A bụ 1 ma ọ bụ 2 ma B bụ 3 ma ọ bụ 4, P(B)=1/3, ma ọ bụrụ na A eme, P(B|A)=0.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.prompt: Site n'otu ịgba dice ahụ, tụlekwa ihe omume C (ọnụọgụ ejiji) na ihe omume D (ọnụọgụ 3 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị). Họrọ ụzọ niile nke ihe omume nọ onwe ha.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.hint.0: Maka ụzọ ọ bụla, chọta P(ihe omume abụọ ahụ ga-eme) na P(nke mbụ)×P(nke abụọ) ma tụnyere ma ha hà.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.hint.1: Buru ụzọ dee ọnụọgụ nke ihe omume ọ bụla, mgbe ahụ chọta ọnụọgụ nke abụọ ahụ.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.r.a: Ị lere ụzọ na-enweghị ike ime ọnụ dịka nke nọ onwe ha. Ọ bụrụ na otu eme, probability nke nke ọzọ na-aghọ 0.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.r.d: Ị lere A ịdị n'ime D dịka "enweghị mmekọrịta." Ọ bụrụ na A eme, D ga-eme n'ezie, ya mere probability nke D na-agbanwe.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.explain: P(A)=1/3, P(C)=1/2, na P(A∩C)=P({2})=1/6=P(A)P(C), ya mere A na C nọ onwe ha. B na C nọkwa onwe ha, ebe B∩C={4} ma 1/6=1/3×1/2. Maka A na D, P(A∩D)=1/3 ma P(A)P(D)=1/6, ya mere ha anaghị anọ onwe ha. Ihe omume nwere ike ịnọ onwe ha ọbụlagodi mgbe ha na-agbakọta, ihe omume na-agbakọtaghị (mgbe probabilities ha karịrị 0) enweghị ike ịnọ onwe ha.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.prompt: Dee nkọwa ị ga-ezigara Jimin. Dabere n'ihe ọ pụtara ka A na B nọ onwe ha, kọwaa ihe mere A na B anaghị anọ onwe ha n'ọmụmaatụ dice a, site n'iji "probability nke B mgbe anyị maara na A emeela."
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee ọnụọgụ ndị fọdụrụ mgbe ị maara na A emeela, ma lelee ma ụfọdụ n'ime ha bụ nke B.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.hint.1: Dee probability mbụ nke B na probability mgbe ahụ n'akụkụ n'akụkụ n'otu ahịrịokwu ma tụnyere ha.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.placeholder: dịka, Ọ bụrụ na ị maara na A emeela, mgbe ahụ B ...
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ dere ihe ịnọ onwe ha pụtara dịka "ịmara otu ihe omume anaghị agbanwe probability nke nke ọzọ"?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: N'ọmụmaatụ a, ị̀ kwuru ma probability mbụ nke B ma probability ya mgbe ịmara na A emeela?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ kwuru na "enweghị ike ime n'otu oge" na "nọ onwe ha" dị iche?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ihe omume ahụ nọ onwe ha, probability nke B ga-anọgide 1/3 ọbụlagodi mgbe anyị maara na A emeela. Ma ọ bụrụ na A (1 ma ọ bụ 2) eme, B (3 ma ọ bụ 4) enweghị ike ime, ya mere probability ya na-aghọ 0. Probability na-agbanwe, ya mere ha anaghị anọ onwe ha.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.model.1: Na mbụ, probability nke B bụ otu n'ụzọ atọ. Ma ọ bụrụ na anyị mata na dice na-egosi 1 ma ọ bụ 2, mgbe ahụ 3 ma ọ bụ 4 abụghị ihe na-ekwe omume, ya mere probability nke B na-agbanwe ruo 0. Ọ bụrụ na ha nọ onwe ha ọ ga-abụ na ọ naghị agbanwe, ma ọ gbanwere, ya mere ha anaghị anọ onwe ha.

n-m-h3-prob-08.title: Ego Onyinye nke Egwuregwu E Kwụsịrị: Kedu Otú Anyị Ga-esi Kewaa Ya?
n-m-h3-prob-08.goal: Hazie ozi dị mkpa iji chọta puru omume imeri, ma tọọ oghere sample nwere otu puru omume site n'iwere na egwuregwu nke ga-akwụsị n'oge na-egwu ruo ngwụcha.
n-m-h3-prob-08.material: Otu A na Otu B na-egwu egwuregwu ebe otu mbụ merie egwuregwu 3 na-eweta onyinye niile nke 80,000 won, ma e kwusịrị ya n'ihi ihe ụfọdụ. Ruo ugbu a Otu A nwere mmeri 2 ma Otu B nwere mmeri 1. Otu abụọ ahụ kwetara ikewa onyinye ahụ n'ọnụego "puru omume na otu ọ bụla na-emeri n'egwuregwu fọdụrụ."
n-m-h3-prob-08.thinking.1: Ịtọ oghere sample nwere otu puru omume
n-m-h3-prob-08.thinking.2: Ikọwa ihe mere echiche anaghị agbanwe nsonaazụ
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.prompt: Otu A na Otu B na-egwu egwuregwu ebe otu mbụ merie egwuregwu 3 na-eweta onyinye niile nke 80,000 won, ma e kwusịrị ya. Ruo ugbu a Otu A nwere mmeri 2 ma Otu B nwere mmeri 1. A ga-ekewa onyinye ahụ n'ọnụego puru omume imeri nke otu ọ bụla. Họrọ ozi niile dị mkpa iji chọta puru omume ndị a. (Amaghị ihe ọ bụla banyere ọkwa nka nke otu ndị ahụ.)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.hint.0: Wepụ ozi ọ bụla otu otu ma chee ma a ka nwere ike ịgbakọ puru omume imeri n'ọdịnihu na-enweghị ya.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.hint.1: Dee ihe ịchọrọ iji mara egwuregwu ole ọzọ otu ọ bụla ga-emeri ka ọ bụrụ onye mmeri.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.a: Usoro egwuregwu e merila ruo ugbu a (ma ọ bụ A, B, A)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.r.a: I chere na usoro dị mkpa. Puru omume imeri n'ọdịnihu dabere n'ọnụọgụ mmeri ugbu a na egwuregwu fọdụrụ; usoro mmeri si gbakọta enweghị mmetụta.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.b: Ọnụọgụ mmeri nke otu ọ bụla ruo ugbu a (mmeri 2 na mmeri 1)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.c: Ọnụọgụ mmeri a chọrọ ka ọ bụrụ onye mmeri (nke mbụ ruo mmeri 3)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.d: Oge egwuregwu ahụ were ruo ugbu a
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.r.d: Oge enweghị njikọ na mmeri na mfu n'ọdịnihu. Chee ma ọ bụ ozi na-emetụta puru omume imeri.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.e: Ohere nke otu ọ bụla imeri otu egwuregwu
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.explain: Ọnụọgụ mmeri ugbu a na mmeri a chọrọ ka ọ bụrụ onye mmeri na-ekpebi egwuregwu ole ọzọ otu ọ bụla ga-emeri (A chọrọ egwuregwu 1, B chọrọ egwuregwu 2), ma ohere imeri n'egwuregwu ọ bụla na-ekpebi puru omume nke nke ahụ ime. Usoro mmeri na oge e were anaghị emetụta egwuregwu fọdụrụ, ya mere a chọghị ha.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.prompt: Were ya na otu abụọ ahụ nwere otu puru omume imeri otu egwuregwu ma egwuregwu anaghị emetụta ibe ha. Chọta puru omume na Otu A na-emeri asọmpi ahụ, ma dee ego onyinye Otu A kwesịrị inweta. Tinye n'ngwọta gị ọnọdụ ndị ị gụrụ.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.hint.0: Dee ihe ga-eme n'egwuregwu fọdụrụ ka Otu A merie na ka Otu B merie.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ọbụna ma egwuregwu ahụ ga-akwụsị n'oge, chee ma iche na a na-agwu egwuregwu fọdụrụ niile na-enye gị ohere ime ka ọnọdụ ndị ahụ nwee otu puru omume.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: I tụlere ọnọdụ ebe Otu A na-emeri na ebe Otu B na-emeri iche?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: I họrọ ọnọdụ ndị ahụ ka nke ọ bụla nwee otu puru omume?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: I kewara ego onyinye site n'iji puru omume?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na anyị eche ịgwu egwuregwu abụọ fọdụrụ abụọ, nsonaazụ anọ (A,A),(A,B),(B,A),(B,B) nwere otu puru omume. Ka B merie, B ga-emeri egwuregwu abụọ ahụ abụọ, nke bụ naanị (B,B), ya mere B nwere 1/4 ma A nwere 3/4. Ya mere A kwesịrị inweta 60,000 won ma B 20,000 won.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.model.1: Ka B merie, B ga-emeri egwuregwu abụọ fọdụrụ n'usoro, ma puru omume nke ahụ bụ 1/2×1/2=1/4. Ya mere puru omume na A na-emeri bụ 3/4, ma A kwesịrị inweta 60,000 won n'ime onyinye 80,000 won.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.prompt: Minji kwuru, "Ọ bụrụ na A merie egwuregwu na-esote egwuregwu ahụ na-akwụsị, ya mere ọ dịghị mma iche ịgwu egwuregwu abụọ fọdụrụ abụọ, n'ihi na nke ahụ dị iche n'ihe ga-eme n'ezie." Kedu azịza kacha dabara n'okwu Minji?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.hint.0: Chọta puru omume nke ụzọ atọ ahụ egwuregwu n'ezie nwere ike isi kwụsị, ma lelee na ha na-agbakwụnye ruo 1.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.hint.1: Ọ bụrụ na a na-agwu egwuregwu abụọ fọdụrụ abụọ, mee tebụl na-egosi onye na-emeri asọmpi maka nsonaazụ anọ ọ bụla.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.a: A na-agwu egwuregwu abụọ ọzọ n'ezie, ya mere nsonaazụ anọ niile nwere ike ime.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.r.a: Nkọwa a na-emegide eziokwu na egwuregwu ahụ na-akwụsị n'oge. Ha anaghị agwu ha niile n'ezie.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.b: Ọnụọgụ egwuregwu ruo ngwụcha ga-abụ otu ka a kewaa onyinye n'ụzọ ziri ezi.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.r.b: I tọrọ ikpe ziri ezi n'ọnụọgụ egwuregwu ruo ngwụcha. Ọkọlọtọ bụ puru omume imeri.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.c: Ọ bụ naanị maka mfe, ya mere ọ dịghị mkpa ma ọ bụrụ na uru ziri ezi.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.r.c: I kwughị ihe mere uru ji ziri ezi. E nwere ihe kpatara ọ dị mma ilele ya n'ụzọ a.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.d: Egwuregwu mgbe a kpebiri egwuregwu anaghị agbanwe otu mmeri, ya mere nsonaazụ bụ otu ọbụna ma a gwuo ha niile.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.explain: Ọ bụrụ na A merie egwuregwu na-esote, A bụ onye mmeri, ma egwuregwu ndị e mesịrị anaghị agbanwe onye mmeri. Ya mere ọbụna ma anyị were na a na-agwu egwuregwu abụọ fọdụrụ abụọ, "onye na-emeri asọmpi" anaghị agbanwe, ma nsonaazụ anọ ahụ nke ọ bụla na-aghọ otu puru omume na 1/4, nke na-eme ka ịgụta dị mfe. Ọ bụrụ na anyị were ụzọ atọ ahụ egwuregwu n'ezie na-akwụsị ("A na-emeri" na 1/2, "B na-emeri wee A emeri" na 1/4, "B na-emeri ugboro abụọ n'usoro" na 1/4) dị ka nke nwere otu puru omume, nke ahụ adịghị mma.

n-m-h3-serieslim-01.thinking.0: Ịgbanwe ikpe gị mgbe ọ bụla ozi ọhụrụ pụtara
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.title: Ọ bụrụ na anyị kpokọta okwu ndị ahụ, ngụkọta ọ bụ otu?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.topic: Usoro: ngụkọta akụkụ na usoro geometric na-enweghị ọgwụgwụ
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.goal: Site n'ide ngụkọta akụkụ n'onwe gị, lelee ma kọwaa na ịbịaru nso otu uru nke usoro nwere okwu a kpokọtara anaghị ekwe ka anyị kwubie na usoro mbụ na-abịaru nso otu uru.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.material: Ndị enyi atọ na-arụ ụka banyere ihe ngụkọta nke usoro 1−1+1−1+1−1+… bụ. A na-ekpughe ozi otu mpempe n'otu oge. (Okwu izugbe bụ (−1)^(n−1): 1 ma ọ bụrụ na n bụ nke na-abụghị abụọ-abụọ, −1 ma ọ bụrụ na n bụ abụọ-abụọ.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.thinking.1: Ịkpe ikpe ịbịaru nso otu uru nke usoro site n'iji ngụkọta akụkụ
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.thinking.2: Ịhazi ntụzi ndị na-adị n'etiti usoro a kpokọtara na usoro mbụ
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.prereq.1: Ịkọwa ngụkọta nke usoro dị ka oke nke ngụkọta akụkụ ya
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.prompt: Na nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, họrọ mkpebi site n'iji naanị ihe ị maara ruo ugbu a.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.hint.0: Mgbe ozi ọhụrụ pụtara, tụlee ọzọ ma mkpebi i họrọla n'oge na-adịbeghị anya ka dị mma.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.hint.1: Dee ụzọ abụọ dị iche a ga-esi kpokọta ma tụnyere ma otu uru na-apụta n'agbanyeghị otú e si kpokọta okwu ndị ahụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Mina kpokọtara okwu abụọ n'otu oge ma dee (1−1)+(1−1)+(1−1)+…, ya mere akwụkwọ ọ bụla bụ 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kedu ihe ị kpebiri ngụkọta nke usoro a bụ?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Dabere n'ụzọ e si kpokọta okwu ndị ahụ, ma 0 ma 1 pụtara. Ya mere ị nwere ike ịhụ na ọ dị ọsịsọ ikwu ngụkọta naanị n'ihi na "akpokọtara m n'otu ụzọ."
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ọ bụ 0: n'ihi na otu ọ bụla bụ 0
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: I nakweere nsonaazụ otu nkpokọta dị ka ngụkọta. Nke a bụ mkpebi mbụ na-abata n'echiche.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ọ bụ 1: n'ihi na ịhapụ okwu mbụ 1 ma kpokọta dị ka 1+(−1+1)+(−1+1)+… na-enye 1
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: I nwara nkpokọta dị iche ma nweta uru dị iche. Ma ị nwere ike ilebanye anya nke ọma n'eziokwu na i kpebiri ozugbo na uru ahụ bụ ngụkọta.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ọ dị ọsịsọ ikpebi: anyị ga-elele ma uru ahụ bụ otu mgbe anyị gbanwere nkpokọta
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: I na-enyo enyo na nsonaazụ nwere ike ịgbanwe dabere n'ụzọ e si kpokọta okwu ndị ahụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Ide ngụkọta akụkụ n'usoro na-enye S_1=1, S_2=0, S_3=1, S_4=0, S_5=1, ….
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: A na-ekpebi usoro site na oke nke ngụkọta akụkụ ya. Ugbu a kedu ihe ị na-ekpebi?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Ngụkọta akụkụ anaghị abịaru nso otu uru, ya mere usoro a na-ekewapụ. A naghị ekpebi ngụkọta ya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ọ na-abịaru nso 0: n'ihi na S_2, S_4, … niile bụ 0
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: I lere naanị ngụkọta akụkụ nwere ọnụọgụ abụọ-abụọ. I hapụrụ na ndị na-abụghị abụọ-abụọ bụ 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ọ na-abịaru nso 1: n'ihi na S_1, S_3, … niile bụ 1
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: I lere naanị ngụkọta akụkụ nwere ọnụọgụ na-abụghị abụọ-abụọ. I hapụrụ na ndị abụọ-abụọ bụ 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ọ naghị abịaru nso otu uru: n'ihi na ngụkọta akụkụ na-agbanwe n'etiti 0 na 1 ma anaghị abịaru nso otu uru
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: I lere omume nke ngụkọta akụkụ niile ma kpee ikpe dabere n'nkọwa nke oke.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Ma usoro 0+0+0+… nke Mina mere site na nkpokọta na-abịaru nso 0 n'ụzọ doro anya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Site n'eziokwu na usoro a kpokọtara na-abịaru nso otu uru, kedu ihe anyị pụrụ ikwu banyere usoro mbụ?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Ọ bụrụ na usoro mbụ na-abịaru nso otu uru, usoro a kpokọtara na-abịaru nso otu uru ahụ. Ma nke megidere adịghị adị, n'ihi na usoro a kpokọtara na-eji naanị S_2, S_4, ….
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Usoro mbụ na-abịaru nso otu uru kwa, ya na otu ngụkọta: n'ihi na anyị kpokọtara naanị okwu ndị ahụ
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: I tinyere echiche na nkpokọta na-edebe ngụkọta n'ntụzi abụọ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Enweghị ike ikpebi ihe ọ bụla: n'ihi na ngụkọta akụkụ nke usoro a kpokọtara bụ naanị ụfọdụ n'ime ngụkọta akụkụ mbụ
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: I kwuru na usoro a kpokọtara na-eji naanị ụfọdụ ngụkọta akụkụ mbụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ngụkọta nke usoro mbụ bụ ma 0 ma 1: n'ihi na ụzọ nkpokọta ọ bụla nwere ngụkọta
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: I kwuru na usoro na-abịaghị nso otu uru nwere ngụkọta abụọ. A na-akọwa ngụkọta dị ka otu oke nke ngụkọta akụkụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.reflect: Na mbụ, ngụkọta nke 0 site n'ịkewa n'otu dị ka ihe nwere ike ịbụ eziokwu, mana ikpe gị gbanwere mgbe ị dere ngụkọta akụkụ. Ọ bụghị otu e si kewaa ya na-ekpebi ma usoro na-abịaru nso, kama ọ bụ omume nke ngụkọta akụkụ niile S_n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.prompt: Soyoung sịrị, "Ịkewa site n'akara ogbugbu nyere 0+0+0+…, ya mere ngụkọta nke 1−1+1−1+… bụ 0." Dee nkọwa ị ga-ezigara Soyoung. Gụnye ka ngụkọta akụkụ nke usoro mbụ si eme na ka ngụkọta akụkụ nke usoro e kewara si mekọrịta na ngụkọta akụkụ mbụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee S_1, S_2, S_3, S_4 n'onwe gị ma kaa ka uru ndị ahụ si agbanwe.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.hint.1: Gosi nke n'ime ngụkọta akụkụ mbụ bụ ngụkọta akụkụ nke usoro e kewara (1−1)+(1−1)+….
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị lelere n'ezie uru nke ngụkọta akụkụ S_1, S_2, S_3, S_4?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị kwuru nke n'ime ngụkọta akụkụ mbụ usoro e kewara na-eji?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị tụlere ma "usoro e kewara na-abịaru nso" na-ekwe nkwa "usoro mbụ na-abịaru nso"?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.model.0: Ngụkọta akụkụ nke usoro mbụ bụ 1, 0, 1, 0, …, na-agbanwe n'etiti 0 na 1 ma anaghị abịaru otu uru nso. Ya mere ọ nweghị ngụkọta. Ngụkọta akụkụ nke usoro e kewara na-ahọrọ naanị ụfọdụ n'ime ha (ndị nwere ọnụọgụ ụzọ), dị ka S_2, S_4, …, ya mere ọ bụ naanị ohere ka ọ pụta 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.model.1: Ngụkọta akụkụ na-emegharị 1,0,1,0 ma anaghị abịaru nso. Ọ bụrụ na anyị gbanwee ịkewa ka ọ bụrụ 1+(−1+1)+(−1+1)+…, ọ na-enye 1, ya mere uru na-adabere n'ịkewa. Usoro e kewara bụ 0 enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ngụkọta nke usoro mbụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.model.2: Soyoung, S_n nke usoro mbụ bụ 1 maka n ọ bụghị ụzọ na 0 maka n ụzọ, ya mere ọ nweghị oke (ọ na-agbasa). Ịkewa site n'akara ogbugbu pụtara ilele naanị S_2, S_4, …, nke na-enye 0, ya mere ọ bụghị ihe àmà na usoro mbụ na-abịaru nso.

n-m-h3-serieslim-04.topic: Usoro: ngụkọta akụkụ na usoro geometric na-enweghị ọgwụgwụ
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.prereq.0: Ngụkọta nke usoro geometric na-enweghị njedebe
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.title: 0.999… Ọ̀ Dị Obere Karịa 1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.goal: Kọwaa, site n'iji oke nke ọdịiche, na oke nwere ike ịbụ ngụkọta ọbụna ma ngụkọta akụkụ anaghị erute ya, ma mepụta usoro ọzọ nwere otu àgwà.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.material: Ndị enyi abụọ na-arụ ụka ma 0.999… (nwere 9 na-emegharị ruo mgbe ebighị ebi) hà nhata 1. Yuna: "0.9, 0.99, 0.999, … dị ala karịa 1 mgbe niile n'agbanyeghị ebe ị gara, ya mere 0.999… dị ala karịa 1." Dohyun: "0.999…=9/10+9/100+9/1000+…, nke bụ usoro geometric na-enweghị njedebe nwere okwu mbụ 9/10 na ratio nkịtị 1/10, ya mere ngụkọta ya bụ 1."
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.thinking.0: Ịhazi ma ihe àmà nke nkwupụta na-akwado nkwubi okwu ya
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.thinking.1: Ịmata ngụkọta akụkụ na oke iche
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.thinking.2: Ịmepụta ihe atụ nwere otu àgwà
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.prompt: Nyochaa nkwupụta na ihe àmà nke ndị enyi abụọ ahụ, ma họrọ ikpe kacha dabara.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.hint.0: Lelee iche ma ihe àmà Yuna bụ eziokwu na ma nkwubi okwu ya na-esi n'ihe àmà ahụ pụta.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.hint.1: Dee ihe a kọwapụtara dị ka ngụkọta nke usoro, ma tụnyere ma ngụkọta Dohyun kwekọrọ n'nkọwa ahụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.a: Dohyun ziri ezi: ngụkọta nke usoro bụ oke nke ngụkọta akụkụ ya, ma ngụkọta akụkụ na-abịaru 1 nso n'enweghị njedebe
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.a: I kpebiri dabere n'nkọwa nke ngụkọta (oke nke ngụkọta akụkụ). Ị na-ahụkwa na ihe àmà Yuna anaghị eduga n'nkwubi okwu ya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.b: Ngụkọta adịghị ekpebi: n'ihi na ngụkọta akụkụ na-agbanwe mgbe niile ma enweghị ike inwe otu uru
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.b: I gbagwojuru ngụkọta akụkụ na-aga n'ihu na-agbanwe na ịnaghị abịaru nso. Ọbụna ma ha na-agbanwe, usoro na-abịaru nso ma ọ bụrụ na ha na-abịaru otu uru nso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.c: Yuna ziri ezi: ọ dịghị ngụkọta akụkụ hà nhata 1, ya mere 0.999… dị iche na 1
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.c: I buru àgwà nke ngụkọta akụkụ ọ bụla gaa oke ozugbo. Oke abụghị otu n'ime ngụkọta akụkụ ahụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.d: Ha abụọ ziri ezi: 0.999… dị obere karịa 1 site n'ọnụọgụ nta n'enweghị njedebe, mana n'ịgbakọ a na-eweta ya dị ka 1
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.d: I kwuru na ọdịiche dị mma site na 1 fọdụrụ, ma kwukwara na ọ hà nhata 1. N'etiti ọnụọgụ n'ezie, ọnụọgụ abụọ bụ otu naanị ma ọdịiche ha bụ 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.explain: Ngụkọta nke usoro bụ oke nke ngụkọta akụkụ S_n. Ebe a S_n=1−(1/10)^n ma oke bụ 1, ya mere 0.999…=1. Ihe àmà Yuna bụ eziokwu, mana site na "S_n niile dị ala karịa 1" ọ naghị esi pụta na "lim S_n dị ala karịa 1" (n'oke ọ na-aghọ ≤).
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.prompt: Nkwupụta Yuna "n'agbanyeghị ruo n ole ị gbakwunyere, ngụkọta akụkụ dị ala karịa 1" bụ eziokwu. Ma nkwubi okwu ya ezighị ezi. Kọwaa ihe kpatara site n'iji 1−S_n, uru nke 1 wepụrụ ngụkọta akụkụ S_n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.hint.0: Dee S_1, S_2, S_3 ma dee ọdịiche nke ọ bụla na 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.hint.1: Jikọọ ka ọdịiche ahụ si eme ka n na-eto na ihe ngụkọta nke usoro a na-ekpebi dị ka oke nke.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị kwupụtara 1−S_n dị ka okwu ọtụtụ n'ihe gbasara n?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị jikọtara uru ahụ na-abịaru 0 nso na ngụkọta ịbụ 1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị kwuru na oke nwere ike ịbụ 1 ọbụna ma ngụkọta akụkụ anaghị erute 1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.0: 1−S_n=1/10^n karịrị 0 mgbe niile, ya mere ọ bụ eziokwu na S_n dị ala karịa 1. Mana ka n na-eto, 1/10^n na-abịaru 0 nso n'enweghị njedebe, ya mere oke nke S_n bụ 1, ma ebe ọ bụ na ngụkọta nke usoro bụ oke ahụ, 0.999…=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.1: Ọ dịghị ngụkọta akụkụ na-eru 1, mana 1−S_n=(1/10)^n na-abịaru 0 nso. Ngụkọta nke usoro bụ oke nke ngụkọta akụkụ ya, ya mere ọ bụ 1. Ọbụna ma ngụkọta akụkụ ọ bụla dị ala karịa 1, oke nwere ike ịbụ 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.2: S_n ọ bụla dị ala karịa 1, mana ọdịiche 0.00…01 na-aghọ obere n'enweghị njedebe ka n na-eto, ya mere oke bụ 1, ya mere 0.999…=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.prompt: Mepụta usoro nwere otu àgwà n'onwe gị. Tinye usoro geometric abụọ na-enweghị njedebe a + ar + ar² + … nwere okwu mbụ a na ratio nkịtị r nke ngụkọta ha bụ 1 ma ngụkọta akụkụ ha niile dị ala karịa 1, site n'iji ratio nkịtị dị iche. (Ị nwere ike itinye ọnụọgụ ntụpọ.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee akụkụ ọtụtụ ole ga-adị n'etiti a na r ka ngụkọta bụrụ 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.hint.1: Gbakọọ S_1 na S_2 iji lelee akara r ga-enwerịrị ka ngụkọta akụkụ niile dị ala karịa 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.ok.c1: Uru zuru oke nke ratio nkịtị dị ala karịa 1, ya mere ọ na-abịaru nso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.fail.c1: |r|<1 anaghị adị, ya mere nke a abụghị usoro na-abịaru nso nwere ngụkọta 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.ok.c3: Okwu niile dị mma, ya mere ngụkọta akụkụ dị ala karịa 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.fail.c3: Ratio nkịtị adịghị mma, ya mere ngụkọta akụkụ nwere ike ịgafe 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.explain: Ọ bụrụ na a=1−r ma 0<r<1, ngụkọta akụkụ S_n=1−r^n dị ala karịa 1 mgbe niile mana oke ya bụ 1. a=0.9, r=0.1 bụ kpọmkwem 0.999…. Ọ bụrụ na r adịghị mma, a=1−r>1, ya mere ngụkọta akụkụ mbụ agafelarị 1.

n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n'ngwọta Seojin.
n-m-h3-integc-01.title: Ị nwere ike ịtụkwasị uru e nwetara site na ijikọta site n'akụkụ obi?
n-m-h3-integc-01.topic: Ijikọta: njehie n'ijikọta site n'akụkụ na ilele site na akara nke ihe a na-ejikọta
n-m-h3-integc-01.goal: Chọta ma mezie ahịrị mbụ na-ezighi ezi n'ngwọta ijikọta site n'akụkụ, ma kọwaa otú e si elele akara nke ijikọta kpọmkwem site n'iji akara nke ihe a na-ejikọta, na oke nlele ahụ.
n-m-h3-integc-01.material: Seojin dozịrị ∫_0^π x sin x dx site n'iji ijikọta site n'akụkụ. (∫_0^π bụ ijikọta kpọmkwem site na 0 ruo π. [F]_0^π = F(π) − F(0).)
n-m-h3-integc-01.thinking.0: Lelee ahịrị ọ bụla nke ngwọta
n-m-h3-integc-01.thinking.1: Buru amụma akara nke ijikọta kpọmkwem site n'akara nke ihe a na-ejikọta
n-m-h3-integc-01.thinking.2: Nyochaa oke ebe usoro nlele na-adị (oke ebe akara na-agbanwe)
n-m-h3-integc-01.prereq.1: Mkpụrụ na ihe e jikọtara nke ọrụ trigonometric
n-m-h3-integc-01.prereq.2: Ijikọta kpọmkwem na akara nke ihe a na-ejikọta
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.hint.0: Maka ahịrị ọ bụla nke na-enye ọrụ ọhụrụ e chọtara (u', v), lelee ọrụ ahụ megide ọnọdụ mbụ.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.hint.1: N'ahịrị ebe e chọtara v, mepụta v n'onwe gị ma lelee ma ọ hà v'.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.0: Maka ∫_0^π x sin x dx, ka u=x na v'=sin x.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.1: Mgbe ahụ u'=1 na v=cos x.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.2: Site n'usoro ijikọta site n'akụkụ, ∫_0^π x sin x dx = [x cos x]_0^π − ∫_0^π 1·cos x dx.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.3: [x cos x]_0^π = π·cos π − 0 = −π, ma ∫_0^π cos x dx = [sin x]_0^π = 0.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.4: Ya mere ∫_0^π x sin x dx = −π.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 2 bụ nke mbụ na-ezighi ezi. Mkpụrụ nke cos x bụ −sin x, ya mere v nke v'=sin x bụ −cos x, ọ bụghị cos x. Site n'ahịrị 3 gaa n'ihu, a na-etinye v na-ezighi ezi n'usoro naanị, ya mere usoro na mgbakọ ziri ezi ma nsonaazụ na-ezighi ezi.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.prompt: Dozie ahịrị ezighị ezi ma chọta uru nke ∫_0^π x sin x dx. Mgbe ahụ, jiri akara nke x sin x na 0≤x≤π, dee n'ahịrịokwu otu ma ọ bụ abụọ ihe mere −π nke Seojin enweghị ike ịbụ uru ahụ.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.hint.0: Chọta v nwere v'=sin x ọzọ, tinye ya n'usoro dị n'ahịrị 3, ma tụọ ya n'oke ndị ahụ.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.hint.1: Lelee n'tebụl ma x na sin x nke ọ bụla dị opekata mpe 0 na 0≤x≤π, ma chee echiche ihe akara nke integral kpọmkwem nke ọrụ dị opekata mpe 0 bụ.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.placeholder: dị ka Ọ bụrụ na anyị edozie v, ..., ma uru bụ .... Mana x sin x bụ ...
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị gbanwere v ka ọ bụrụ −cos x ma tinyeghachi ya n'usoro?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị kwuru na sin x dị opekata mpe 0 na 0≤x≤π dị ka ihe kpatara gị?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị jikọtara àgwà na ọ bụrụ na integrand dị opekata mpe 0, integral kpọmkwem dị opekata mpe 0?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ v'=sin x, mgbe ahụ v=−cos x. [−x cos x]_0^π + ∫_0^π cos x dx = π + 0 = π. Na 0≤x≤π, x≥0 na sin x≥0, ya mere x sin x≥0, nke pụtara na integral kpọmkwem enweghị ike ịbụ nke na-adịghị mma (−π).
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbanwee v ka ọ bụrụ −cos x, uru bụ π. N'etiti ahụ x sin x dị opekata mpe 0 mgbe niile, ya mere dị ka mpaghara ọ nweghị ike ịpụta dị ala karịa 0, ma −π adịghị mma, nke bụ nsogbu.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.prompt: Ugbu a a na-eji otu ọrụ ahụ, mana a gbanwere etiti ka ọ bụrụ [0,2π]. Họrọ nkwupụta ziri ezi gbasara usoro ilele akara nke integral kpọmkwem site n'iji akara nke integrand.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.hint.0: Lelee akara nke sin x na [π,2π] ma chee udi eserese nke x sin x.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.hint.1: Mgbe e nwere akụkụ dị mma na nke na-adịghị mma abụọ, chee echiche ihe akara nke ngụkọta na-adabere na ya.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.a: x sin x dị opekata mpe 0 na [0,2π], ya mere uru ahụ ga-abụrịrị nke dị mma.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.a: Lelee akara nke sin x na [π,2π]. I lebeghị anya ma akara na-anọgide otu mgbe etiti na-agbanwe.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.b: Ọbụna ma akara na-agbanwe, akụkụ dị mma na-abịa mbụ, ya mere uru bụ nke dị mma mgbe niile.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.b: I lere naanị usoro n'enweghị ịtụnyere nha nke akụkụ dị mma na nke na-adịghị mma. Akụkụ na-adịghị mma nwere ike ịbụ nke ka ukwuu.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.c: Akara nke x sin x na-agbanwe n'ime etiti, ya mere akara naanị enweghị ike ikpebi akara nke uru.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.c: I chọpụtara na nlele akara bụ ngwa nke a pụrụ iji n'etiti ebe akara bụ otu udi.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.d: Ọbụna ma a gbasaa etiti, akụkụ agbakwunyere na-ewepụ ibe ya, ya mere uru bụ π, otu ahụ dị ka na [0,π].
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.d: I weere na etiti agbakwunyere [π,2π] ga-ewepụ ibe ya n'enweghị ilele integral ya ozugbo.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.explain: Na [π,2π], sin x≤0, ya mere x sin x≤0. Ya mere akara abụghị otu udi n'ofe etiti dum, ma akụkụ dị mma na akụkụ na-adịghị mma na-egbutu ibe ha. N'ezie, [−x cos x + sin x]_0^{2π} = −2π, nke na-adịghị mma. Nlele akara na-agwa gị akara nke uru naanị mgbe akara anaghị agbanwe n'ime etiti.

n-m-h3-integc-08.title: Mpaghara nke Otu Ebe: Mmadụ Abụọ, Ngwọta Abụọ Dị Iche
n-m-h3-integc-08.topic: Integration: mpaghara — ijikọta n'ihe gbasara x na n'ihe gbasara y (ịgbanwe nnọchite anya)
n-m-h3-integc-08.goal: Kọwaa, site n'iji udi nke ebe ahụ, ihe mere ijikọta n'ihe gbasara x na ijikọta n'ihe gbasara y ji enye otu mpaghara maka otu ebe, ma kpee ikpe ọnọdụ ụzọ nke abụọ nwere ike iji.
n-m-h3-integc-08.material: Mmadụ abụọ chọtara mpaghara nke ebe R nke curve y=ln x, axis x, na ahịrị x=e gbara site n'iji ụzọ dị iche. Jian dozie ∫_1^e ln x dx site na integration by parts ma nweta [x ln x − x]_1^e = (e−e)−(0−1) = 1. Soyul wepụrụ ∫_0^1 eʸ dy = e−1 site na mpaghara e nke rectangle 0≤x≤e, 0≤y≤1, ma nweta e−(e−1)=1. (∫_1^e bụ definite integral site na 1 ruo e.)
n-m-h3-integc-08.thinking.0: Bipụ ebe ahụ n'ntụziaka dị iche
n-m-h3-integc-08.thinking.1: Jiri ihe osise lelee ebe a na-ewepụ
n-m-h3-integc-08.thinking.2: Kpee ikpe ọnọdụ ụzọ ahụ na-arụ ọrụ (mmekọrịta otu n'otu)
n-m-h3-integc-08.prereq.1: Inverse functions na definite integrals nke logarithmic na exponential functions
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.prompt: N'ihe osise ahụ, akụkụ nke ∫_0^1 eʸ dy nke Soyul na-ewepụ site na e bụ mpaghara kedu?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.hint.0: Were ịdị elu y, seta otu ahịrị kwụ ọtọ n'ofe rectangle, ma chọta ebe curve na-egbutu ahịrị ahụ.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.hint.1: N'ahịrị ahụ, kwuo akụkụ nke curve, aka ekpe ma ọ bụ aka nri, bụ R.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.a: Ebe R n'onwe ya, nke anyị chọrọ ịchọta mpaghara ya
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.a: Mpaghara R bụ uru e nwetara site n'iwepụ nkwupụta a site na e. Ọ bụrụ na R dị otu na ebe nkwupụta a, a gaghị achọ iwepụ site na e.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.b: Ihe fọdụrụ nke rectangle 0≤x≤e, 0≤y≤1 mgbe e wepụsịrị R
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.b: Ị hụrụ na ọ bụ akụkụ n'aka ekpe nke curve x=eʸ, ya bụ, akụkụ nke rectangle ahụ nke na-abụghị R.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.c: Akụkụ n'okpuru curve y=ln x nwere 1≤x≤e
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.c: Akụkụ ahụ bụ kpọmkwem R. Soyul anaghị ewepụ R site na e; ọ na-ewepụ akụkụ fọdụrụ.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.d: Akụkụ n'etiti axis x na curve nwere 0<x<1
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.d: Maka 0<x<1 curve dị n'okpuru axis x, ya mere ọ bụghị akụkụ nke R, ọ nweghịkwa mmekọrịta na nkwupụta a.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.explain: Mpaghara nke rectangle 0≤x≤e, 0≤y≤1 bụ e. N'ịdị elu y ọ bụla, ebe dị na curve bụ x=eʸ, ya mere obosara nke akụkụ n'aka ekpe ya bụ eʸ, mpaghara ya bụkwa ∫_0^1 eʸ dy = e−1. R bụ akụkụ n'aka nri nke curve, ya mere mpaghara ya bụ e−(e−1)=1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.prompt: Soro ụzọ Soyul, chọta mpaghara nke ebe y=ln x, axis x, na ahịrị x=e² gbara. Gosi obosara na ịdị elu nke rectangle na definite integral ị na-ewepụ, ma dee nsonaazụ.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.hint.0: Chọta ịdị elu nke curve na x=e², y=ln e², iji kpebie ịdị elu nke rectangle.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.hint.1: N'ịdị elu y ọ bụla, kwuo x-coordinate nke curve n'okwu y, mgbe ahụ jikọta nkwupụta ahụ site na 0 ruo ịdị elu nke rectangle.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.placeholder: dịka, Rectangle nwere obosara ..., ịdị elu ..., na ...
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ kwenyesiri ike na ịdị elu nke rectangle bụ ln e²=2?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ lelere na ọ kwekọrọ n'uru e chọtara site na integration by parts?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.model.0: Rectangle nwere obosara e² na ịdị elu ln e²=2, ya mere mpaghara ya bụ 2e². Akụkụ n'aka ekpe nke curve bụ ∫_0^2 eʸ dy = e²−1. Ya mere mpaghara R bụ 2e² − (e²−1) = e²+1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.model.1: Na x=e², y na-esi na 0 ruo 2, ya mere mpaghara rectangle bụ 2e² ma akụkụ a ga-ewepụ bụ ∫_0^2 e^y dy=e²−1. Mpaghara bụ 2e²−e²+1=e²+1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.prompt: Enwere ike iji ụzọ Soyul "mgbe enwere ike ide curve dịka otu nkwupụta nke udi x=h(y)." Họrọ curves niile n'okpuru nke enwere ike ide otú ahụ n'oge e nyere.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.hint.0: Maka curve ọ bụla, were otu uru y ma gụọ x ole n'oge ahụ nwere uru y ahụ.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.hint.1: Lelee ma eserese ahụ na-arị elu na-agbadakwa n'ime oge ahụ (ma ọ bụ na-abawanye naanị).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.a: Uru y ọ bụla kwekọrọ na uru x abụọ (x na −x). Enweghị ike ide ya dịka otu nkwupụta nke udi x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.b: Ị hụrụ na y ọ bụla kwekọrọ naanị otu x (x=ln y), ya mere enwere ike ide ya dịka otu nkwupụta nke udi x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.c: Uru y ọ bụla kwekọrọ na uru x abụọ (x na π−x). Enweghị ike ide ya dịka otu nkwupụta nke udi x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.d: Ị hụrụ na y ọ bụla kwekọrọ naanị otu x (x= cube root nke y), ya mere enwere ike ide ya dịka otu nkwupụta nke udi x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.explain: y=eˣ (0≤x≤1) na y=x³ (−1≤x≤1) na-abawanye n'oge ha, ya mere y ọ bụla kwekọrọ otu x (ha nwere inverse functions). Maka y=x² ma ọ bụ y=sin x, e nwere x abụọ maka otu y, ya mere dịka ha dị ha enweghị ike ịbụ otu nkwupụta x=h(y), a ga-ekewakwa oge ahụ.

n-m-h3-vec-04.topic: Vector na jiometrị ihe siri ike
n-m-h3-vec-04.title: Akụkụ Dị n'Etiti Ahịrị Abụọ Ọ Bụ Otu Na Akụkụ Dị n'Etiti Vector Ntụzịaka Ha?
n-m-h3-vec-04.goal: Ghọta ọdịiche dị n'etiti akụkụ dị n'etiti vector ntụzịaka na akụkụ dị n'etiti ahịrị site n'ịgbanwe ikpe gị ka a na-agbakwunye ozi, ma jiri usoro ziri ezi maka akụkụ dị n'etiti ahịrị.
n-m-h3-vec-04.material: Ị chọrọ ichọta akụkụ θ dị n'etiti ahịrị abụọ l na m n'ụgbọ elu nhazi. A na-ekpughe ozi otu otu. (A na-agụ u·v dị ka "u dot v," |u| bụ nha nke u, ma a na-agụ √5 dị ka "root 5.")
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.0: Ịgbanwe ikpe gị mgbe ozi ọhụrụ pụtara
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.1: Ilele ma uru bụ otu ọbụlagodi na e họrọ vector ntụzịaka n'ụzọ dị iche
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.2: Ịkọwa ihe mere uru zuru oke ji dị mkpa
n-m-h3-vec-04.prereq.0: Dot product nke vector ụgbọ elu na akụkụ dị n'etiti ha
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.prompt: A na-ekpughe ozi otu otu. N'ogo ọ bụla, họrọ ikpe site n'iji naanị ihe ị maara ruo ugbu a.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.hint.0: Mgbe ọ bụla ozi ọhụrụ pụtara, lelee ma ikpe gara aga ka dị.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.hint.1: Maka otu ahịrị ahụ, họrọ vector ntụzịaka na-emegide, mee otu ngụkọta ahụ, ma tụnyere nsonaazụ ndị ahụ.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.info: I họrọla u=(1, 2) dị ka vector ntụzịaka nke ahịrị l na v=(1, −3) dị ka vector ntụzịaka nke ahịrị m. Ịgbakọ na-enye u·v=−5, |u|=√5, |v|=√10.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kedu ka ị si ekpe akụkụ θ dị n'etiti ahịrị abụọ ahụ?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Akụkụ dị n'etiti u na v nwere cos = −1/√2, ya bụ, 135°. Ma e kwadoghị ka ma enwere ike were uru a dị ka akụkụ dị n'etiti ahịrị abụọ ahụ.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: I bufere akụkụ dị n'etiti vector abụọ ahụ ozugbo gaa n'akụkụ dị n'etiti ahịrị. Nke a bụ ikpe mbụ na-abata n'uche.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Anyị kwesịrị ilele ọzọ ma uru a na-akọwa n'ezie akụkụ dị n'etiti ahịrị, na ma ọ bụ otu ma e họrọ vector ntụzịaka n'ụzọ dị iche
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: I chetara na vector ntụzịaka abụghị otu uru kwụsiri ike maka ahịrị ọ bụla.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ebe ọ bụ na dot product adịghị mma, anyị nwere ike ikwu naanị na ahịrị abụọ ahụ adịghị perpendicular
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: I kwuru naanị na ha adịghị perpendicular. I kpebighị nha nke akụkụ.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Ọbụna ma ị were −v=(−1, 3) dị ka vector nduzi nke ahịrị m kama v, ọ bụ otu ahịrị m.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Gịnị bụ akụkụ dị n'etiti u na −v, ma gịnị ka nke a na-agwa anyị banyere akụkụ θ dị n'etiti ahịrị ndị ahụ?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Akụkụ dị n'etiti u na v bụ 135°, ma akụkụ dị n'etiti u na −v bụ 45°. Ọbụna maka otu ahịrị abụọ ahụ, uru na-agbanwe dabere n'otu a họrọ vector nduzi. Mgbe ahịrị abụọ zutere, akụkụ 45° na 135° na-etolite, ya mere anyị chọrọ nkwekọrịta maka nke a ga-akpọ akụkụ dị n'etiti ahịrị ndị ahụ.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: u·(−v)=5 na cos=1/√2, ya mere ọ bụ 45°. Maka otu ahịrị ndị ahụ, akụkụ abụọ, 135° na 45°, na-apụta, ya mere dot product nwere akara naanị anaghị ekpebi akụkụ dị n'etiti ahịrị ndị ahụ
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: I lelere ozugbo na uru na-agbanwe dabere n'otu a họrọ vector nduzi.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Inweta 45° bụ njehie ngụkọta, ma 135° ziri ezi
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ịgbanwe ka ọ bụrụ −v na-atụgharị akara nke dot product, ya mere cos na-aghọ +1/√2; nke a abụghị njehie.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: u·(−v)=5 ma akụkụ bụ 45°, ya mere 135° nke mbụ ezighị ezi ma akụkụ dị n'etiti ahịrị ndị ahụ bụ 45°
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: I ziri ezi na 45° na-apụta, mana i hapụrụ na 135° na 45° abụọ sitere n'otu ahịrị abụọ ahụ. Anyị chọrọ nkwekọrịta maka nke a ga-ewere dị ka akụkụ dị n'etiti ahịrị ndị ahụ.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Anyị kwenyere na akụkụ θ dị n'etiti ahịrị abụọ bụ nke n'ime ụdị akụkụ abụọ e mepụtara ebe ha zutere (45° na 135°) nke na-adịghị buru ibu, ya bụ, nke nwere 0°<θ≤90°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kedu usoro na-enye θ mgbe niile n'agbanyeghị otu a họrọ vector nduzi?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.after: |u·v|=5, ya mere cosθ=5/(√5·√10)=1/√2 na θ=45°. A ga-achọta akụkụ dị n'etiti ahịrị site n'usoro na-eji uru zuru oke nke dot product, ka otu uru ahụ pụta n'agbanyeghị otu a họrọ vector nduzi.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Akara na-agbanwe dabere n'nhọrọ vector nduzi, ya mere ọ nwere ike ghara ịdabara n'nkwekọrịta na θ dị n'etiti 0° na 90°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Iji uru zuru oke nke dot product na-enye otu uru ahụ ọbụna ma a tụgharịa vector nduzi, ma cosθ≥0, ya mere θ adịghị karịa 90°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Nke a ziri ezi naanị mgbe a na-eji −v; ọ bụrụ na a họrọ ya n'ụzọ ọzọ akara dị iche, ya mere ọ bụghị usoro nke na-ziri ezi mgbe niile.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.reflect: Na mbụ i buru akụkụ dị n'etiti vector nduzi gaa n'akụkụ dị n'etiti ahịrị ndị ahụ ozugbo, mana ikpe gị gbanwere mgbe e gbakwunyere ozi na ọbụna otu ahịrị nwere vector nduzi n'nduzi abụọ megidere ibe ha. Akụkụ dị n'etiti ahịrị ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ nke anaghị agbanwe site n'akara nke vector nduzi, ya mere anyị na-achọta ya site n'iwere uru zuru oke nke dot product.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.prompt: Vector nduzi nke ahịrị p bụ (2, 1) ma vector nduzi nke ahịrị q bụ (1, −3). Chọta uru nke cosθ maka akụkụ θ dị n'etiti ahịrị abụọ ahụ, ma dee n'otu ahịrịokwu ihe mere usoro ji chọrọ uru zuru oke.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.hint.0: Chọta uru nke dot product na nha nke vector abụọ ahụ, ma tinye ha n'usoro.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.hint.1: Mee otu ngụkọta ahụ na (−1, 3), nke tụgharịrị nke vector nduzi (1, −3), ma tụnyere nsonaazụ.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.placeholder: dị ka cosθ = ... A chọrọ uru zuru oke n'ihi na ...
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị gbakọrọ uru nke u·v na nha nke vector abụọ ahụ?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị tụnyere akụkụ ole na-apụta ma ị jiri dot product dị ka o si dị mgbe ọ na-adịghị mma?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị jikọtara ihe kpatara uru zuru oke na "otu a họrọ vector nduzi"?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.model.0: (2, 1)·(1, −3) = −1 ma nha bụ √5 na √10, ya mere cosθ = |−1|/(√5·√10) = 1/(5√2) ≈ 0.14. Ọ bụrụ na anyị tụgharịa vector nduzi, akara nke dot product na-agbanwe, ya mere anyị chọrọ uru zuru oke ka akụkụ dị n'etiti ahịrị bụrụ nke a kpebiri n'otu ụzọ.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.model.1: Dot product bụ −1 ma |p|=√5, |q|=√10, ya mere cosθ=1/√50=√2/10. Anyị na-eji uru zuru oke n'ihi na anyị kwenyere na akụkụ dị n'etiti ahịrị abụọ adịghị karịa 90°, ma anyị chọrọ otu uru ahụ n'agbanyeghị otu a họrọ vector nduzi.

n-m-h3-dist-06.thinking.0: Megharịa mkpebi gị ka ozi na-abawanye
n-m-h3-dist-06.title: Ọ bụrụ na i tụgharịa mkpụrụ ego ọtụtụ ugboro, isi ọ̀ ga-apụta kpọmkwem ọkara?
n-m-h3-dist-06.topic: Nkesa probability: nkesa binomial na ọnụ ọgụgụ nnwale
n-m-h3-dist-06.goal: Lelee n’usoro otú probability nke “kpọmkwem ọkara” na nke “nso ọkara” si agbanwe n’ụzọ dị iche ka ọnụ ọgụgụ nnwale na-abawanye, mezie echiche mbụ gị.
n-m-h3-dist-06.material: Ka X bụrụ ọnụọgụ isi (heads) mgbe a tụrụ mkpụrụ ego ziri ezi. A na-ekpughe ozi otu otu. (A chọtara puru ihe maka ọnụọgụ ntụgharị buru ibu site n'iji kalkuleta.)
n-m-h3-dist-06.thinking.1: Kewaa puru ihe nke uru kpọmkwem na puru ihe nke oke
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.prompt: N'nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, họrọ ikpe dabere n'ihe ị maara ruo ugbu a.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.hint.0: Mgbe ọ bụla ozi ọhụrụ pụtara, chee ma azịza maka otu ajụjụ ahụ kwesịrị ịgbanwe.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.hint.1: Dee n'akụkụ ibe ha puru ihe nke inweta isi 4, 5, na 6 n'ntụgharị 10, ma lee otú ọnụọgụ ndị dị nso dị otú ahụ si agbanwe ka ọnụọgụ ntụgharị na-abawanye.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ọ ga-adị ka ihe puru ihe iji nweta kpọmkwem isi 5?
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.after: C(10,5)/2¹⁰=252/1024≈0.246. Ọ bụ ezie na nke a bụ ọnụọgụ kacha puru ihe, puru ihe ya bụ naanị ihe dị ka 25%.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ihe dị ka 50%: n'ihi na kpọmkwem ọkara bụ nsonaazụ kacha eme n'onwe ya
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: I chere na inweta ọkara bụ nsonaazụ kacha eme n'onwe ya, yabụ puru ihe ya kwesịrị ịbụ 50%.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ihe dị ka 25%: n'ihi na ọ bụ ọnụọgụ etiti, ma ọ na-ekere òkè puru ihe na ọnụọgụ ndị dị nso dị ka 4 na 6
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.r.b: I hụrụ na ọbụlagodi ọnụọgụ etiti kacha puru ihe na-ekere òkè puru ihe na ọnụọgụ ndị dị nso ya.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ihe na-erughị 5%: n'ihi na ịkụ ya kpọmkwem bụ ihe na-adịghị ahụkebe
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.r.c: I chere na ịkụ ọnụọgụ kpọmkwem bụ ihe na-adịghị ahụkebe nke ukwuu.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.info: Oge a ị na-atụ mkpụrụ ego ugboro 100, ma ajụjụ ahụ bụ puru ihe nke inweta kpọmkwem isi 50.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kedu ka ọ si tụnyere ihe dị ka 25% maka ntụgharị 10?
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.after: C(100,50)/2¹⁰⁰≈0.080. Ka ọnụọgụ ntụgharị na-abawanye, puru ihe nke "kpọmkwem ọkara" na-adị ntakịrị n'ezie.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ọ na-adị ntakịrị: n'ihi na e nwere ọtụtụ ọnụọgụ dị nso nwere puru ihe yiri ya
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: I hụrụ na ọtụtụ ọnụọgụ dị nso nwere puru ihe yiri nke ọnụọgụ etiti, yabụ òkè nke otu uru etiti na-ebelata.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ọ na-adị ukwuu: n'ihi na ka ị na-atụ ọtụtụ, ka ị na-abịaru ọkara nso
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: I chere na ka ị na-atụ ọtụtụ, ka kpọmkwem ọkara na-apụtakwu.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ọ na-anọgide ihe dị ka otu: n'ihi na ọ ka bụ ọkara na ọkara
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: I lere naanị eziokwu na ọ bụ ọkara na ọkara ma ahụghị mmetụta nke ọnụọgụ ntụgharị gbanwere.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Ugbu a ajụjụ bụ puru ihe na, n'ntụgharị 100, òkè isi dị n'etiti 40% na 60% gụnyere (isi 40 ruo 60). N'ntụgharị 10, puru ihe nke inweta isi 4 ruo 6 bụ ihe dị ka 66%.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.ask: Gịnị na-eme puru ihe a maka ntụgharị 100?
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.after: Puru ihe nke isi 40 ruo 60 bụ ihe dị ka 0.965. Puru ihe nke kpọmkwem 50 gbadara, ma puru ihe nke ịdaba nso ọkara na-arị elu n'ezie.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Dị ala karịa 66%: n'ihi na puru ihe nke kpọmkwem ọkara gbadakwara
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: I chere na ebe puru ihe nke kpọmkwem ọkara belatara, puru ihe nso ọkara ga-abụ na ọ belatakwara.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ihe dị ka 8%: n'ihi na puru ihe maka ntụgharị 100 bụ 8%
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: I wetụrụ puru ihe nke kpọmkwem 50 ka ọ bụrụ puru ihe nke oke.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Karịa 90%: n'ihi na nsonaazụ na-agbakọta nso ọkara
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: I lere puru ihe jikọtara nke oke dị nso ọkara, ọ bụghị nke uru kpọmkwem.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.reflect: Na mbụ ọ dị mfe ichee na "ka ị na-atụ ọtụtụ, ka kpọmkwem ọkara na-apụtakwu." Ma ka ọnụọgụ ntụgharị na-abawanye, puru ihe nke kpọmkwem ọkara na-ada, ebe puru ihe na òkè isi na-adaba nso ọkara na-arị elu. Ị ga-agụ "uru kpọmkwem" na "oke" dị ka ihe dị iche.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.prompt: Dee otú puru ihe nke inweta kpọmkwem ọkara isi na puru ihe nke ịdaba nso ọkara nke ọ bụla si agbanwe ka ọnụọgụ ntụgharị na-abawanye. Ọ bụrụ na echiche gị dị iche na echiche mbụ gị, tinyekwa nke ahụ.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.hint.0: Dee n'akụkụ ibe ha puru ihe nke "kpọmkwem ọkara" maka ntụgharị 10 na maka ntụgharị 100.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.hint.1: Dee otú puru ihe nke "nso ọkara" si dị iche n'ikpe abụọ ahụ.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.placeholder: dịka ọmụmaatụ, Ma e tụnyere ntụgharị 10, maka ntụgharị 100 puru ihe nke kpọmkwem ...
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị tụnyere uru puru ihe n'ikpe abụọ ahụ?
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị kewara puru ihe nke uru kpọmkwem na puru ihe nke oke?
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị kwuru otú echiche mbụ gị si gbanwee?
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.model.0: Ka ọnụọgụ ntụgharị na-abawanye, puru ihe nke kpọmkwem ọkara na-ada site n'ihe dị ka 25% maka ntụgharị 10 ruo ihe dị ka 8% maka ntụgharị 100. Ma puru ihe nke ịdaba nso ọkara na-arị elu n'ezie: maka ntụgharị 100, puru ihe nke isi 40 ruo 60 karịrị 96%.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.model.1: Na mbụ echere m na ịtụ ọtụtụ ugboro ga-enye kpọmkwem ọkara, ma nke ahụ ezighi ezi. Puru ihe nke kpọmkwem ọkara na-ada, ebe puru ihe na òkè isi na-agbakọta nso ọkara na-arị elu.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.model.2: Ka ị na-atụ ọtụtụ, òkè nke otu nsonaazụ nke kpọmkwem ọkara na-adị ntakịrị, ma puru ihe nke ịdaba nso ọkara na-abawanye.

n-m-h3-serieslim-02.topic: Usoro: ngụkọta akụkụ na usoro geometric na-enweghị ọgwụgwụ
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.title: Ịlele Azịza Nke Chọtara Okwu Izugbe Site n'Usoro Ngụkọta Akụkụ
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.goal: Mụta na a ga-achọta a_1 iche mgbe a na-achọta okwu izugbe site n'ngụkọta akụkụ S_n, dozie azịza ezighị ezi, ma lelee ya site n'iji ngụkọta lim S_n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.material: Ngụkọta nke okwu n mbụ nke usoro bụ S_n = 4 − 3·(1/2)^(n−1). Gụọ azịza Minjae maka ịchọta ngụkọta nke usoro a. ((1/2)^(n−1) pụtara ọkara n'ike nke n−1.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.thinking.0: Ịchọta ahịrị mbụ n'azịza nke na-agbagwoju anya
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.thinking.2: Ịlele site n'ụzọ ọzọ (oke nke ngụkọta akụkụ)
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.thinking.3: Ịchọta ọnọdụ nke usoro na-adịkwa na n=1
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.prereq.1: Usoro maka ngụkọta nke usoro geometric na-enweghị njedebe
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ n'azịza Minjae nke na-agbagwoju anya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.hint.0: Lelee ahịrị otu otu ma ahịrị ọ bụla na-esi n'nke gara aga pụta n'ezie.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tụnyere ma ọnọdụ (oke nke n) e ji nweta usoro na-anọgide dị ka o si dị n'ahịrị na-esote.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.0: Ngụkọta nke usoro bụ lim S_n, ma maka n ≥ 2, a_n = S_n − S_(n−1).
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.2: Ịchee na a pụrụ iji usoro a maka n=1 kwa, tọọ a_n = 3·(1/2)^(n−1) maka n niile.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.3: Nke a bụ usoro geometric na-enweghị njedebe nwere okwu mbụ 3 na ratio nkịtị 1/2, ya mere ngụkọta bụ 3/(1−1/2) = 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụ ahịrị 3. A pụrụ iji S_n−S_(n−1) naanị maka n≥2, ya mere ma usoro enwetara na-adịkwa na n=1 ga-elele iche. Ebe a a_1=S_1=4−3=1, mana itinye n=1 n'usoro na-enye 3, nke dị iche. Ngụkọta nke ahịrị 1 na 2 ziri ezi, ma ahịrị 4 bụ nsonaazụ nke na-esote ahịrị 3.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.prompt: Dozie azịza Minjae ma chọta ngụkọta nke usoro a. Mgbe ahụ chọta okwu mbụ a_1 ozugbo, tụnyere ya na uru Minjae, ma dee ihe mere ngụkọta ji agbanwe.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.hint.0: Chọta oke nke S_n ozugbo ma tụnyere ya na uru Minjae nwetara.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tinye n'usoro iji chọta a_1 site na S_1, ma mgbe ahụ tụnyere ya na uru ị na-enweta site n'itinye n=1 n'usoro okwu izugbe Minjae.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị lelere ma usoro enwetara maka n≥2 na-adịkwa na n=1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị lelere ngụkọta ahụ ugboro abụọ site na lim S_n?
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.0: a_1=S_1=4−3=1. Mana itinye n=1 n'3·(1/2)^(n−1) na-enye 3, ya mere a_1 dị iche. Ya mere a_1=1, ma site na n≥2 okwu bụ 3·(1/2)^(n−1). Ngụkọta bụ 1+(3/2)/(1−1/2)=1+3=4, nke hà nhatakwa lim S_n=4.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.1: Okwu mbụ bụ S_1=1, ọ bụghị 3 sitere n'usoro okwu izugbe. Site n'n=2, okwu mbụ bụ 3/2 ma ratio nkịtị bụ 1/2, ya mere akụkụ ahụ bụ 3/2÷(1/2)=3, ma ịgbakwunye 1 na-enye ngụkọta 4.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.2: Iwere oke nke S_n ozugbo na-enye 4−0=4, ma 6 Minjae dere bụ uru nke nwere 3 agbakwunyere n'ihi na o weere a_1 dị ka 3 n'njehie. A_1 n'ezie bụ S_1=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.3: lim S_n=4. a_1=S_1=1, mana Minjae weere ya dị ka 3. Ya mere azịza ziri ezi bụ 4, ọ bụghị 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.prompt: Maka S_n ọ bụla n'okpuru, họrọ nke usoro okwu izugbe enwetara maka n≥2 na-adịkwa dị ka o si dị na n=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.hint.0: Maka usoro ọ bụla, chọta S_1 ma tụnyere ya na uru ị na-enweta site n'itinye n=1 n'usoro enwetara site na S_n−S_(n−1).
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.hint.1: Maka usoro ọ bụla, tinye uru dị iche iche nke n n'S_n ma tụnyere, ma chọọ ihe ha nwere n'otu n'usoro ndị S_1 a gbakọrọ ozugbo hà nhata uru nke usoro a_1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.a: Nke a bụ usoro Minjae. a_1=1 mana usoro na-enye 3, ya mere ọ naghị adabara.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.b: a_1=S_1=1, mana itinye n=1 n'usoro 2·(1/2)^(n−1) maka n≥2 na-enye 2, ya mere ọ naghị adabara.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.c: a_1=S_1=3, ma itinye n=1 n'usoro 3·(1/2)^(n−1) maka n≥2 na-enyekwa 3, ya mere ọ na-adabara.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.d: a_1=S_1=7/2, mana itinye n=1 n'usoro 3·(1/2)^n maka n≥2 na-enye 3/2, ya mere ọ naghị adabara.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.explain: Ọ bụrụ na itinye n=0 n'usoro S_n na-enye S_0=0 (c: 6−6=0), usoro na-adịkwa na n=1. Maka ndị ọzọ, S_0 bụ −2, −1, 2 n'usoro, ya mere a ga-achọta a_1 iche.

n-m-h3-serieslim-05.topic: Usoro: ngụkọta akụkụ na usoro geometric na-enweghị ọgwụgwụ
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.prompt: Na nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, họrọ mkpebi site n'iji naanị ihe ị maara ruo ugbu a.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.prereq.0: Ngụkọta nke usoro geometric na-enweghị njedebe
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.title: Mgbe x Bụ 0, Ngụkọta Nke Usoro ̀ Na-enye Otu Usoro Ahụ?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.goal: Maka usoro geometric nke ratio nkịtị ya na-agbanwe na x, nyochaa oke ebe usoro ngụkọta na-adị, ma kọwaa na ịgbakọ iche na x=0 na-egosi na ngụkọta dị iche n'isi ebe ahụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.material: Maka ọnụọgụ n'ezie x, ka f(x)=x²+x²/(1+x²)+x²/(1+x²)²+x²/(1+x²)³+…. (Ọ bụ usoro nwere okwu mbụ x² nke a na-amụba okwu ọ bụla na-esote site na 1/(1+x²).) A na-ekpughe ozi otu otu.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.thinking.0: Ịgbanwe ikpe gị ka ozi na-abawanye
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.thinking.1: Ịlele ọnọdụ maka iji usoro (okwu mbụ ≠ 0)
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.thinking.2: Ịnwale site n'itinye uru ókè ozugbo
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.hint.0: Oge ọ bụla ozi ọhụrụ pụtara, lelee ọzọ ma usoro i jiri na mbụ ka na-adị dị ka o si dị.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tinye x=0 ozugbo ma dee ihe okwu ole na ole mbụ bụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kedu usoro ị tụrụ anya na f(x) bụ maka ọnụọgụ n'ezie x niile?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.after: x²/(1−1/(1+x²))=1+x² bụ usoro enwetara mgbe e kagburu. Cheta na e nwere x nke x² e kagburu bụ 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: f(x)=1+x²: n'ihi na uru abụọ ahụ dabara n'1+x²
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: I gbasaara usoro nke dabara n'isi ebe abụọ n'x niile. Nke a bụ ikpe mbụ na-abata n'uche.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: f(x)=1+x², mana a ga-enyocha iche x nke ratio nkịtị ya pụrụ iche
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ị na-enwe obi abụọ ma nsonaazụ n'isi ebe abụọ na-adị n'x niile.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: f(x)=x²+1/x²: n'ihi na usoro ọzọ nwekwara ike ịdabara n'uru abụọ ahụ
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Na x=1 ọ na-enye 2 ma na x=2 ọ na-enye 4.25, ya mere ọ naghị adabara n'otu n'ime uru abụọ ahụ. I tinyeghị ịlele usoro ahụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Ugbu a tụlee ikpe x=0. Tinye x=0 ozugbo n'usoro nkọwa nke f.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.after: f(0)=0. Ọbụna ma ratio nkịtị bụ 1, ọ bụrụ na okwu mbụ bụ 0 mgbe ahụ ngụkọta akụkụ niile bụ 0, ya mere ọ na-abịaru 0 nso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 1: n'ihi na anyị nwere ike itinye x=0 n'usoro 1+x²
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ị tinyere usoro e nwetara maka x≠0 n'x=0 dịka ọ dị.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 0: n'ihi na okwu niile bụ 0, ya mere partial sums niile bụ 0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ị malitere site na nkọwa ma gbakọọ partial sums ozugbo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Akọwapụtaghị: n'ihi na common ratio bụ 1, ya mere ọ na-agbasa
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ị chere na common ratio nke 1 na-agbasa mgbe niile. Ị hapụrụ ikpe ebe okwu mbụ bụ 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Iji chịkọta, f(x)=1+x² ma ọ bụrụ x≠0, f(0)=0 ma ọ bụrụ x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Nkwupụta kedu ziri ezi banyere limit nke f(x) ka x→0 na continuity na x=0?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Okwu ọ bụla na-aga n'ihu, ma nchikota f gbajiri na x=0. Maka nchikota enweghị njedebe, "ọ bụrụ na okwu ọ bụla na-aga n'ihu, nchikota na-aga n'ihu" anaghị ejide mgbe niile.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Limit bụ 1 ma f(0)=0, ya mere f anaghị aga n'ihu na x=0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ị kpere ikpe continuity site n'itụnyere uru limit na uru function.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Okwu ọ bụla bụ continuous function, ya mere nchikota f na-aga n'ihu maka x niile
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ị tinyere onwunwe na-ejide maka nchikota nwere njedebe n'nchikota enweghị njedebe dịka ọ dị.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Limit na f(0) abụọ bụ 0, ya mere f na-aga n'ihu na x=0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ị lelebeghị ebe usoro 1+x² maka x≠0 na-aga ka x→0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.reflect: Na mbụ ị chọrọ iji usoro dabara n'ebe abụọ maka x niile, ma ikpe gị gbanwere mgbe ị lelere ọnọdụ x²≠0 e jiri n'ịkagbu. Mgbe ị na-eji usoro, ị ga-anwale ozugbo n'uru oke ma ọnọdụ ebe usoro na-ejide na-emetụta n'ikpe a.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.prompt: Okwu x²/(1+x²)^n ọ bụla bụ continuous function nke x. Dee ihe f(0) bụ na x=0, na otu o si dị iche na usoro 1+x² maka x≠0, ya na ihe kpatara ya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tinye x=0 ozugbo n'usoro nkọwa nke f ma dee okwu mbụ ole na ole.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.hint.1: Mgbe ị na-eji usoro nchikota maka geometric series, lelee ma e nwere ikpe ebe divisor na-aghọ 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ tinyere x=0 n'ezie ma dee okwu mbụ ole na ole?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ tụlere ma a pụrụ iji usoro e nwetara maka x≠0 na x=0?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ kwuru na ọbụlagodi okwu ọ bụla na-aga n'ihu, nchikota nwere ike ọ naghị aga n'ihu?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na x=0, okwu ọ bụla bụ 0²/1^n=0, ya mere f(0)=0. Ma ọ bụrụ na x≠0, f(x)=1+x², ya mere n'akụkụ x=0 uru ya dị nso na 1. Ya mere limit 1 dị iche na f(0)=0, f adịghịkwa aga n'ihu na x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.1: Itinye x=0 na-enye common ratio nke 1, ma okwu niile site na nke mbụ bụ 0, ya mere nchikota bụ 0. Nke a dị iche na 1, nke ị na-enweta mgbe ị tinye 0 n'1+x², f gbajikwara na x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.2: A na-eji usoro 1+x² naanị maka x≠0. Ọ bụrụ na x=0, okwu niile bụ 0 ya mere nchikota bụ 0, nke dị iche na 1+0²=1, ya mere function anaghị ejikọta n'ebe ahụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.3: Ọ bụrụ na x=0, common ratio na-aghọ 1 ya mere enweghị ike iji usoro ahụ, okwu niile bụkwa 0, ya mere f(0)=0. Nke ahụ dị iche na 1, nke ị na-enweta mgbe ị tinye 0 n'1+x².

n-m-h3-serieslim-06.topic: Usoro: ngụkọta akụkụ na usoro geometric na-enweghị ọgwụgwụ
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.ok.c1: Uru zuru oke nke ratio nkịtị dị ala karịa 1, ya mere ọ na-abịaru nso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.title: Infinite Geometric Series Nke Okwu Mbụ Ya Karịrị Nchikota Ya
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.goal: Mee ọmụmaatụ nke infinite geometric series nwere nchikota 6 nke okwu mbụ ya karịrị 6, ma kọwaa otu ihe ịrịba ama nke common ratio si eme ka partial sums gaa n'elu na n'okpuru nchikota.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.material: Chee na infinite geometric series a + ar + ar² + … nwere okwu mbụ a na common ratio r nwere nchikota 6. Ọ dị mfe ichee, "Nchikota bụ 6, ya mere okwu mbụ ga-adị ala karịa 6."
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.thinking.0: Ime ọmụmaatụ na-emezu ọnọdụ n'onwe gị iji chọta ụkpụrụ
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.thinking.1: Ịlele mmekọrịta nha dị n'etiti nchikota na partial sums site n'ikpe
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.prereq.0: Nchikota nke infinite geometric series a/(1−r)
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.prompt: Mee infinite geometric series nwere nchikota 6 na okwu mbụ a karịrị 6, ma họrọkwa n (ọnụọgụ okike site na 1 ruo 9) nke partial sum S_n nke series ahụ karịrị 6. Tinye a, r, n. Mee atọ nwere (r, n) dị iche. (S_n bụ nchikota site n'okwu mbụ ruo okwu nke n.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee nha dị n'etiti a na r ka nchikota bụrụ 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.hint.1: Mgbe ị họrọ r site n'nha ahụ, lelee ma a karịrị 6, ọ bụrụkwa na ọ karịghị, gbanwee ihe ịrịba ama ma ọ bụ nha nke r.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.hint.2: Site na r ị họrọ, gbakọọ S_1, S_2, S_3 ozugbo ma họrọ n nke ọ karịrị 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.fail.c1: |r|<1 adịghị ejide, ya mere series a enweghị nchikota.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.fail.c4: Na n a, S_n adịghị karịa 6. Gbakọọ S_1, S_2, S_3 ozugbo ma tụnyere ha na 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.explain: Ebe a=6(1−r), a>6 chọrọ r<0. Mgbe ahụ S_n=6(1−r^n), ya mere ka S_n karịa 6 anyị chọrọ r^n<0, ya bụ, n ga-abụ ọnụọgụ ọdịnụ. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na a=9 na r=−1/2, mgbe ahụ S_1=9 na S_3=6(1+1/8)=6.75 karịrị 6, S_2=4.5 dịkwa ala. r=−1 anaghị ekwe n'ihi na |r|<1 na-agbaji, a=8, r=−1/2 nwere nchikota 8/1.5≈5.33.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.prompt: Họrọ ihe niile ga-ejide maka infinite geometric series nwere nchikota 6 na okwu mbụ karịrị 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.hint.0: Hazie n'tebụl ihe ọmụmaatụ ị mere n'nzọụkwụ gara aga nwere n'otu.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.hint.1: Gbakọọ S_1, S_2, S_3 maka ọmụmaatụ gị ma tụnyere ma nke ọ bụla karịrị ma ọ bụ dị ala karịa 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.o.a: S_2 karịrị 6 mgbe niile, dịka S_1
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.r.a: S_1 karịrị 6, ma okwu nke abụọ bụ negative, ya mere S_2 na-adị obere karịa S_1. N'ọmụmaatụ a=9, r=−1/2, S_2=4.5.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.o.b: Okwu niile bụ positive ma na-aga n'ihu na-ebelata
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.r.b: Ka okwu mbụ karịa nchikota, ụfọdụ okwu ga-abụ negative. Ọ bụrụ na okwu niile bụ positive, nchikota enweghị ike ịdị obere karịa okwu mbụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.r.c: Common ratio bụ negative ma okwu mbụ bụ positive, ya mere okwu nke abụọ ar bụ negative.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.o.d: Partial sums karịrị 6 na partial sums dị ala karịa 6 na-eso ibe ha
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.r.d: S_n=6(1−r^n) na r<0, ya mere ihe ịrịba ama nke r^n na-eso ibe ya, S_n−6=−6r^n na-esokwa ibe ya n'ihe ịrịba ama.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.explain: Ebe r<0, okwu nke abụọ bụ negative, n'S_n=6−6r^n ihe ịrịba ama nke ọdịiche site na 6, −6r^n, na-eso ibe ya. Ya mere S_2 dị ala karịa 6, ọ bụkwa ihe na-ekwe omume ka okwu niile bụrụ positive.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.prompt: Kọwaa ihe mere infinite geometric series nwere nchikota 6 ji nwee ike inwe okwu mbụ karịrị 6. Gụnye otu partial sum S_n ịkarịa ma ọ bụ ịdị ala karịa 6 si adabere n'n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.hint.0: Jiri otu n'ọmụmaatụ ndị ị mere n'elu, gbakọọ S_1, S_2, S_3 ma tụnyere ha na 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.hint.1: Dee S_n n'okwu a na r, ma chee ihe ịrịba ama nke ọdịiche ya na nchikota 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ gbakọrọ S_1, S_2, S_3 maka ọmụmaatụ ị mere?
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ jikọtara ihe ịrịba ama nke common ratio na omume nke partial sums?
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ tụnyere ikpe ebe okwu niile bụ positive?
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na common ratio bụ negative, ihe ịrịba ama nke okwu na-eso ibe ya. Ọ bụrụ na okwu mbụ karịrị 6, S_1 karịrị 6, okwu nke abụọ bụkwa negative, ya mere S_2 na-adị ala karịa 6. N'ụzọ a partial sums na-aga n'elu na n'okpuru n'usoro gburugburu 6 ka ha na-abịaru 6 nso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.model.1: Nchikota nke 6 apụtaghị na okwu mbụ ga-adị ala karịa 6. Ọ bụrụ na r bụ negative, S_n=6(1−r^n), ya mere mgbe n bụ ọdịnụ ọ dị n'elu 6, mgbe n bụ ọnụọgụ ọbụgụ ọ dị n'okpuru 6. Ya mere ọ na-aga n'elu na n'okpuru ka ọ na-abịaru 6 nso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.model.2: Naanị mgbe okwu bụ positive ka partial sums dị ala karịa nchikota. Ọ bụrụ na common ratio bụ negative, partial sums na-aga n'elu 6 ugboro ugboro ma laghachi n'okpuru, ya mere okwu mbụ nwere ike ịkarịa nchikota.

n-m-h3-serieslim-07.topic: Usoro: ngụkọta akụkụ na usoro geometric na-enweghị ọgwụgwụ
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.title: Mgbe Nchikota Series nke Series Abụọ Na-abịaru Nso?
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.goal: Hazie nchikota ebe convergence nke Σ(a_n+b_n) na-ekpebi site na ma Σa_n na Σb_n na-abịaru nso na ndị ebe ọ naghị ekpebi, ma wuo ihe atụ megidere.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.material: E nwere infinite series abụọ Σa_n na Σb_n, ị chọrọ ịmata ma series Σ(a_n+b_n), e mere site n'ịgbakwunye ha okwu site n'okwu, na-abịaru nso ma ọ bụ na-agbasa. Dabere n'ihe ị maara, oge ụfọdụ a kpebiri ya, oge ụfọdụ ọ bụghị.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.thinking.1: Igosi ikpe ndị a kpebibeghị site n'ihe atụ megidere
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.thinking.2: Ikwu ọnọdụ ebe iwu ọrụ na-ejide
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.prereq.1: Nchikota na okpukpu mgbe niile nke convergent series
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ozi niile na-ekpebi, dịka otu azịza, ma Σ(a_n+b_n) na-abịaru nso ma ọ bụ na-agbasa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.hint.0: Maka ozi ọ bụla, chee ụzọ a_n, b_n abụọ dị iche na-adabara ya ma lelee ma nchikota series na-enye otu nsonaazụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.hint.1: Chee ma ịgbakwunye ma ọ bụ iwepụ convergent series nwere ike ime ka divergent series bụrụ convergent.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.o.a: Σa_n na Σb_n abụọ na-abịaru nso
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.a: Nchikota nke convergent series abụọ na-abịaru nso, ya mere a kpebiri ya dịka otu azịza.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na a_n=b_n=1 ọ na-agbasa, ma ọ bụrụ na a_n=1, b_n=−1 nchikota series na-abịaru nso, ya mere akpebighị ya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.o.c: Σa_n na-abịaru nso ma Σb_n na-agbasa
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.c: Iwepụ convergent Σa_n na-ahapụ Σb_n, ya mere ọ bụrụ na nchikota series na-abịaru nso, Σb_n ga-abịarukwa nso; ya mere nchikota series na-agbasa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.o.d: a_n na b_n abụọ na-abịaru 0 nso
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na a_n=b_n=1/n nchikota series na-agbasa, ọ bụrụkwa na a_n=1/n², b_n=1/n² ọ na-abịaru nso. Akpebighị ya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na abụọ na-abịaru nso, nchikota series na-abịaru nso, ọ bụrụkwa na naanị otu na-abịaru nso, nchikota series na-agbasa (n'ihi na ọ bụrụ na ọ na-abịaru nso, Σb_n=Σ(a_n+b_n)−Σa_n ga-abịarukwa nso). Ọ bụrụ na abụọ na-agbasa, ma ọ bụ ma okwu na-aga 0, nke ahụ naanị anaghị ekpebi ya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.prompt: Gosi ikpe nke ozi adịghị zuru. Ka a_n=p·r^n, b_n=q·r^n (p≠0, q≠0, |r|≥1); mgbe ahụ Σa_n na Σb_n abụọ na-agbasa. Tinye p, q, r ugboro abụọ, nwere r dị iche, ka Σ(a_n+b_n) bụrụ nke na-abịaru nso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.hint.0: Dee a_n+b_n n'otu n'okwu r^n, mgbe ahụ chee ihe coefficient ga-abụ ka series ahụ na-abịaru nso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.hint.1: Chọta ụzọ iji mee coefficient 0 mgbe ị na-edebe ọnọdụ na ma p ma q abụghị 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Okwu n'ozuzu nke Σa_n na Σb_n abụghị 0, ya mere nke ọ bụla na-agbasa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.fail.c1: p ma ọ bụ q bụ 0, ya mere series ahụ anaghị agbasa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.ok.c2: |r|≥1, ya mere okwu n'ozuzu anaghị aga 0, ya mere nke ọ bụla na-agbasa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Ọ bụrụ na |r|<1, Σa_n na-abịaru nso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.ok.c3: a_n+b_n=(p+q)r^n=0, ya mere nchikota series na-abịaru nso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.fail.c3: (p+q)r^n abụghị 0, ya mere nchikota series na-agbasakwa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.explain: Ebe a_n+b_n=(p+q)r^n, ọ bụrụ na p+q=0 okwu niile bụ 0, ya mere nchikota series na-abịaru 0 nso. Ma ọ bụrụ na p≠0 na |r|≥1, a_n na b_n anaghị aga 0, ya mere nke ọ bụla na-agbasa. Na p=q=1 nchikota series na-agbasakwa, na |r|<1 series ọ bụla na-abịaru nso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.prompt: Kọwaa ihe mere nkwupụta "ọ bụrụ na Σa_n na Σb_n abụọ na-agbasa, mgbe ahụ Σ(a_n+b_n) na-agbasakwa" ji ezighị ezi. Jiri ọmụmaatụ nke nzọụkwụ gara aga, ma dee kwa ọnọdụ a chọrọ mgbe a na-ekewa series nke nchikota ka ọ bụrụ nchikota nke series abụọ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.hint.0: Dee a_n+b_n maka ọmụmaatụ ị tinyere n'nzọụkwụ gara aga.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.hint.1: Chee ma akụkụ ọ bụla ga-enwe uru mgbe a kewara nchikota.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ gbakọrọ a_n+b_n n'onwe gị maka ọmụmaatụ nke nzọụkwụ gara aga?
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru ọnọdụ a chọrọ maka ịkewa?
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ kwuru ihe nwere ike ime mgbe a gwakọtara divergent series abụọ?
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.model.0: Ọbụlagodi na abụọ na-agbasa, dịka Σa_n nwere p·r^n na Σb_n nwere −p·r^n, ịgbakwunye ha na-eme okwu niile 0, ya mere ọ na-abịaru nso. Ya mere mgbe abụọ na-agbasa, akpebighị ma nchikota series na-abịaru nso. Ka e kewaa nchikota ka ọ bụrụ Σa_n+Σb_n, nke ọ bụla ga-abịaru nso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.model.1: E nwere ihe atụ megidere. Ọ bụrụ na a_n=2^n na b_n=−2^n, nke ọ bụla na-agbasa, ma a_n+b_n=0, ya mere nchikota series na-abịaru 0 nso. Ya mere Σ(a_n+b_n)=Σa_n+Σb_n pụrụ iji naanị mgbe series abụọ na-abịaru nso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.model.2: Nchikota nke divergent series abụọ nwere ike ịbịaru nso site n'ịkagbu (1 na −1 na-agbakwunye ruo 0), ma ọ bụ gbasaa ma ọ bụrụ na ha nwere otu ihe ịrịba ama. Ya mere tupu ịkewa, ị ga-ebu ụzọ lelee na series ọ bụla na-abịaru nso.

n-m-h3-serieslim-08.topic: Usoro: ngụkọta akụkụ na usoro geometric na-enweghị ọgwụgwụ
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.title: Iji Tebụl Partial Sum Kpebie Mgbakọ Ziri Ezi
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.goal: Wepụ nkwupụta na-ezighị ezi site n'iji uru ọnụọgụ nke partial sums, chọta nchikota nke telescoping series site n'ịchọpụta kpọmkwem okwu ndị fọdụrụ, ma kwuo n'ozuzu mgbe oghere gbanwere.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.material: Ndị enyi abụọ na-enye uru dị iche maka nchikota nke series 1/(1·3) + 1/(2·4) + 1/(3·5) + … + 1/(n(n+2)) + …. Jiho: "Okwu ndị ahụ na-akagbu n'ihu na azụ, ya mere nchikota bụ 1/2." Seoa: "Nchikota bụ 3/4." Site n'iji calculator, partial sums S_n pụtara dịka S_1=0.333, S_2=0.458, S_3=0.525, S_4=0.567, S_5=0.595.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.thinking.0: Ịhazi nkwupụta site n'iji ihe akaebe ọnụọgụ
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.thinking.2: Ịgbanwe udi (partial fractions) iji kpughee nhazi
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.prereq.1: Nchikota nke series = limit nke partial sums
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ikpe ị nwere ike ikwu n'ụzọ kacha tụkwasị obi site na tebụl partial sum naanị.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ọ bụrụ na okwu niile bụ positive, lelee ma partial sums na-abawanye naanị ma ọ bụ nwekwara ike ibelata.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.hint.1: Tụnyere uru dị n'tebụl na uru nke nkwupụta abụọ ahụ ma lelee ma e karịrịla otu n'ime ha.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.o.a: Seoa ziri ezi: partial sums na-aga n'ihu na-abawanye ma na-abịaru 3/4 nso
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.r.a: Ị kwubiri 3/4 naanị site n'eziokwu na uru dị n'tebụl na-abawanye. Ha nwere ike na-abawanye gaa n'uru ndị ọzọ kwa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.o.b: Jiho ezighị ezi: partial sums na-abawanye naanị, S_3 karịlarị 1/2
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.r.b: Ị jiri eziokwu na okwu niile bụ positive, ya mere S_n anaghị ebelata, iji wepụ 1/2.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.o.c: Jiho ziri ezi: partial sums dị ka ndị na-agagharị gburugburu 1/2
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.r.c: Site n'S_3, ha karịlarị 1/2. Ị gụbeghị tebụl ahụ ruo njedebe.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.o.d: Site n'tebụl naanị, anyị enweghị ike ikpe Jiho ma ọ bụ Seoa
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụlagodi na anyị enweghị ike ikpebi ihe nchikota bụ, anyị nwere ike iwepụ 1/2.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.explain: Okwu niile bụ positive, ya mere S_n na-abawanye naanị. S_3=0.525 karịlarị 1/2, ya mere nchikota enweghị ike ịbụ 1/2. Enweghị ike ịkwenye 3/4 nke Seoa site n'tebụl naanị, ya mere anyị ga-achọta ya ozugbo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.prompt: Jiri 1/(n(n+2))=½(1/n−1/(n+2)) dee S_n, dee kpọmkwem okwu ndị fọdụrụ mgbe ndị ọzọ kagbuchara, ma chọta nchikota nke series. Dee kwa ihe mere okwu ndị ahụ ji fọdụrụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.hint.0: Gbasaa nkeji ahịrị, tọọ okwu mbụ 5 ma ọ bụ 6 n'otu ahịrị, ma seta ahịrị site n'ụzọ ndị na-akagbu.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ gbasaara n'ezie ma dee okwu mbụ ole na ole?
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru ihe mere okwu abụọ ji fọdụrụ?
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ chọtara nchikota site n'iji limit nke S_n?
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.model.0: N'S_n=½{(1−1/3)+(1/2−1/4)+(1/3−1/5)+…}, site n'1/3 gaa n'ihu okwu ọ bụla na-akagbu ebe abụọ n'azụ, 1 na 1/2 mbụ na −1/(n+1) na −1/(n+2) ikpeazụ na-afọdụ. S_n=½(1+1/2−1/(n+1)−1/(n+2)) limit bụkwa ½·3/2=3/4.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.model.1: Okwu ndị ahụ dị ebe abụọ iche, ya mere okwu abụọ mbụ, 1 na 1/2, enweghị ndị mmekọ ha ga-akagbu. Okwu abụọ ikpeazụ na-aga 0 ka n→∞, ya mere nchikota bụ ½(1+½)=3/4.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.model.2: Ebe S_n=½(3/2−1/(n+1)−1/(n+2)), ọ na-abịaru 3/4 nso ka n na-abawanye. N'ihi na okwu abụọ mbụ 1 na 1/2 na-afọdụ, 3/2 kama 1 na-abanye n'ime nkeji ahịrị.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.model.3: 1 na 1/2 nke mbụ fọdụrụ na-akagbughị. Nchikota 3/4
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na anyị eji otu ụzọ ahụ na series 1/(1·4) + 1/(2·5) + 1/(3·6) + … + 1/(n(n+3)) + …, kedu nchikota?
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.hint.0: Buru ụzọ chọta usoro nke na-ede 1/(n(n+3)) dịka ọdịiche nke ụmụ nkeji abụọ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.hint.1: Mgbe ọdịiche bụ ebe 3, gụọ ole okwu mbụ ka fọdụrụ n'akagbughị.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.r.a: Nke a bụ ikpe ebe naanị 1 mbụ fọdụrụ. Na ọdịiche 3, okwu 3 mbụ na-afọdụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.r.b: Nke a bụ ikpe ebe naanị okwu abụọ mbụ fọdụrụ. Na ọdịiche 3, okwu atọ na-afọdụ.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.r.d: Nke a bụ ikpe ebe okwu anọ mbụ fọdụrụ. Ọnụọgụ okwu fọdụrụ bụ 3, otu ahụ na ọdịiche.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ọdịiche bụ k, mgbe ahụ 1/(n(n+k))=(1/k)(1/n−1/(n+k)) ma okwu k mbụ 1, 1/2, …, 1/k fọdụrụ. Ngụkọta bụ (1/k)(1+1/2+…+1/k). Maka k=2 ọ bụ 3/4, ma maka k=3 ọ bụ 11/18.

n-m-h3-est-03.title: Nyocha nke ndị zara 900 ma ọ bụ nyocha enweghị usoro nke 60: Kedu ka ị kwesịrị ịtụkwasị obi?
n-m-h3-est-03.topic: Statistical estimation: ịkpa oke n'nyocha sample
n-m-h3-est-03.goal: Kewaa sample ịbụ nnukwu na sample ịnọchite anya population, ma kọwaa ihe mere ịkpa oke sitere n'ụzọ e si ahọrọ sample anaghị apụ mgbe nha sample na-abawanye.
n-m-h3-est-03.material: Ị chọrọ ịchọta nkezi oge ụmụ akwụkwọ niile 1200 n'ụlọ akwụkwọ na-amụ kwa ụbọchị. Ụzọ A tinyere njikọ nyocha n'webụsaịtị ụlọ akwụkwọ ma were nkezi nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 900 zara n'onwe ha: awa 3.1. Ụzọ B jụrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ 60 e họrọ site n'ọnụọgụ enweghị usoro site n'ndetu ụmụ akwụkwọ, ha niile zakwara: nkezi bụ awa 2.4.
n-m-h3-est-03.thinking.0: Tụọ nha sample na ụzọ e si ahọrọ sample n'iche
n-m-h3-est-03.thinking.1: Chọpụta ịkpa oke sitere n'usoro ịhọrọ dịka azịza afọ ofufo
n-m-h3-est-03.thinking.2: Kpee ikpe ike nke ihe akaebe ma kọwaa ya
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nyocha nke kacha dị mma ịtụkwasị obi maka ịtụ atụmatụ nkezi oge ụmụ akwụkwọ niile na-amụ.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tụnyere ma n'ụzọ ọ bụla, nwa akwụkwọ ọ bụla n'ụlọ akwụkwọ nwere otu ohere ịbanye n'sample.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.hint.1: Chee, site n'ọmụmaatụ, ma "sample buru ibu" na "sample na-anọchite anya ụmụ akwụkwọ niile" pụtara otu ihe.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.o.a: B: n'ihi na a dọpụtara ya site n'ndetu site n'ọnụọgụ enweghị usoro, ya mere nwa akwụkwọ ọ bụla nwere otu ohere
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.o.b: A: n'ihi na sample nke 900 buru ibu karịa nke ukwuu, ya mere sample mean dị nso n'population mean
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ eziokwu na sample buru ibu na-ebelata mgbasa nke ohere kpatara. Ma ọ bụrụ na onye na-abanye n'sample gbagọrọ n'otu ụzọ, ịkpa oke ahụ anaghị ebelata site n'nha.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.o.c: Enweghị nke ọ bụla pụrụ iji: n'ihi na ụfọdụ ụmụ akwụkwọ naanị, ọ bụghị niile, ka a nyochara
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.r.c: Nyocha sample bụ, site n'nhazi, ụzọ itụ atụmatụ ihe niile site n'akụkụ. Ajụjụ bụ ma ụzọ e si ahọrọ akụkụ ahụ na-anọchite anya population.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.o.d: Jiri abụọ: naanị were nkezi abụọ 3.1 na 2.4
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.r.d: Ịgwakọta data nwere ịkpa oke na data ndị ọzọ na-ahapụ ịkpa oke ahụ. Ị ga-ebu ụzọ jụọ nke data na-anọchite anya population.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.explain: N'nyocha webụsaịtị, ụmụ akwụkwọ nwere mmasị ma ọ bụ nwere oge na-aza n'onwe ha, ya mere ohere ịhọrọ site n'population dị iche n'nwa akwụkwọ n'nwa akwụkwọ. Ụdị ịkpa oke ịhọrọ a anaghị apụ ọbụlagodi mgbe ọnụọgụ ndị zara na-abawanye. N'B, sample dị nta na 60, ya mere mgbasa kpatara site n'ohere buru ibu, ma a họrọ nwa akwụkwọ ọ bụla site n'otu ohere, ya mere sample mean na-agbasa gburugburu population mean, nke na-eme ya ntọala kacha dị mma ịtụkwasị obi maka atụmatụ ahụ.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.prompt: Ụzọ A nwere sample buru ibu karịa nke ukwuu nke 900, ma ọ siri ike ịtụkwasị nkezi ya nke awa 3.1 obi dịka atụmatụ nkezi maka ụmụ akwụkwọ niile. Kọwaa ihe mere, jikọtara ya na sample ịbawanye.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.hint.0: Chee otu ụmụ akwụkwọ ndị na-ahụ njikọ nyocha ma na-azaghị nwere ike isi dị iche n'ndị na-aza.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.hint.1: Chee ma ọdịiche ahụ na-ebelata ma ị mụbaa ndị zara site na 900 okpukpu abụọ.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.placeholder: dịka, A gụnyere naanị ụmụ akwụkwọ ..., ya mere ... ọbụlagodi mgbe sample na-abawanye ...
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ gosiri onye na-abanye n'sample n'A (usoro ịhọrọ)?
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru na ịkpa oke ahụ fọdụrụ ọbụlagodi mgbe sample na-abawanye?
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ jikọtara ya na ihe mere B ji bụrụ nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi (otu ohere)?
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.model.0: Nyocha webụsaịtị gụnyere naanị ụmụ akwụkwọ na-aza n'onwe ha, ya mere ụfọdụ ụmụ akwụkwọ, dịka ndị nwere mmasị nke ukwuu n'ịmụ akwụkwọ, nwere ike ịbụ ndị ọtụtụ. Ịkpa oke a anọgide otu ma ndị zara bụ 900 ma ọ bụ 9000, ya mere ọ siri ike ịtụkwasị obi ọbụlagodi na sample buru ibu.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.model.1: A bụ sample e mere site n'ndị zara n'afọ ofufo naanị, ya mere ọ naghị anọchite anya ụmụ akwụkwọ niile. Ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ ole dị n'sample, ọ bụrụ na ụzọ ịhọrọ gbagọrọ n'otu ụzọ, nkezi ahụ na-anọgide na-adịghị nso n'population mean.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ma "n'afọ ofufo" ma "anaghị anọchite anya" bụ okwu nwere ihe pụtara.

n-m-h3-conic-01.title: Ịlele ngwọta gbasara mpaghara triangle PF₁F₂
n-m-h3-conic-01.topic: Akụkụ conic: nkọwa na tangent nke parabola, ellipse na hyperbola; njikọ ọdịdị na nhata
n-m-h3-conic-01.goal: Ghọta na ọbụna ngwọta ngụkọ ya niile ziri ezi nwere ike ime ka nkwubi okwu ghara inwe isi ma a nyochaghị ma ọnọdụ nsogbu ahụ ọ̀ nwere ike ime. Chọta oke ebe ọnọdụ ahụ na-emezu.
n-m-h3-conic-01.material: Akwụkwọ mgbatị nwere nsogbu na azịza a: “Ka F₁ na F₂ bụrụ focus abụọ nke ellipse x²/25+y²/16=1. Maka isi P dị na ellipse ebe ∠F₁PF₂=90°, chọta mpaghara triangle PF₁F₂. (Azịza: 16)” Nke a bụ ngwọta nyere azịza ahụ.
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.0: Kewaa ma ahịrị ngwọta nke ọ bụla bụ ngụkọ ka ọ bụ nnabata ọnọdụ e nyere.
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.1: Nwale ma ọnọdụ e nyere nwere ike ime n’ezie site n’ịnwale ọnọdụ oke.
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.2: Chọta oke parameter ebe ọnọdụ ahụ na-emezu.
n-m-h3-conic-01.prereq.0: Nkọwa ellipse na nhazi focus ya
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.prompt: Ngụkọ dị n’ahịrị ngwọta dị n’okpuru ziri ezi. Ma azịza 16 siri ike ikwere. Họrọ ahịrị mbụ mere ka azịza ahụ sie ike ikwere.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kewaa ma ahịrị nke ọ bụla sitere na ngụkọ ahịrị bu ya ụzọ ma ọ bụ naanị nabata ọnọdụ sitere na nsogbu.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.hint.1: Jikọta nsonaazụ ahịrị nabatara ọnọdụ na nsonaazụ ahịrị ọzọ a chọtara mbụ, tinye ọnụọgụ hụ ma ha abụọ nwere ike ịdị n’otu oge.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.0: Maka ellipse x²/25+y²/16=1, a=5,b=4; ya mere c²=a²−b²=9,c=3, F₁(−3,0), F₂(3,0). (0 0 3 3)
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.1: Dịka nkọwa ellipse si dị, PF₁+PF₂=2a=10, F₁F₂=6.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.2: Ebe ∠F₁PF₂=90°, dịka iwu Pythagoras si dị PF₁²+PF₂²=F₁F₂²=36.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.3: Ebe (PF₁+PF₂)²=PF₁²+PF₂²+2·PF₁·PF₂, anyị nwetara 100=36+2·PF₁·PF₂, ya mere PF₁·PF₂=32.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụ ahịrị 3. Ahịrị a were “∠F₁PF₂=90°” nke nsogbu nyere dịka eziokwu, tọọ nhata. Ma ebe PF₁+PF₂=10 dịka ahịrị 2 si dị, PF₁²+PF₂² kacha nta mgbe ogologo abụọ hà nhata, ya mere ọ ga-abụkarịa ala 5²+5²=50. Ọ gaghị abụ 36; ya mere isi P dị otu a adịghị na ellipse. Ahịrị 4 na 5 bụ ngụkọ sochiri nsonaazụ ahịrị 3; ngụkọ ha ziri ezi, ma ha enweghị isi.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.prompt: Jiri ọnụọgụ ndị dị n’ngwọta kọwaa ihe mere ị gaghị atụkwasị azịza 16 obi. Dee kwa ihe ziri ezi a ga-ekwu maka nsogbu a.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.hint.0: Chee uru kacha nta PF₁²+PF₂² nwere ike ịbụ ma PF₁+PF₂ ka bụ 10.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.hint.1: See eserese ịkọ ebe ∠F₁PF₂ kacha ukwuu ka P na-agagharị na ellipse, tụọ atụmatụ akụkụ ahụ.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: I ji ọnụọgụ sitere n’ngwọta (36,10,50 wdg.) kpọmkwem n’ịkọwa gị? (10 36)
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: I kwuru nkwubi okwu dị ka “ọnọdụ ahụ agaghị emezu,” kama “ngụkọ ezighi ezi”?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: I ghọtara na a pụkwara iji eserese ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ oke (nsọtụ obere axis) lelee nke a?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ PF₁+PF₂=10, ngụkọta square kacha nta mgbe ogologo abụọ hà nhata; ya mere ọ dịkarịa ala 5²+5²=50. Ma ahịrị 3 kwuru 36, nke na-emegide ya. Isi P dị otu a adịghị; uru 16 enweghị isi.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.1: N’nsọtụ obere axis (0,4), PF₁=PF₂=5, F₁F₂=6; ya mere 25+25>36, nke pụtara akụkụ ∠F₁PF₂ dị ala karịa 90° ebe a. Akụkụ a kacha ukwuu n’ebe a n’ellipse, ya mere enweghị isi ebe ọ bụ 90°. A pụghị ịchọta mpaghara ahụ. (0 4)
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.2: Azịza 16 ezighi ezi. Ọ bụrụ ngụkọta bụ 10, ngụkọta square ga-abụkarịa ala 50, ma ọ bụ 36; ya mere ọnọdụ ahụ adabaghị. Isi dị otu a adịghị.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.3: 16 ezighi ezi. Ọ bụrụ ngụkọta ogologo abụọ bụ 10, ngụkọta square enweghị ike ịbụ 36; ya mere isi P dị otu a adịghị.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.prompt: Ugbu a gbanwee ellipse ka ọ bụrụ x²/25+y²/b²=1 (0<b<5). Chọta ma tinye uru b atọ dị iche iche nke isi P nwere ∠F₁PF₂=90° dị n’ellipse n’ezie.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.hint.0: Buru ụzọ lee etu anya n’etiti focus abụọ si agbanwe ka b na-ebuwanye.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.hint.1: Maka b nke ọ bụla, tụọ ma akụkụ n’isi ellipse ebe ∠F₁PF₂ kacha ukwuu ga-eru 90°.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.ok.c2: Maka b a, e nwere isi ellipse nwere ∠F₁PF₂=90°.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.fail.c2: Maka b a, ∠F₁PF₂ anaghị eru 90° n’ebe ọ bụla n’ellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.explain: Ka focus abụọ hụ isi P n’ellipse n’akụkụ 90°, ∠F₁PF₂ aghaghị ịdịkarịa ala 90° n’nsọtụ obere axis, ebe akụkụ ahụ kacha ukwuu. Nke a na-eme mgbe c≥b, ya bụ 25−b²≥b². Ya mere b²≤12.5, maka 0<b<5, isi P dị ma b dịkarịa ala ihe dịka 3.54. b=3.5 na-arụ ọrụ, 3.6 anaghị arụ ọrụ.

n-m-h3-conic-02.topic: Akụkụ conic: nkọwa na tangent nke parabola, ellipse na hyperbola; njikọ ọdịdị na nhata
n-m-h3-conic-02.title: Ozi ọzọ dị aṅaa ka anyị chọrọ iji chọpụta nhata hyperbola?
n-m-h3-conic-02.goal: Kpebie ma ozi ezuola iji chọpụta nhata curve site n’iji ọnụ ọgụgụ unknown tụnyere ọnụ ọgụgụ nhata independent.
n-m-h3-conic-02.material: Akwụkwọ mgbatị nwere nsogbu “Chọta nhata hyperbola x²/a²−y²/b²=1 (a>0,b>0) nwere focus (5,0), (−5,0).” Onye nkuzi kwuru, “Nsogbu a enweghị otu ọnọdụ.” Ị chọrọ mezue ya site n’itinye ọnọdụ efu ahụ. (0 0 5 5)
n-m-h3-conic-02.thinking.0: Gụọ nhata ozi e nyere na-emepụta.
n-m-h3-conic-02.thinking.1: Kewaa ihe a maralarị na ozi ọhụrụ.
n-m-h3-conic-02.thinking.2: Jiri ihe atụ na-agbagha gosi na ozi ezughị (curve ọzọ nwere otu focus).
n-m-h3-conic-02.prereq.0: Ụdị ọkọlọtọ x²/a²−y²/b²=1 nke hyperbola, ihe focus, vertex na asymptote pụtara
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ozi niile, mgbe agbakwunyere naanị na focus bụ (5,0), (−5,0), na-ekpebi a na b n’otu ụzọ. (a>0,b>0) (0 0 5 5)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.hint.0: Dee otu otu ma ozi nke ọ bụla na-enye nhata ọhụrụ jikọtara a na b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.hint.1: Buru ụzọ chọta nhata a maralarị n’etiti a na b mgbe focus naanị ka amara.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.o.b: Anya dị n’etiti focus abụọ bụ 10.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.b: Anyị amaralarị nke a site na nhazi focus (±5,0); ọ bụghị ozi ọhụrụ. A ka nwere naanị otu nhata a chọrọ n’etiti a na b. (0 5)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.o.d: Curve nwere symmetry n’akụkụ isi mmalite.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ eziokwu mgbe niile maka curve ụdị x²/a²−y²/b²=1; ọ bụghị ozi ọhụrụ gbasara a na b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.e: Itinye x=0 na-enye −y²/b²=1; ya mere hyperbola ụdị a anaghị ezute y-axis. Ọ bụghị ozi ọhụrụ gbasara a na b.
