n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.explain: Ozi focus na-enye naanị otu nhata, a²+b²=25. Vertex (3,0) na-enye a=3, ya mere b=4. Mkpọda asymptote 4/3 na-enye b/a=4/3, ya bụ a=3,b=4. Anya focus 10, symmetry mmalite, na ịghara izute y-axis bụ ihe amaralarị ma ọ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; ha anaghị agbakwunye nhata. (0 3)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.prompt: Mepụta hyperbola 2 nwere ụdị dị iche iche, focus ha bụ (5,0), (−5,0), ụdị ha bụ x²/a²−y²/b²=1; tinye (a,b). (Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ ntụpọ, jiri ebe ntụpọ abụọ.) (0 0 5 5)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tinye uru c n’ime nhata hyperbola jikọtara a,b,c.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.hint.1: Họrọ otu uru a mezuru nhata ahụ, lelee uru b ọ na-enye.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a na b ga-abụrịrị ndị dị mma.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Nke a bụ hyperbola focus ya bụ (±5,0). (0 5)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.explain: Ọ bụrụ focus ha bụ otu, c=5, ya mere a²+b²=25. Ọ bụghị naanị (3,4) na (4,3); ụzọ dịka (2, ihe dịka 4.58) nwekwara ike, ya mere e nwere hyperbola dị iche iche enweghị njedebe. (3 3 4 4)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Kọwaa ihe mere hyperbola dị iche iche ji apụta ọbụna ma focus hà nhata.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Gụọ nhata ole jikọtara a na b na unknown ole dị.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Gbakọọ a²+b² maka ụzọ abụọ nke ọ bụla i mepụtara, tụnyere ha.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: I kwuru na naanị otu nhata dị n’etiti a na b?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: I nyere ihe atụ abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa (a,b) mezuru nhata ahụ?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Ọ bụrụ focus bụ (±5,0), c=5; maka hyperbola, naanị otu nhata na-apụta: a²+b²=c²=25. Unknown abụọ bụ a na b; ya mere b na-agbanwe dabere n’otu esi họrọ a, curve dịkwa enweghị njedebe. (0 5)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.model.1: A gwara anyị naanị a²+b²=25; ya mere (3,4), (4,3) na ọtụtụ ndị ọzọ na-arụ ọrụ. Focus naanị anaghị ekpebi ya n’otu ụzọ. (3 3 4 4)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.prompt: Oge a họrọ usoro bara uru maka curve ndị ọzọ kwa, ọ bụghị naanị hyperbola. Mgbe ozi ọhụrụ bịara, olee ụzọ a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi iji kpebie ma ozi ahụ naanị ya na-ekpebi curve n’otu ụzọ?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.hint.0: Dee n’akụkụ ibe ha ọnụ ọgụgụ nhata sitere na ozi abụọ i ji ruo ugbu a na ọnụ ọgụgụ unknown.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.hint.1: Chee etu otu ozi ọhụrụ si agbanwe ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị ahụ.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.a: Kpebie site n’ịlele ma ozi ọhụrụ ahụ nwere ọnụọgụ akọwapụtara.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.a: Ọbụna ma e nwere ọnụọgụ, ha nwere ike ikwughachi ihe amaralarị (dịka anya focus). Inwe ọnụọgụ abụghị ụkpụrụ ikpebi.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.b: Lelee ma ọ na-enye otu nhata ọzọ gbasara a na b nke dị iche na ọnọdụ focus.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.c: Lelee ma a pụrụ ịdọrọ curve site na ozi ọhụrụ ahụ.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.c: Inwe ike ịdọrọ eserese apụtaghị na ọnụọgụ ekpebiela. Jiri nhata kpebie ma e kpebiela ha.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.d: Kpebie site n’ịlele ma e kwupụtara ozi ọhụrụ ahụ n’otu ụzọ ahụ dịka focus.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.d: Ụzọ e si kwupụta ihe enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na oke ozi. Ihe dị mkpa bụ nhata ọ na-agbakwunye.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.explain: Iji kpebie ya n’otu ụzọ, a chọrọ nhata independent ole hà nhata unknown. Focus nyere otu nhata, a na b bụ unknown abụọ; ya mere lelee ma ozi ọhụrụ na-enye otu nhata ọzọ dị iche na nke amaralarị. Ma ọbụna na nhata abụọ, azịza nwere ike ghara ịbụ otu; n’ikpeazụ dozie iji kwenye.

n-m-h3-conic-04.topic: Akụkụ conic: nkọwa na tangent nke parabola, ellipse na hyperbola; njikọ ọdịdị na nhata
n-m-h3-conic-04.title: Iwu tangent lines nke hyperbola n'onwe gị
n-m-h3-conic-04.goal: Wuo ọtụtụ tangent lines n'onwe gị, chọpụta na e nwere oke slopes nke tangent line dị, kọwaakwa nke a site n'iji discriminant.
n-m-h3-conic-04.material: E nwere hyperbola x²/4 − y²/9 = 1. Ị ga-amụta banyere ahịrị y = mx + k na-emetụ curve a site n'iwu ha n'onwe gị.
n-m-h3-conic-04.thinking.1: Iwu tangent lines n'onwe gị ma chọta ụkpụrụ
n-m-h3-conic-04.prereq.1: Mmekọrịta ọnọdụ n'etiti ahịrị na conic (nha na-eso ibe ha)
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.prompt: Wuo ahịrị 3 dị iche y = mx + k na-emetụ hyperbola x²/4 − y²/9 = 1 ma tinye (m, k). (Jiri decimals ruo ebe decimal atọ.)
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tinye nha nke ahịrị n'nha nke hyperbola ka e nweta nha n'x.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.hint.1: Chee ọnọdụ nha ahụ ga-anọ n'ime ya ka ahịrị emetụ curve n'otu ebe kpọmkwem.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.ok.c1: Itinye ahịrị na-enye nha quadratic n'x.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.fail.c1: Na slope a, itinye ahịrị anaghị enye nha quadratic.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.ok.c2: Nha quadratic nwere ọnụ okpukpu abụọ (tangent).
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.fail.c2: Ahịrị a anaghị emetụ hyperbola (discriminant abụghị 0).
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.explain: Itinye y=mx+k n'9x²−4y²=36 na-enye (9−4m²)x²−8mkx−4k²−36=0. Discriminant bụ 144(k²+9−4m²), ya mere maka tangency, k²=4m²−9. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na m=2.5, mgbe ahụ k²=16, ya mere k=±4.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.prompt: Chetakwa ahịrị ndị ị wuru na mbụ. Họrọ slopes niile nke ahịrị y = mx + k na-emetụ hyperbola a dị.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.hint.0: Dee ọnọdụ ka discriminant nke nha ị tọrọ na mbụ bụrụ 0 dịka nha n'k².
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.hint.1: Maka slope m ọ bụla, kpebie ma k² ga-abụ negative.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.r.a: Ahịrị kwụ ọtụtụ y=k ma na-agafe alaka hyperbola ọ bụla otu ugboro ma ọ bụ anaghị ezute ha abụọ. Ọ pụghị ịbụ tangent.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.r.d: Ọ dị ka ị chere na slope dị nta nwere tangent line. Ọ bụrụ na ị kpọgara usoro tangent nke ellipse k²=a²m²+b² n'enweghị mgbanwe, ị na-enweta k=±√13, ma ahịrị a na-ezute hyperbola n'ebe abụọ.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.explain: Maka tangency, a chọrọ k²=4m²−9≥0, ma wepụ ikpe yiri asymptote (slope ±3/2), 4m²>9, ya bụ, |m|>3/2. Slopes 2 na −3 na-arụ ọrụ; maka 0 na 1, k² bụ negative, ya mere ha anaghị arụ ọrụ.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.prompt: Ahịrị nwere slope 1 enweghị ike ịbụ tangent nye hyperbola a. Kọwaa ihe mere, ma kọwaakwa oke slopes m nke tangent line dị.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.hint.0: Tinye m=1 ma chọta k na-eme ka discriminant bụrụ 0.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.hint.1: Chọpụta oke m ga-anọ n'ime ya ka k² ghara ịbụ negative.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ kọwara ihe kpatara site n'iji discriminant (ma ọ bụ ihe ịrịba ama nke k²)?
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru na oke nke oke ahụ jikọtara na slope nke asymptotes?
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.model.0: Itinye y=x+k na-enye discriminant 144(k²+5), nke pụghị ịbụ 0. Ka ọ bụrụ tangent line, a chọrọ k²=4m²−9≥0, ya mere uru zuru ezu nke m ga-abụ ihe karịrị 3/2.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.model.1: Na slope 1, k²=−5, ya mere enweghị k real ma ya mere enweghị tangent line. Slopes maka tangent lines chọrọ 4m²−9 ka ọ bụrụ opekata mpe 0, ma ±1.5, nke yiri asymptotes, ga-ewepụ, ya mere |m|>1.5.

n-m-h3-conic-05.topic: Akụkụ conic: nkọwa na tangent nke parabola, ellipse na hyperbola; njikọ ọdịdị na nhata
n-m-h3-conic-05.title: Ọ bụrụ na k gbanwee, ụdị curve ọ̀ na-agbanwekwa?
n-m-h3-conic-05.goal: N'nha nke conic nwere mkpụrụedemede, chọta ma lelee ozugbo oge ebe ụdị ọdịdị na-agbanwe dabere n'ihe ịrịba ama nke denominators.
n-m-h3-conic-05.material: Maka k real, nyochaa otu ọdịdị nha x²/(9−k) + y²/(4−k) = 1 na-anọchi anya si agbanwe site na k. Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye k=2, ọ ghọrọ x²/7 + y²/2 = 1, nke bụ ellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-05.thinking.0: Ịgụ nhazi ihe ịrịba ama nke nha ahụ
n-m-h3-conic-05.thinking.2: Ịlele na nha ahụ nwere ike ịnọchite anya ọdịdị ọ bụla
n-m-h3-conic-05.prereq.0: Udi ọkọlọtọ nke ellipses na hyperbolas
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye k=6, ị na-enweta x²/3 + y²/(−2) = 1. Kedu ọdịdị nha a na-anọchi anya?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.hint.0: Degharịa okwu nwere denominator negative n'udi mwepu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tụnyere nha e degharịrị na udi ọkọlọtọ ma lelee nke okwu bụ positive.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.a: Ọ bụ ellipse, n'ihi na e dere nha dịka nchikota nke okwu abụọ.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.a: Ị hapụrụ na ihe ịrịba ama nke denominator nwere ike ịgbanwe mgbe ị tinye k. Ị lere naanị ọdịdị nke nha ahụ.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.b: Ọ bụ hyperbola nke transverse axis ya dị n'ntụziaka y-axis, n'ihi na negative dị n'akụkụ y².
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na denominator negative dị n'akụkụ y², okwu x² bụ positive, ya mere ọ na-emeghe n'ntụziaka x-axis. Lelee nke okwu bụ positive.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.c: Ọ bụ ọdịdị ọ bụla, n'ihi na otu denominator bụ negative.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na otu denominator bụ negative, nha na-aghọ mwepu. Ọ bụghị na enweghị ebe; ụdị curve na-agbanwe.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.d: Ọ bụ hyperbola, n'ihi na otu denominator na-aghọ negative ma nha na-ewere udi mwepu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.explain: y²/(−2) bụ −y²/2, ya mere nha bụ x²/3 − y²/2 = 1. Okwu x² bụ positive, ya mere ọ bụ hyperbola na-emeghe n'ntụziaka x-axis.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.prompt: Chọta ma tinye uru k dị iche atọ nke nha x²/(9−k) + y²/(4−k) = 1 na-aghọ hyperbola nke udi x²/A − y²/B = 1 (A>0, B>0).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.hint.0: Dee ihe ịrịba ama denominators abụọ ga-abụ ka nha ahụ were udi mwepu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.hint.1: Gbanwee ọnọdụ ihe ịrịba ama ahụ ka ọ bụrụ enweghị nha n'k ma chọta oke.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Denominator nke okwu x² bụ positive.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Denominator nke okwu x² abụghị positive.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Okwu y² anaghị agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ udi mwepu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.explain: Ọ bụrụ na denominator 9−k nke okwu x² bụ positive ma denominator 4−k nke okwu y² bụ negative, nha na-ewere udi x²/(9−k) − y²/(k−4) = 1. Ya bụ, k ọ bụla nwere 4<k<9 na-arụ ọrụ (k=4 na 9 anaghị arụ ọrụ n'ihi na denominator bụ 0).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Mgbe k=2 ọ bụ ellipse, ma mgbe k=6 ọ ghọrọ hyperbola. Kọwaa nke akụkụ nke nha gbanwere na otu o si gbanwee.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Dee ihe ịrịba ama denominators abụọ maka k=2 na maka k=6 ma tụnyere ha.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Chọta nke denominator gbanwere ihe ịrịba ama.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ tụnyere mgbanwe ihe ịrịba ama nke denominators abụọ na k=2 na k=6?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ chọpụtara kpọmkwem nke denominator gbanwere ihe ịrịba ama?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Mgbe k=2, denominators abụọ bụ 7 na 2, abụọ bụ positive, ya mere ọ nwere udi nchikota (ellipse). Mgbe k=6, denominator 4−k n'akụkụ y² ghọrọ −2, negative, ya mere nha na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ udi mwepu (hyperbola).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Mgbe k gafere 4, 4−k na-aghọ negative. Mgbe ahụ ihe ịrịba ama n'ihu okwu y² na-agbanwe, ya mere ellipse na-aghọ hyperbola. 9−k na-anọgide positive.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye k=10, nha ahụ ghọrọ x²/(−1) + y²/(−6) = 1. Kedu nkwupụta banyere ọdịdị nha a na-anọchi anya bụ nke ziri ezi?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.hint.0: Degharịa akụkụ aka ekpe site n'iwepụ denominators.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.hint.1: Tụnyere oke uru akụkụ aka ekpe nwere ike inwe na akụkụ aka nri, 1.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.a: Enweghị ebe (x, y) na-emezu nha a.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.b: Ọ bụ ellipse, n'ihi na ọbụlagodi denominators abụọ gbanwere, ọ ka bụ n'udi nchikota.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.b: Ọbụlagodi mgbe denominators abụọ bụ negative, ọ ka bụ n'udi nchikota, ma ị lelebeghị na akụkụ aka ekpe enweghị ike karịa 0, ya mere ọ pụghị hà 1 n'aka nri.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.c: Ọ bụ hyperbola na-emeghe n'ntụziaka x-axis, n'ihi na 9−k bụ negative.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.c: Denominators abụọ bụ negative, ya mere ọ bụghị n'udi mwepu. Lelee ihe ịrịba ama ọzọ.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.d: Ọ bụ gburugburu, n'ihi na okwu abụọ ahụ dị ka otu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.d: Denominators nwere uru dị iche, ya mere ọ pụghị ịbụ gburugburu, ị lelebeghịkwa ihe ịrịba ama.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.explain: Akụkụ aka ekpe bụ −x²−y²/6, nke bụ 0 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị. Ọ pụghị hà 1 n'aka nri, ya mere enweghị (x, y) real na-emezu nha a. Dabere ma denominators bụ positive ma ọ bụ negative, ọ na-ekewa ka ọ bụrụ ellipse, hyperbola, ma ọ bụ ọdịdị ọ bụla.

n-m-h3-conic-07.topic: Akụkụ conic: nkọwa na tangent nke parabola, ellipse na hyperbola; njikọ ọdịdị na nhata
n-m-h3-conic-07.title: Nchikota nke ụzọ abụọ site n'ebe dị na parabola
n-m-h3-conic-07.goal: Iji ọnọdụ ebe hụ na oke dị ala site n'triangle inequality abụghị mgbe niile uru a na-eru, ma chọta ọzọ minimum site n'ịkọwa parabola (ebe dị n'focus = ebe dị n'directrix).
n-m-h3-conic-07.material: Parabola y² = 8x nwere focus F(2, 0) na directrix x = −2. Seoyun na-ekwu, "Maka ebe P dị na curve na ebe A ọ bụla, minimum nke PA + PF bụ mgbe niile AF site n'triangle inequality."
n-m-h3-conic-07.thinking.0: Ịnyochaa ọnọdụ maka hà nhata n'enweghị nha
n-m-h3-conic-07.thinking.1: Idegharị n'udi dị iche site n'iji nkọwa
n-m-h3-conic-07.prereq.1: Enweghị nha triangle na ọnọdụ hà ya
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.prompt: Maka parabola y² = 8x nwere ebe lekwasị anya F(2, 0) na ntụpọ A(4, 2), i buuru ntụpọ P dị n'akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ ka ị chọta ihe kacha pere mpe nke PA+PF. Kedu uru na ihe kpatara kacha dabara?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.hint.0: Họrọ ọtụtụ ntụpọ P dị n'akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ, gbakọọ PA+PF ozugbo, ma mee tebụl.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.hint.1: Chetakwa nkọwa ma lelee ma ị nwere ike idegharị PF dị ka ogologo ọzọ maka ntụpọ dị n'parabola.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.a: 6, n'ihi na ọ hà ebe dị anya site na A ruo directrix.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.b: 2√2, n'ihi na PA+PF ≥ AF ma e nwere P nke hà dị.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.b: Hà n'enweghị nha triangle na-adị naanị mgbe P dị n'ahịrị AF. I lelighị ma P dị otú ahụ dị n'akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.c: 4, n'ihi na ọ hà nhazi x nke A.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.c: I lere naanị nhazi nke ntụpọ A. Enweghị nkọwa nke ogologo ole ka uru a bụ ngụkọta ha.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.d: 2+2√5, n'ihi na ọ bụ uru na vertex P=(0, 0).
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.d: I chọtara naanị uru na otu ntụpọ ma ị lelighị ma ọ bụ nke kacha pere mpe.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.explain: Maka ntụpọ dị n'parabola, PF hà ebe dị anya site na P ruo directrix x=−2. Ya mere PA+PF bụ ngụkọta nke PA na "ebe dị anya site na P ruo directrix," nke bụ opekata mpe 6, ebe dị anya site na A ruo directrix. Ọ hà 6 na ntụpọ dị n'akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ n'otu ịdị elu dịka A, dị ka P=(0.5, 2). 2√2 bụ AF, ma A na F abụọ dị n'ime akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ, ya mere ahịrị AF anaghị agafe akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ ma enweghị ike iru ya.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.prompt: Oge a họrọ ntụpọ A(x, y) nwere nhazi ọnụọgụ zuru ezu (−10 ruo 10), ma chọta ma tinye ntụpọ A atọ dị iche nke kacha pere mpe nke PA+PF hà AF mgbe P na-agagharị n'akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ kwuo ebe P ga-anọ ka hà n'enweghị nha triangle dị.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kewaa n'ọnọdụ ebe A nọ n'ime na n'èzí akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ, ma sere ma ahịrị AF zutere akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Ndị a bụ nhazi ọnụọgụ zuru ezu n'ime oke.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhazi ga-abụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na −10 ruo 10 gụnyere ha.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Ahịrị AF na-ezute akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ, ya mere e nwere P nke PA+PF=AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Maka ntụpọ a, enweghị P dị n'akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ nke hà AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.explain: PA+PF ≥ AF, ma hà na-adị naanị mgbe P dị n'ahịrị AF. F dị n'ime akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ, ya mere ọ bụrụ na A dị n'akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ ma ọ bụ n'èzí ya (y² ≥ 8x), ahịrị AF na-ezute akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ. Ọ bụrụ na A dị n'ime (y² < 8x), ahịrị anaghị ezute akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ, ya mere kacha pere mpe buru ibu karịa AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.prompt: Na A(4, 2), kacha pere mpe pụtara buru ibu karịa AF. Kọwaa ihe mere nkwupụta Seoyun "kacha pere mpe nke PA+PF bụ AF mgbe niile" ji ezighi ezi.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.hint.0: Kwuo ebe P ga-anọ ka hà dị n'enweghị nha Seoyun jiri.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.hint.1: Lelee ma ọnọdụ ahụ emezuru na A(4, 2) site n'iji ọnọdụ ahịrị AF na akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: I kwuru ọnọdụ hà nke enweghị nha triangle?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: I kwuru na nsonaazụ dị iche dabere n'ọnọdụ ntụpọ A (n'ime/n'èzí akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ)?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.model.0: PF hà ebe dị anya site na P ruo directrix, ya mere PA+PF bụ opekata mpe 6, ebe dị anya site na A ruo directrix. 6 a buru ibu nke ukwuu karịa AF=2√2. Nkwupụta Seoyun abụghị eziokwu mgbe niile, ebe e nwere ọnọdụ ebe AF bụ kacha pere mpe.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.model.1: Hà n'enweghị nha triangle PA+PF≥AF na-adị naanị mgbe P dị n'ahịrị AF. Ọ bụrụ na A na F abụọ dị n'ime akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ, ahịrị AF anaghị ezute akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ, ya mere enweghị P dị otú ahụ. Ya mere kacha pere mpe buru ibu karịa AF.

n-m-h3-diffc-05.title: Ọ bụrụ na ọrụ dị n'ime nwere akụkụ, ọrụ ejikọtara ọ̀ nwekwara?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.topic: Ịdị iche: ịdị iche nke ọrụ ejikọtara
n-m-h3-diffc-05.goal: Nwalee nkwupụta "ọ bụrụ na ọrụ dị n'ime enweghị ike ịdị iche, ọrụ ejikọtara enweghị ike ịdị iche" site n'ihe atụ, ma kwado ọnọdụ nke ọrụ ejikọtara na-ghọ nke nwere ike ịdị iche site n'ihe atụ ị mepụtara n'onwe gị.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.material: g(x)=|x| enweghị ike ịdị iche na x=0. (Mkpọda n'aka ekpe nke x=0 bụ −1, ma mkpọda n'aka nri bụ 1.) Minseo na-ekwu, "Ọ bụrụ na ọrụ dị n'ime g enweghị ike ịdị iche na x=0, mgbe ahụ maka ọrụ ọ bụla nwere ike ịdị iche f, ọrụ ejikọtara h(x)=f(g(x))=f(|x|) enweghị ike ịdị iche na x=0."
n-m-h3-diffc-05.thinking.0: Chọta ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta ahụ
n-m-h3-diffc-05.thinking.1: Mepụta ma lelee ihe atụ nke na-eju ọnọdụ afọ
n-m-h3-diffc-05.thinking.2: Kọwaa nsonaazụ n'ọnọdụ ebe enweghị ike iji iwu chain
n-m-h3-diffc-05.prereq.0: Ọrụ uru zuru oke |x| enweghị ike ịdị iche na x=0
n-m-h3-diffc-05.prereq.1: Nkọwa nke derivative (oke aka ekpe na aka nri)
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ f niile nke h(x)=f(|x|) na-aghọ nke nwere ike ịdị iche na x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.hint.0: Maka f ọ bụla, dee h(x)=f(|x|) ozugbo n'ihe gbasara |x|.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.hint.1: Nso x=0, jiri |x|=x maka x>0 na |x|=−x maka x<0 tụnyere udi nke h n'aka ekpe na aka nri.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.a: h(x)=x²+|x|, ma x² enweghị ike ịzobe akụkụ nke |x|. Maka f a, mkpọda na x=0 abụghị 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.b: h(x)=|x|³, ya mere mkpọda n'akụkụ abụọ nke x=0 na-abịaru 0 nso.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.c: h(x)=3|x|+2, ma udi akụkụ ahụ na-anọgide.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.e: h(x)=(|x|−1)²=x²−2|x|+1, ma n'ihi −2|x| ọ nwere akụkụ na x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.explain: Derivative aka nri nke h na x=0 bụ f′(0) ma derivative aka ekpe bụ −f′(0). Ka ha hà nhata, a chọrọ f′(0)=0. x³ na x²+3 nwere f′(0)=0, ya mere ha nwere ike ịdị iche, ma ndị ọzọ nwere f′(0) hà nhata 1, 3, na −2 n'usoro, ya mere ha nwere akụkụ.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.prompt: Ka f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx. Tinye atọ abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa dị iche (a, b, c) nke na-eme ka h(x)=f(|x|) nwee ike ịdị iche na x=0. Ebe a a na b abụghị 0, ma ha niile bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na −9 ruo 9 gụnyere.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.hint.0: Dee f(|x|) dị ka okwu ọtụtụ ma kewaa okwu ndị ebe |x| fọdụrụ dị ka ike ọ bụghị ụzọ na okwu ndị nwere ike ụzọ, ebe |x| na-apụ.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.hint.1: Chọta okwu nke na-ahapụ |x| dị ka o si dị ma na-enye akụkụ na x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Ọnụọgụ atọ niile bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu n'ime oke ahụ.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.fail.c1: a, b, na c ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na −9 ruo 9 gụnyere.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Mkpọda aka ekpe na aka nri na x=0 hà nhata.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụ nke x abụghị 0, h nwere akụkụ na x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.explain: N'h(x)=a|x|³+bx²+c|x|, a|x|³ na bx² nwere ike ịdị iche na x=0, ma c|x| nwere akụkụ ma ọ bụrụ c≠0. Ya mere c ga-abụrịrị 0. Ya bụ, f′(0)=c=0. (1, 2, 1) nwere c≠0, ya mere ọ nwere akụkụ; (0, 2, 0) na (1, 0, −2) nwere a=0 na b=0 n'usoro, ya mere ha na-agbaji ọnọdụ c2, ma nke ikpeazụ na-agbajikwa c3.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.prompt: Kọwaa na nkwupụta Minseo ezighị ezi site n'iji ihe atụ ndị dị n'elu, ma dee ọnọdụ f ga-eju ka f(|x|) nwee ike ịdị iche na x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.hint.0: Dọba n'akụkụ ibe ha f ndị nwere ike ịdị iche n'ọkwa gara aga na ndị na-adịghị, ma tụnyere mkpọda nke f na x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kwupụta mkpọda aka nri na mkpọda aka ekpe nke h na x=0 n'ihe gbasara mkpọda nke f.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.placeholder: dị ka Ọ bụrụ na f(x)=x²+3, mgbe ahụ ...
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị nyere otu f kpọmkwem ma gosi na h(x) nwere ike ịdị iche na x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị kwuru ka mkpọda aka ekpe na mkpọda aka nri si aghọ hà nhata?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na f(x)=x²+3, mgbe ahụ h(x)=x²+3, nke nwere ike ịdị iche na x=0. Ọbụna ma |x| nwere akụkụ, ọrụ ejikọtara enweghị. Mkpọda aka nri nke h bụ f′(0) ma mkpọda aka ekpe bụ −f′(0), ya mere ọ bụrụ f′(0)=0 mkpọda abụọ ahụ hà nhata ma ọ nwere ike ịdị iche. Ya mere nkwupụta Minseo ezighị ezi.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.model.1: Ihe atụ megidere bụ f(x)=x³. h(x)=|x|³ nwere mkpọda 0 na x=0. N'izugbe, ọ bụrụ f′(0)=0, derivative aka ekpe na aka nri bụ 0 na 0, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịdị iche, ma ọ bụrụ f′(0) abụghị 0, ọ nwere akụkụ.

n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.prompt: A na-ekpughe ozi otu mpempe n'otu oge. Na nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, họrọ mkpebi dabere naanị n'ihe ị maara ruo ugbu a.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.title: Gịnị na-eme ma ọ bụrụ na mkpọda bụ 0 ma ọnụọgụ ntụgharị bụkwa 0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.topic: Ịdị iche: ịkọwa eserese, uru oke, na derivative nke abụọ
n-m-h3-diffc-04.goal: Ka a na-agbakwunye ozi otu otu, gbanwee ikpe gbasara uru oke, ma ghọta na mgbe uru nke derivative nke abụọ bụ 0, ị ga-elele ozugbo mgbanwe akara nke derivative.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.material: Ọrụ polynomial f na-eju f′(0)=0 na x=0. Oge ọ bụla a na-ekpughe otu ozi, lelee ikpe gị gbasara udi eserese nwere na x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.thinking.0: Gbanwee ikpe gị dabere n'ozi ọhụrụ
n-m-h3-diffc-04.thinking.1: Chọpụta ikpe ebe nnwale anaghị arụ ọrụ
n-m-h3-diffc-04.thinking.2: Lelee uru oke site na mgbanwe akara nke derivative
n-m-h3-diffc-04.prereq.0: Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti uru oke na mgbanwe akara nke derivative
n-m-h3-diffc-04.prereq.1: Derivative nke abụọ na concavity nke eserese
n-m-h3-diffc-04.prereq.2: Ihe isi ebe mgbanwe (isi ebe ebe concavity na-agbanwe) pụtara
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.hint.0: Oge ọ bụla ozi ọhụrụ pụtara, kpebie nnwale nke a na-eji ya maka ya na ma ọnọdụ ziri ezi ka nnwale ahụ nye nkwubi okwu.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tụnyere ma eziokwu na f′ na f″ nke ọ bụla bụ 0 na-ekwu otu ihe dị ka akara dị n'aka ekpe na aka nri nke isi ebe ahụ.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.info: f′(0)=0. (Na x=0, ahịrị tangent kwekọrọ n'ahịrị x.)
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Anyị nwere ike ikwu na f nwere uru oke na x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.after: f′(x)=0 na-agwa gị naanị onye a na-atụ aro maka uru oke. Ị chọrọ ịmara karịa banyere akara nke f′ tupu na mgbe x=0, ma ọ bụ akara nke f″.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ọ bụ obere uru mpaghara: ọ bụrụ na ahịrị tangent kwụ ọtọ, eserese na-ezute ya site n'okpuru
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: I weere isi ebe ọ bụla nwere ahịrị tangent kwụ ọtọ dị ka obere uru mpaghara. Ahịrị tangent kwụ ọtọ nwere ike ịdị na oke uru mpaghara, obere uru mpaghara, ma ọ bụ isi ebe mgbanwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ọ bụ oke uru mpaghara: ọ bụrụ na ahịrị tangent kwụ ọtọ, ọ bụ elu nke eserese
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: I weere isi ebe ọ bụla nwere ahịrị tangent kwụ ọtọ dị ka oke uru mpaghara.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Anyị amabeghị ya: ọ nwere ike ịbụ uru oke ma ọ bụ ọ bụghị, ya mere anyị chọrọ ịmara karịa
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: I chere na ahịrị tangent kwụ ọtọ naanị enweghị ike ịkọwa na ọ bụ uru oke.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ịhụ ozi a, gịnị bụ ikpe gị ugbu a?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Nnwale na f″(0)>0 na-enye obere uru mpaghara ma f″(0)<0 na-enye oke uru mpaghara anaghị agwa gị ihe ọ bụla mgbe f″(0)=0. f(x)=x⁴, −x⁴, na x³ niile nwere f′(0)=f″(0)=0, mana udi ha dị iche.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ọ bụghị uru oke: ọ bụrụ na f″(0) bụ 0, ọ bụghị uru oke
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: I gụrụ f″(0)=0 dị ka ihe àmà na ọ bụghị uru oke. Ihe naanị ọ pụtara bụ na nnwale "derivative nke abụọ dị mma pụtara obere uru mpaghara, nke na-adịghị mma pụtara oke uru mpaghara" enweghị ike iji.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Enweghị ike ikpebi site n'ozi a: nnwale na-eji derivative nke abụọ na-akwụsị ịrụ ọrụ
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: I chọpụtara na ọ bụrụ f″(0)=0, enweghị ike iji f″ kpebie ma ọ bụ oke ma ọ bụ obere uru mpaghara.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ọ bụ obere uru mpaghara: mkpọda bụ 0 ma ntụgharị bụ 0, ya mere ọ bụ nke kacha ruo ala
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: I kwuru obere uru mpaghara site n'echiche nke ịbụ "ala." Isi ebe ruru ala abụghị isi ebe dị ala mgbe niile.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: N'ikpeazụ, gịnị bụ udi f na x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.after: f′(x)=4x³ na-adịghị mma maka x<0 ma dị mma maka x>0, ya mere f nwere obere uru mpaghara na x=0. Chekwa, f″(x)=12x²≥0, ya mere concavity anaghị agbanwe, ma ọ bụghị isi ebe mgbanwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ọ nwere obere uru mpaghara, ma isi ebe a abụghị isi ebe mgbanwe
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: I gụrụ ọnụ na akara nke f′ na-agbanwe site na nke na-adịghị mma ruo nke dị mma na f″ dị opekata mpe 0 ma anaghị agbanwe akara.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ọ nweghị uru oke, ma isi ebe a bụ isi ebe mgbanwe
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: I kpebiri na ọ bụ isi ebe mgbanwe naanị n'ihi f″(0)=0. Ka ọ bụrụ isi ebe mgbanwe, akara nke f″ ga-agbanwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ọ nwere obere uru mpaghara, ma isi ebe a bụkwa isi ebe mgbanwe
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: I chere na f″(0)=0 pụtara isi ebe mgbanwe. f″(x)=12x² dị opekata mpe 0, ya mere akara ya anaghị agbanwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.reflect: Na mbụ, f′(0)=0 naanị mere ka ọ dị ka uru oke, ma mgbe f″(0)=0 pụtara, nnwale kwụsịrị ịrụ ọrụ. Ọbụna ya, ị nwere ike iru nkwubi okwu site n'ilele ozugbo ma akara nke f′ na-agbanwe. Uru ịbụ 0 dị iche na akara ịgbanwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.prompt: Họrọ ọrụ nwere f′(0)=0 na f″(0)=0 nke na-enweghị uru oke na x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.hint.0: Chọta derivative nke ọrụ ọ bụla ma tụnyere akara ya n'aka ekpe na aka nri nke x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kewaa ha n'ọrụ ebe akara nke f′ na-agbanwe na ọrụ ebe ọ naghị agbanwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.a: x⁴ nwere f′(0)=f″(0)=0 mana nwere obere uru mpaghara na x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.b: −x⁶ nwere f′(0)=f″(0)=0 mana nwere oke uru mpaghara na x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.c: x⁶ nwekwara obere uru mpaghara na x=0. Lee ma onye na-ebuli ike bụ ọnụọgụ ụzọ.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.d: Maka x³, f′(x)=3x² anaghị agbanwe akara, ya mere enweghị uru oke.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.explain: Maka x³, f′(x)=3x²≥0, ya mere f′ nwere otu akara tupu na mgbe x=0, ma enweghị uru oke. Maka ọrụ atọ ndị ọzọ, akara nke f′ na-agbanwe, ya mere ha nwere uru oke. Nke a pụtara na f′(0)=f″(0)=0 naanị enweghị ike ịgwa ikpe ọ bụ.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.prompt: Mgbe f′(0)=0 na f″(0)=0, dee ihe ị ga-elele, na otu esi eme ya, iji kpebie ma e nwere uru oke na x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.hint.0: Dee ka ọ dị ka ikwu na e nwere uru oke n'ihe gbasara akara nke f′.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.hint.1: Dee iche usoro nke enweghị ike iji ọzọ mgbe f″(0)=0 na usoro nke ka enwere ike iji.

n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị dere na ị tụnyere akara nke f′ n'aka ekpe na aka nri nke x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị kwuru na f″(0)=0 apụtaghị na enweghị uru oke?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.model.0: Ọ bụrụ f″(0)=0, derivative nke abụọ enweghị ike ịgwa gị ma ọ bụ oke ma ọ bụ obere uru mpaghara. Ya mere ị ga-elele ozugbo ma akara nke f′ na-agbanwe n'aka ekpe na aka nri nke x=0. Ọ bụrụ na ọ gbanwere, e nwere uru oke, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ gbanwebeghị, ọ dịghị.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na uru derivative nke abụọ bụ 0, nnwale na-akwụsị ịrụ ọrụ, ya mere sere chaatị akara nke f′(x). Ọ bụrụ na f′ na-agbanwe site na nke na-adịghị mma ruo nke dị mma (obere uru) ma ọ bụ site na nke dị mma ruo nke na-adịghị mma (oke uru) gburugburu 0, ọ bụ uru oke, ma ọ bụrụ na akara na-anọgide otu, ọ bụghị.

n-m-h3-diffc-08.title: Tangent line ọ̀ na-ezute akụkụ ahụ naanị n'ebe mmetụ?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.ok.c1: a na b bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu n'ime oke.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.topic: Ịdị iche: nha nke tangent lines, tangent lines nke cubic curves
n-m-h3-diffc-08.goal: Wuo ọmụmaatụ nke gị nke tangent line nke cubic curve na-ezutekwa curve ahụ n'ebe ọzọ karịa ebe mmetụ, ma kewaa ebe mmetụ ebe nke a na-eme na ebe ọ naghị eme.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.material: Tangent line nke curve y=x³−3x n'ebe A(1, −2) bụ y=−2. Maka eserese nke quadratic function, ị hụrụ na tangent line na-ezute curve naanị n'otu ebe mmetụ. Nke ahụ ọ̀ bụkwa eziokwu maka curve a?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.thinking.1: Wuo ọmụmaatụ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ n'onwe gị
n-m-h3-diffc-08.thinking.2: Chọta ebe mmetụ ndị bụ ihe dị iche
n-m-h3-diffc-08.prereq.1: Ime factor nke cubic equations (ọnụ okpukpu abụọ)
n-m-h3-diffc-08.prereq.2: Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ọnụ na coefficients
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na ị chọta x-coordinates niile nke ebe tangent line y=−2 na-ezute curve y=x³−3x, gịnị ka ị na-enweta?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ebe tangent line na curve na-ezute bụ ngwọta nke nha na-eme nkwupụta abụọ ahụ hà nhata. Tọọ nha ahụ.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.hint.1: Jiri eziokwu na x=1 bụ ngwọta mee factor nke akụkụ aka ekpe.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.a: Ị chere na ebe ọ bụ tangent line, ọ na-ezute curve naanị n'ebe mmetụ. Dozie nha x³−3x=−2 ozugbo.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.b: Ị lere x=1 na −1 dịka ụzọ. Tinye x=−1 n'nha ka ị lelee.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ nsonaazụ nke ime factor x³−3x+2=0 dịka (x−1)²(x+2)=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.d: Ị hapụrụ ọnụ okpukpu abụọ x=1. x=1 bụ ebe mmetụ, ya mere ọ dị na tangent line.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.explain: x³−3x+2=(x−1)²(x+2), ya mere ngwọta bụ x=1 (ọnụ okpukpu abụọ, ebe mmetụ) na x=−2. N'ebe (−2, −2), tangent line na-ezutekwa curve ahụ ọzọ.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.prompt: Tinye ụzọ dị iche abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa (a, b) ka tangent line nke curve y=x³−3x n'ebe (a, a³−3a) na-ezutekwa curve n'ebe (b, b³−3b) ọ bụghị ebe mmetụ. (a na b bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na −6 ruo 6 gụnyere ha, ma b≠a)
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.hint.0: Họrọ uru maka x-coordinate a nke ebe mmetụ, chọta nha nke tangent line, ma dee nha e nwetara site n'ime ya hà curve.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.hint.1: Jiri ngwọta ị maralarị n'nha ahụ (ebe mmetụ) chọta ngwọta fọdụrụ.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.var.b: x-coordinate b nke ebe ọ na-ezute ọzọ
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.fail.c1: a na b ga-abụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na −6 ruo 6 gụnyere ha.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Ọ bụ ebe dị iche na ebe mmetụ.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.ok.c3: Ebe (b, b³−3b) dị na tangent line.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Ebe (b, b³−3b) adịghị na tangent line.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.explain: Ime nha nke tangent line n'ebe (a, a³−3a) hà curve na-enye (x−a)²(x+2a)=0, ya mere x-coordinate nke ebe ọ na-ezute ọzọ bụ b=−2a. (1, −2), (2, −4), na (−3, 6) bụ ọmụmaatụ; (1, 1) bụ ebe mmetụ n'onwe ya, (1, −1) abụghịkwa ebe dị na tangent line.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.prompt: Ilele ụzọ (a, b) ị chọtara, dee mmekọrịta na-egosi b n'okwu a, kọwaakwa ihe mere mmekọrịta ahụ ji ejide.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tinye uru a na b nke ọmụmaatụ gị n'akụkụ n'akụkụ n'tebụl ma tụnyere okpukpu ole nke a b bụ.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.hint.1: Chee na nha jikọtara bụ cubic na ụdị ọnụ x=a bụ (ọnụ otu ma ọ bụ ọnụ okpukpu abụọ), ma dee ọnụ atọ ahụ.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.placeholder: dịka, Ime tangent line hà curve na-enye ...
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ jiri eziokwu na cubic equation e mere site na tangent line na curve nwere ọnụ okpukpu abụọ n'ebe mmetụ?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ chọtara b site n'iji eziokwu na nchikota nke ọnụ atọ bụ 0, ma ọ bụ site n'ime factor?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.model.0: b=−2a. Ime tangent line hà curve na-enye cubic equation nke udi x³−3x=m(x−a)+a³−3a, ebe mmetụ x=a bụkwa ọnụ okpukpu abụọ, ya mere a pụrụ ide ya dịka (x−a)²(x−b). Coefficient nke x² bụ 0, ya mere nchikota nke ọnụ atọ bụ a+a+b=0, na-enye b=−2a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.model.1: Elele m na ọ na-aghọ (x−a)²(x+2a)=0. Ebe mmetụ bụ ọnụ okpukpu abụọ, ya mere e nwere factor (x−a)², ọ dịghịkwa okwu x², ya mere ọnụ fọdụrụ bụ −2a, ya bụ, b=−2a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.prompt: N'etiti ebe dị na curve y=x³−3x, maka x-coordinate kedu ka tangent line n'ebe ahụ anaghị ezute curve n'ebe ọ bụla ọzọ karịa ebe mmetụ?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.hint.0: Jiri mmekọrịta ị chọtara n'nzọụkwụ gara aga, chọta x-coordinate nke ebe ọ na-ezute ọzọ maka ebe mmetụ n'nhọrọ ọ bụla.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.hint.1: Chee ihe na-eme mgbe ebe ọ na-ezute ọzọ na-aghọ otu na ebe mmetụ.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na a=−1, tangent line na-ezutekwa curve ọzọ na x=2.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.b: Ị tụlere ikpe ebe x-coordinate nke ebe ọ na-ezute ọzọ na-aghọ otu na ebe mmetụ.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na a=1, tangent line na-ezutekwa curve ọzọ na x=−2.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na a=2, tangent line na-ezutekwa curve ọzọ na x=−4.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.explain: X-coordinate nke ebe ọ na-ezute ọzọ bụ −2a, ya mere nke a hà ebe mmetụ naanị mgbe −2a=a, ya bụ, a=0. Tangent line y=−3x na-ezute curve n'otu ebe x=0, site na x³=0. Ebe a bụkwa ebe inflection nke curve ahụ.

n-m-h3-diffc-06.prereq.0: Akara derivative na ịrị elu/ịda ala nke ọrụ
n-m-h3-diffc-06.title: Kedu ka ị ga-esi gwa nwa akwụkwọ dị obere ihe ọ pụtara mgbe derivative nke abụọ dị mma?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.topic: Ịdị iche: ịkọwa eserese, derivative nke abụọ na convexity
n-m-h3-diffc-06.goal: Chọta ahịrịokwu ezighị ezi n'nkọwa nwa akwụkwọ ka okenye, lelee ya site n'ihe atụ megidere, ma dee ya ọzọ dị ka ahịrịokwu ziri ezi nke nwa akwụkwọ dị obere nwere ike ịghọta.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.material: Nwa akwụkwọ dị obere gị Haeun jụrụ, "Ọ bụrụ na f″(x)>0, eserese ọ̀ na-arị elu ka ọ na-aga n'aka nri?" Nwa akwụkwọ okenye gị Jihu zara dị ka e dere n'okpuru. Lelee ihe a dere ma dee ya ọzọ ka Haeun nwee ike ịghọta. (f″ bụ derivative nke derivative nke f.)
n-m-h3-diffc-06.thinking.0: Chọta ahịrịokwu ezighị ezi n'nkọwa ahụ
n-m-h3-diffc-06.thinking.2: Dee ya ọzọ ka ọ dabara onye na-ege ntị
n-m-h3-diffc-06.prereq.1: Derivative nke abụọ bụ derivative nke derivative
n-m-h3-diffc-06.prereq.2: Ihe convex ala (concave up) na convex elu (concave down) pụtara
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ otu ahịrịokwu ezighị ezi n'azịza Jihu.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.hint.0: Soro otu ahịrịokwu ọ bụla si aga n'ihu site n'nke gara aga, otu otu.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.hint.1: Chee echiche akara nke ọrụ ole ka ị chọrọ ịmara iji kwuo "uru ahụ na-abawanye."
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.line.0: Ọ bụrụ na f″(x)>0, derivative f′(x) na-abawanye.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.line.1: f′(x) na-abawanye pụtara na mkpọda nke ahịrị tangent na-aga n'ihu na-abawanye.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.line.2: Ya mere n'etiti ebe f″(x)>0, uru nke f(x) na-abawanyekwa ka ị na-aga n'aka nri.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.line.3: N'ikpe a eserese bụ convex ala.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.explain: Ahịrịokwu 3 ezighị ezi. Akara nke f′(x) na-ekpebi ma uru nke f(x) na-abawanye ma ọ bụ na-ebelata. f″>0 naanị na-agwa gị na f′ na-abawanye, ya mere n'etiti ebe f′ na-adịghị mma, f(x) nwere ike ịbụ na-ebelata ma ka nwee f″>0.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.prompt: Kedu ọrụ na etiti na-egosi nke kachasị doo anya na ahịrịokwu 3 ezighị ezi?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ihe atụ megidere bụ ikpe ebe "ọnọdụ mbụ bụ eziokwu mana nkwubi okwu bụ ụgha." Maka ọrụ ọ bụla, lelee iche akara nke f″ na ma f na-abawanye.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.hint.1: Maka nhọrọ ọ bụla, chọtakwa ihe ịrịba ama nke f′.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.a: N'oge a f″=2>0 ma f na-abawanye, ya mere ọ naghị emegide nkebi ahịrịokwu 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.b: f″=2>0 ma f′=2x<0, ya mere f na-ebelata. Nke a bụ ọmụmaatụ na-emegide nkebi ahịrịokwu 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.c: f″=−2<0, ya mere ọ bụghị ikpe nke f″>0.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.d: f″=6x>0 ma f na-abawanye, ya mere ọ naghị emegide nkebi ahịrịokwu 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.explain: Maka f(x)=x² na x<0, f″(x)=2>0 ma f′(x)=2x<0, ya mere f(x) na-ebelata. Eserese ahụ bụ convex n'ala ma na-agbada ugwu.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.prompt: Degharịa nkebi ahịrịokwu 3 ka Haeun nwee ike ịghọta ya. Ọ ga-agụnye ihe f″(x)>0 na-agwa gị, na ihe na-ekpebi ma f(x) na-abawanye ma ọ bụ na-ebelata.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.hint.0: Dee n'kọlụm abụọ ihe f″>0 na-agwa gị na ihe ọ naghị agwa gị.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.hint.1: Lelee ihe atụ megidere nke nzọụkwụ gara aga ma lelee ma uru na-ekpebi "ịrị elu ma ọ bụ ịda" bụ ihe ịrịba ama nke f, f′, ma ọ bụ f″.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.placeholder: dịka, Ọ bụrụ na f″(x)>0, mgbe ahụ ... ma ma f na-abawanye ...
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ kọwara ihe f″>0 na-agwa gị n'okwu slope ma ọ bụ convexity?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ dere na ihe ịrịba ama nke f′ na-ekpebi ịbawanye na ibelata?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ nyere ọmụmaatụ ka Haeun nwee ike soro naanị site n'ilele akara?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na f″(x)>0, slope nke tangent line na-aga n'ihu na-adị ukwuu ma eserese bụ convex n'ala. Ma ma f(x) na-abawanye ma ọ bụ na-ebelata na-ekpebi site n'ihe ịrịba ama nke f′(x). Dịka ọmụmaatụ, f(x)=x² nwere f″=2>0 maka x<0, ma f′=2x<0, ya mere ọ na-ebelata.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.model.1: f″>0 pụtara na f′ na-abawanye, ya bụ, slope na-adị ukwuu. Ma ọ na-arị elu n'aka nri na-ekpebi site na ma slope bụ positive, ya bụ, ma f′>0. Ọ bụrụ na slope bụ negative ma na-adị ukwuu, ọ na-agbada ma ka nwee f″>0.

n-m-h3-prob-04.thinking.1: Iwu ọtụtụ ihe atụ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ
n-m-h3-prob-04.topic: Probability: conditional probability, ịnọ onwe na ịdabere, echiche udi Bayesian, ịtọ sample space
n-m-h3-prob-04.title: Yiri ugogbe anya na isonye n’otu klọb: ime tebụl njirimara na-enweghị njikọ
n-m-h3-prob-04.goal: Mepụta ọtụtụ tebụl 2×2 ebe ihe omume abụọ nọọrọ onwe ha, lelee etu a ga-esi gụọ independence dịka “ọnụego dị n’ìgwè hà nhata.”
n-m-h3-prob-04.material: Ị ga-eme tebụl gụrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ 60 nke klaasị dịka “ma ha na-eyi ugogbe” na “ma ha sonyere klọb.”
n-m-h3-prob-04.thinking.0: Ịgbanwe ihe independence pụtara ka ọ bụrụ tebụl
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.prompt: Ụmụ akwụkwọ 60 nke klaasị kewara dịka “na-eyi ugogbe” na “sonyere klọb.” Kedu nkwupụta kacha akọwa ihe independence nke njirimara abụọ a pụtara?
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.hint.0: Chee ma n’etiti naanị ndị na-eyi ugogbe, akụkụ sonyere òtù hà nhata akụkụ sonyere n’ụmụ akwụkwọ niile.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ọ bụrụ na ha nọọrọ onwe ha, “ịma ma nwa akwụkwọ na-eyi ugogbe anaghị agbanwe probability o sonyere.” Tụlee ma nhọrọ ọ bụla kwuru nke a.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.a: Ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị na-eyi ugogbe hà nhata ndị na-eyighị.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.r.a: I gụrụ nke a dịka nha ìgwè ha hà nhata. Independence na-ekwu maka ọnụego n’ime ìgwè, ọ bụghị nha ìgwè.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.b: Ọnụọgụ ndị otu n’etiti ndị na-eyi ugogbe hà nhata ndị na-eyighị.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.r.b: I tụnyere ọnụ ọgụgụ isi. Ọ bụrụ ìgwè abụọ nwere nha dị iche, ọnụego nwere ike ịdị iche ọbụna ma ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ hà nhata.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.c: Akụkụ ndị otu n’etiti ndị na-eyi ugogbe hà nhata nke ndị na-eyighị.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.d: Ụmụ akwụkwọ niile na-eyi ugogbe sonyere, ndị na-eyighịkwa esonyeghị.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.r.d: I were njirimara abụọ na-apụta ọnụ mgbe niile dịka ndị nọọrọ onwe ha. Nke a bụ dependence kachasị sie ike: ịmara otu na-ekpebi nke ọzọ.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na akụkụ sonyere n’etiti ndị na-eyi ugogbe hà nhata nke ndị na-eyighị, ịma ma mmadụ na-eyi ugogbe anaghị agbanwe probability isonye. Ya bụ P(sonyere|ugogbe)=P(sonyere), nke pụtara otu ihe dịka P(ugogbe∩sonyere)=P(ugogbe)P(sonyere).
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.prompt: Mee tebụl maka ụmụ akwụkwọ 60. Ka a bụrụ ndị na-eyi ugogbe sonyere, b ndị na-eyi ma esonyeghị, c ndị na-eyighị sonyere, d ndị na-eyighị esonye. Ọnụọgụ anọ niile ga-abụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dịkarịa ala 1, ngụkọta 60, ugogbe na isonye nọọrọ onwe ha, ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị na-eyi ugogbe ga-adị iche na nke ndị otu. Tinye tebụl 3 dị iche.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ kpebie ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị na-eyi ugogbe x na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị otu y. Ọ bụrụ na ha nọọrọ onwe ha, ọnụ ọgụgụ a nke ndị na-eyi ugogbe sonyere ga-abụ x×y÷60.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.hint.1: Họrọ x na y nke ga-eme ka a bụrụ integer, mejupụta b,c,d ka ngụkọta bụrụ 60, lelee na ọnụego isonye nke ìgwè abụọ ahụ hà nhata.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Ọnụọgụ anọ niile bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dịkarịa ala 1.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a,b,c,d niile ga-abụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dịkarịa ala 1.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Ugogbe na isonye nọọrọ onwe ha (P(ugogbe∩sonyere)=P(ugogbe)P(sonyere)).
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Ha anọghị onwe ha. Tụnyere ọnụego isonye nke ndị na-eyi ugogbe na ndị na-eyighị.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.ok.c4: Ọnụọgụ ndị na-eyi ugogbe dị iche na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị otu.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.fail.c4: Ọnụọgụ ndị na-eyi ugogbe hà nhata ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị otu.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.explain: (10,10,20,20): n’ime mmadụ 20 nwere ugogbe, 10 sonyere (1/2); n’ime mmadụ 40 enweghị, 20 sonyere (1/2), ọnụego hà nhata. Na (5,15,10,30), ìgwè abụọ nwere ọnụego 1/4; na (12,18,12,18) ha abụọ bụ 2/5. Na (10,10,10,30), ọnụego bụ 1/2 maka ndị nwere ugogbe, 1/4 maka ndị na-enweghị; ha anọghị onwe ha. (15,15,15,15) nọọrọ onwe ha, ma ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị na-eyi ugogbe hà nhata ndị otu, ya mere ọ naghị emezu ọnọdụ 4.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Họrọ otu tebụl gị, chọta ma dee ọnụego isonye n’etiti ndị na-eyi ugogbe na ndị na-eyighị, kọwaa ihe mere nke a ji bụrụ ihe akaebe independence.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: N’ime tebụl i họọrọ, buru ụzọ dee ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị nwere ugogbe na ndị na-enweghị, kewaa ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị otu nke ìgwè ọ bụla site na nha ya.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Dee ọnụego abụọ ahụ n’akụkụ ibe ha, lelee ma hà nhata, jikọta ya na ihe independence pụtara.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.placeholder: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, n’etiti ndị na-eyi ugogbe, ọnụego isonye bụ ...
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Maka ìgwè abụọ ahụ, ị chọtara ọnụego site n’ịkewa ndị otu na ọnụ ọgụgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ ìgwè ahụ?
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: I jikọtara ọnụego hà nhata na echiche na iyi ugogbe anaghị agbanwe probability isonye?
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.model.0: N’ime mmadụ 20 nwere ugogbe, 10 sonyere, ọnụego 1/2; n’ime mmadụ 40 na-enweghị ugogbe, 20 sonyere, nke bụkwa 1/2. Ebe ọnụego abụọ ahụ hà nhata, ịma ma nwa akwụkwọ na-eyi ugogbe anaghị agbanwe probability isonye; ya mere ha nọọrọ onwe ha.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Ìgwè nwere ugogbe na nke na-enweghị ha abụọ nwere ọnụego isonye 50%. Ya mere iyi ugogbe enweghị mmetụta n’ohere isonye, nke pụtara na ha nọọrọ onwe ha.

n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ ezighi ezi na ngwọta Seoyeon.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.title: Second derivative nke curve e nyere site na parameter
n-m-h3-diffc-07.topic: Ịdị iche: second derivative nke function e nyere site na parameter
n-m-h3-diffc-07.goal: Maka curve e nyere site na parameter, chọta ma dozie njehie n'ngwọta na-eme dy/dx ka ọ dị iche ọzọ, họrọkwa usoro ziri ezi.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta Seoyeon maka ịchọta second derivative d²y/dx² na t=2 n'curve x=t², y=t³−3t (t>0). (t² bụ t squared, t³ bụkwa t cubed.)
n-m-h3-diffc-07.thinking.1: Chọta uru ọzọ site n'ụzọ ziri ezi
n-m-h3-diffc-07.thinking.2: Tụnyere nhazi nke nkwupụta iji họrọ usoro ziri ezi
n-m-h3-diffc-07.prereq.0: Ịdị iche nke parametric functions dy/dx=(dy/dt)/(dx/dt)
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kwenye na dy/dx n'ahịrị 2 bụ nkwupụta n't, chee otu e kwesịrị ide usoro ime ya ka ọ dị iche n'ihe gbasara x site n'iji chain rule.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.hint.1: Kọwaa n'okwu derivative nke ahịrị ọ bụla na-achọta, ma nwalee ma ọ sitere n'ahịrị gara aga n'ụzọ ziri ezi site n'ọmụmaatụ dị mfe dịka x=t², y=t³.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 3 bụ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi. dy/dx bụ nkwupụta n't, ya mere iji mee ya ka ọ dị iche n'ihe gbasara x, ị ga-ebu ụzọ mee ya ka ọ dị iche n'ihe gbasara t ma mgbe ahụ kewaa site na dx/dt. Ime y na x ka ha dị iche ugboro abụọ nke ọ bụla na ịkewa abụghị mgbakọ ahụ. Ahịrị 4 na-eji naanị nsonaazụ nke ahịrị 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.prompt: Chọta uru d²y/dx² na t=2 site n'iji ụzọ ziri ezi, ma dee otu ị si chọta ya.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.hint.0: Mee dy/dx ka ọ dị mfe dịka nkwupụta n't, mgbe ahụ mee nkwupụta ahụ ka ọ dị iche n'ihe gbasara t.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.hint.1: Iji mee ka ọ dị iche n'ihe gbasara x, jiri dx/dt chee ihe ị ga-ekewa derivative n'ihe gbasara t site na ya.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.placeholder: dịka, Buru ụzọ dy/dx ... mgbe ahụ ...
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ buru ụzọ mee dy/dx ka ọ dị mfe dịka nkwupụta n't?
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ mere nkwupụta ahụ ka ọ dị iche n'ihe gbasara t ma mgbe ahụ kewaa site na dx/dt?
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ lelere site n'itinye uru 15/32 ozugbo?
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.model.0: dy/dx=(3t²−3)/(2t)=(3/2)(t−1/t), ime nke a ka ọ dị iche n'ihe gbasara t na-enye (3/2)(1+1/t²). Ịkewa nke a site na dx/dt=2t na-enye d²y/dx². Na t=2, (3/2)(5/4)=15/8, kewaa site na 4, na-enye 15/32.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.model.1: d²y/dx²=(d/dt(dy/dx))÷(dx/dt). Itinye t=2 n'd/dt{(3/2)(t−1/t)}=(3/2)(1+1/t²) na-enye 15/8, ịkewa site na dx/dt=4 na-enyekwa 15/32.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.prompt: Họrọ usoro ziri ezi maka ịchọta d²y/dx² maka curve e nyere site na parameter.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee ihe a pụrụ ịgụ d²y/dx² dịka "ime ihe ka ọ dị iche n'ihe gbasara ihe."
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.hint.1: Jiri chain rule chee ihe ị ga-amụba ma ọ bụ kewaa site na ya iji gbanwee ịdị iche n'ihe gbasara t ka ọ bụrụ ịdị iche n'ihe gbasara x.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.a: Kewaa y e mere ka ọ dị iche ugboro abụọ n'ihe gbasara t site na x e mere ka ọ dị iche ugboro abụọ n'ihe gbasara t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.a: Nke a bụ ụzọ Seoyeon jiri. Oke nke uru e mere ka ha dị iche ugboro abụọ n'ihe gbasara t dị iche na dy/dx e mere ka ọ dị iche n'ihe gbasara x.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.b: Kewaa dy/dx e mere ka ọ dị iche otu ugboro n'ihe gbasara t site na x e mere ka ọ dị iche otu ugboro n'ihe gbasara t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.b: Nke a na-egosipụta usoro ime dy/dx ka ọ dị iche n'ihe gbasara x site n'iji chain rule.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.c: Kewaa dy/dx e mere ka ọ dị iche otu ugboro n'ihe gbasara t site na x e mere ka ọ dị iche ugboro abụọ n'ihe gbasara t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.c: Ị tinyere second derivative nke x n'denominator. Iji gbanwee ka ọ bụrụ ịdị iche n'ihe gbasara x, ị na-ekewa site na dx/dt otu ugboro.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.d: Kewaa dy/dx e mere ka ọ dị iche otu ugboro n'ihe gbasara t site na square nke x e mere ka ọ dị iche otu ugboro n'ihe gbasara t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.d: Ị gbara denominator square. N'chain rule, naanị ihe ị na-ekewa site na ya iji gbanwee ịdị iche n'ihe gbasara t ka ọ bụrụ ịdị iche n'ihe gbasara x bụ dx/dt, otu ugboro.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.explain: d²y/dx²=d/dx(dy/dx)=[d/dt(dy/dx)]·(dt/dx)=[d/dt(dy/dx)]÷(dx/dt). Na t=2, usoro ndị dị n'elu na-enye 6, 15/16, na 15/128 n'otu n'otu, nke dị iche na uru ziri ezi 15/32.

n-m-h3-conic-03.topic: Akụkụ conic: nkọwa na tangent nke parabola, ellipse na hyperbola; njikọ ọdịdị na nhata
n-m-h3-conic-03.title: Olee otú locus nke isi P si agbanwe mgbe isi F na-agagharị?
n-m-h3-conic-03.goal: Jiri nkọwa kwenye na n’otu ihe owuwu ahụ, ịgbanwe ọnọdụ F na-agbanwe locus ka ọ bụrụ okirikiri, ellipse ma ọ bụ hyperbola. Mepụta omume nke ịghara ibufe nkwubi okwu otu ọnọdụ n’ọnọdụ ọzọ n’enweghị mgbanwe.
n-m-h3-conic-03.material: N’ime plane, e nwere okirikiri etiti O na radius 6, na isi F. Maka isi Q na-agagharị n’okirikiri ahụ, ka P bụrụ ebe perpendicular bisector nke FQ na-ezute ahịrị OQ. Anyị ga-enyocha ọdịdị P na-esere ka Q na-agagharị, na-agbanwe ọnọdụ F.
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.0: Gbanwee mkpebi gị oge ọ bụla ọnọdụ gbanwere
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.1: Chọta locus site na nchikọta na ọdịiche anya
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.2: Rịba ama ihe ize ndụ nke ime ka ọnọdụ pụrụ iche (F=O) bụrụ iwu izugbe
n-m-h3-conic-03.prereq.0: Nkọwa ellipse na hyperbola (ngụkọta anya, ọdịiche anya)
n-m-h3-conic-03.prereq.1: Njirimara na isi dị na perpendicular bisector nke akụkụ nwere otu anya na nsọtụ abụọ
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.prompt: Ozi na-apụta n’otu n’otu ka ọnọdụ F na-agbanwe. N’usoro nke ọ bụla họrọ mkpebi dabere naanị n’ihe ị maara ruo ebe ahụ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.hint.0: Oge ọ bụla ozi ọhụrụ pụtara, see eserese na-egosi ebe P dị n’akụkụ OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.hint.1: Jiri PF=PQ lelee ma nchikọta ma ọ bụ ọdịiche PO na PF ọ̀ na-adị ka uru constant.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Buru ụzọ tụlee F bụ otu isi na etiti O. Isi dị na perpendicular bisector nke FQ nwere otu anya na F na Q; ya mere PF=PQ. Isi P dị n’ahịrị OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ka Q na-agagharị gburugburu okirikiri otu ugboro, ọdịdị dị aṅaa ka P na-ese?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ọ bụrụ F=O, PO=PQ, PO+PQ=OQ=6; ya mere PO=3. P dị anya 3 site na O, ọ na-esekwa okirikiri radius 3.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: I kwughachiri naanị okirikiri Q na-ese. P abụghị Q; ọ bụ isi dị na perpendicular bisector nke FQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: I hụrụ na P dị n’otu anya constant site na O.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ellipse nwere O na isi ọzọ dịka focus
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Anyị erubeghị ọnọdụ nwere focus abụọ. F na O bụ otu isi.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Ebugala F n’isi dị n’ime okirikiri, anya 4 site na O. PF=PQ ka bụ eziokwu. Ọ bụrụ i see eserese, P dị n’akụkụ OQ (n’etiti O na Q).
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Gịnị bụ locus P ugbu a?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Gịnị bụ locus P ugbu a?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Ebe P dị n’akụkụ OQ, PO+PF=PO+PQ=OQ=6. Ngụkọta anya site na O na F bụ 6 mgbe niile; ya mere ọ bụ ellipse nwere focus O na F, ogologo major axis 6.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ọ ka bụ okirikiri etiti O: n’ihi na Q nọ n’okirikiri.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Mgbe F hapụrụ O, PO abụghịzi constant. I bugara nkwubi okwu nke usoro gara aga n’enweghị mgbanwe.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Hyperbola nwere ọdịiche anya constant site na O na F.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Hyperbola nwere ọdịiche anya constant site na O na F.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: I leleghị ma a na-agbakwunye PO na PF ka ọ bụ na-ewepụ ha. Jiri eziokwu na P dị n’akụkụ OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ellipse nwere ngụkọta anya constant site na O na F.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: I hụrụ na ngụkọta ahụ bụ constant, ebe PO+PF=PO+PQ=OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Parabola nwere isi ndị hà nhata anya site na F na ahịrị.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Anya hà nhata bụ mmekọrịta dị n’etiti F na Q (PF=PQ); ọ bụ anya ruo isi Q, ọ bụghị ahịrị.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Oge a ebugala F n’isi dị n’èzí okirikiri, anya 9 site na O. Ọ bụrụ i see eserese, P adịghị n’akụkụ OQ kama ọ dị n’akụkụ ahịrị OQ agbatịkwuru (n’akụkụ Q ma ọ bụ O). PF=PQ ka bụ eziokwu.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.after: N'ịgbatị n'akụkụ Q, PO=OQ+PQ, ya mere PO−PF=6, n'ịgbatị n'akụkụ O, PF−PO=6. N'ụzọ ọ bụla, |PO−PF|=6 bụ ihe na-agbanwe agbanwe, ya mere ọ bụ hyperbola nwere foci O na F na transverse axis nke ogologo ya bụ 6 (OF=9>6).
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ellipse nwere nchikota na-agbanwe agbanwe, dịka n'ikpe n'ime
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ị kpọgara nsonaazụ site n'ikpe n'ime n'enweghị mgbanwe. Ọ bụrụ na P adịghị na akụkụ OQ, PO+PQ abụghị OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Lelee ma PO na-agbanwe agbanwe. Ọ bụrụ na F dị anya n'O, ọ naghị agbanwe agbanwe.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Perpendicular bisector na ahịrị OQ na-ezute maka fọrọ nke nta ka Q ọ bụla.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.reflect: Ka ọnọdụ F gbanwere, otu owuwu ahụ nyere gburugburu, ellipse, na hyperbola n'usoro. Ịkpọgara nsonaazụ n'ime n'èzí n'enweghị mgbanwe bụ ihe na-ezighị ezi. Dabere ma ebe P dị n'akụkụ OQ ma ọ bụ n'ịgbatị ya, ọ gbanwere ma nchikota ma ọ bụ ọdịiche nke PO na PF bụ ihe na-agbanwe agbanwe.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.prompt: Kọwaa ihe mere locus nke P ji dị iche mgbe F dị n'ime gburugburu na mgbe F dị n'èzí gburugburu, site n'iji PO, PF, na radius 6 nke gburugburu.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kwuo ebe P dị n'ahịrị OQ n'ikpe n'ime na n'ikpe n'èzí.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.hint.1: N'ikpe ọ bụla, jikọọ mmekọrịta dị n'etiti PO na PQ na ogologo 6.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.placeholder: dịka, Ọ bụrụ na ọ dị n'ime ...
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ dere na PO+PF=6 n'ime na |PO−PF|=6 n'èzí?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kọwara na nchikota na ọdịiche na-ekewa n'ihi na ọnọdụ P (n'akụkụ ma ọ bụ n'ịgbatị) dị iche?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na F dị n'ime, P dị n'akụkụ OQ, ya mere PO+PF=PO+PQ=6, nchikota na-agbanwe agbanwe, ọ bụkwa ellipse. Ọ bụrụ na F dị n'èzí, P dị n'ịgbatị, ya mere ọdịiche PO na PQ bụ 6, ọdịiche PO na PF bụ 6 na-agbanwe agbanwe, ọ bụkwa hyperbola.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na F dị n'ime gburugburu, nchikota nke ebe dị site n'O na F bụ 6, ya mere ọ bụ ellipse, ọ bụrụkwa na F dị n'èzí gburugburu, uru zuru ezu nke ọdịiche nke ebe bụ 6 na-agbanwe agbanwe, ya mere ọ bụ hyperbola. Nke a bụ n'ihi na ma P dị n'akụkụ ma ọ bụ n'ịgbatị na-agbanwe.

n-m-h3-conic-06.topic: Akụkụ conic: nkọwa na tangent nke parabola, ellipse na hyperbola; njikọ ọdịdị na nhata
n-m-h3-conic-06.title: Ebe focus na directrix na-aga mgbe a kwagara parabola?
n-m-h3-conic-06.goal: Gụọ ntụziaka mkpọpụ nke ọma site na nha, kwaga focus na directrix site n'otu mkpọpụ, ma dee nkọwa maka nwa akwụkwọ dị obere.
n-m-h3-conic-06.material: Nwa gị n'ọrụ Haeun zigara gị ndetu mgbe ọ na-anwa ịchọta focus na directrix nke parabola (y−1)² = −8(x+2).
n-m-h3-conic-06.thinking.0: Ịgụ otu ihe ịrịba ama dị n'nha si kwekọrọ n'ntụziaka mkpọpụ
n-m-h3-conic-06.thinking.2: Idegharị nkọwa ka ọ kwekọọ onye ị na-akọwara
n-m-h3-conic-06.prereq.0: Focus na directrix nke parabola y²=4px
n-m-h3-conic-06.prereq.1: Mkpọpụ na otu nha si agbanwe
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.prompt: Nke a bụ ndetu nwa gị n'ọrụ Haeun zigara. Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ chọta ebe n'nha ọhụrụ ebe akụkụ abụọ bụ 0. Tụnyere ya na ebe ọrụ ahụ dị n'nha ochie.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kewaa ma mgbakọ ahịrị ọ bụla sitere n'ahịrị gara aga ka ọ bụ ikpe ọhụrụ.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.0: Maka y² = −8x, 4p = −8, ya mere p = −2, focus bụ (−2, 0), directrix bụkwa x = 2.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.1: (y−1)² = −8(x+2) nwere x+2 na y−1, ya mere ọ bụ y² = −8x e kwagara site na +2 n'ntụziaka x na −1 n'ntụziaka y.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.2: Ịkwaga focus n'otu ụzọ ahụ na-enye (−2+2, 0−1) = (0, −1).
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.3: Ịkwaga directrix n'otu ụzọ ahụ na-enye x = 2+2 = 4.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.4: Ya mere focus bụ (0, −1) directrix bụkwa x = 4.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụ ahịrị 2. Itinye x+2 n'ọnọdụ x na-akwaga site na −2 n'ntụziaka x, itinye y−1 n'ọnọdụ y na-akwagakwa site na +1 n'ntụziaka y. Ihe ịrịba ama ndị ahụ megidere. Ihe niile site n'ahịrị 3 gaa n'ihu bụ mgbakọ na-eso ntụziaka n'ahịrị 2, ya mere ọ bụrụ na ntụziaka ezighị ezi, ihe niile ezighị ezi. Ahịrị 1 ziri ezi.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.prompt: Họrọ ụzọ kacha tụkwasị obi ilele ma ntụziaka mkpọpụ Haeun ziri ezi.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.hint.0: Chee ihe e ji mara ebe kwekọrọ n'vertex ochie n'nha ọhụrụ nke ọdịdị e kwagara.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.hint.1: Buru ụzọ chetụ ma focus na directrix dị na curve.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.a: Tinye focus e chọtara, (0, −1), ka ị hụ ma ọ na-emezu nha ọhụrụ (y−1)² = −8(x+2).
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.a: Focus abụghị ebe dị na curve, ya mere ọ dịghị mkpa ka ọ mezuo nha mgbe e tinyere ya. Ya mere nlele a enweghị ike ịgwa gị ntụziaka mkpọpụ.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.b: Tụnyere ma coefficient −8 n'nha ọhụrụ hà coefficient dị n'nha mbụ.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.b: Coefficient na-agwa gị naanị udi (ntụziaka ọ na-emeghe na obosara ya). Ọ naghị agwa gị n'ụzọ ole e kwagara ọnọdụ.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.c: Chọta ebe akụkụ abụọ nke nha ọhụrụ bụ 0 ma lelee ma ọ bụ ebe vertex ochie (0, 0) kwagara.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.d: Seta eserese n'ihe dị ka ya ma lelee ma ntụziaka ọ na-emeghe bụ otu dịka na mbụ.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.d: Mkpọpụ anaghị agbanwe ntụziaka ọ na-emeghe, ya mere ọ dị otu ọbụlagodi ma ntụziaka mkpọpụ ezighị ezi.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.explain: Vertex bụ ebe (0, 0) ebe akụkụ abụọ nke nha ochie bụ 0, ya mere ebe (−2, 1) ebe akụkụ abụọ nke nha ọhụrụ bụ 0 bụ ebe vertex kwagara. Ya mere mkpọpụ bụ −2 n'ofe x-axis na +1 n'ofe y-axis. Focus na directrix abụghị ebe dị na curve, ya mere ị pụghị ilele ha site n'itinye n'nha.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.prompt: Haeun bụ nwa akwụkwọ afọ mbụ nke elu ụlọ akwụkwọ nke ka mụtara mkpọpụ. Dee azịza ị ga-ezigara Haeun. Ọ ga-agụnye ebe ọ gbagworo, ntụziaka mkpọpụ ziri ezi, focus na directrix ziri ezi, na otu e si lelee.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kpebie usoro nke azịza: ebe ọ gbagworo, mkpọpụ e dozitere, focus na directrix, otu e si lelee.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.hint.1: Jiri mkpọpụ e dozitere kwaga vertex, focus, na directrix nke nha mbụ.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ gosiri ebe ọ gbagworo n'okwu Haeun nwere ike ịghọta?
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ gosiri otu focus na directrix si kwaga site n'ọnọdụ ochie ha?
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ụzọ e si lelee ọ̀ dị n'azịza ahụ?
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.model.0: Haeun, ntụziaka ahụ megidere n'ahịrị 2. Ọ bụrụ na e tinye x+2 n'ọnọdụ x, eserese kwagara site na −2 n'ntụziaka x, ma site na y−1 ọ kwagara site na +1 n'ntụziaka y. Ebe n'nha ọhụrụ ebe akụkụ abụọ bụ 0 bụ (−2, 1), ya mere ị nwere ike ịmata na vertex kwagara site na (0, 0) ruo ebe ahụ. Ya mere focus (−2, 0) na-akwaga (−4, 1), directrix x=2 na-akwagakwa x=0.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.model.1: Haeun, ntụziaka mkpọpụ n'ahịrị 2 ezighị ezi. (x+2) na-akwaga 2 n'aka ekpe, (y−1) na-akwagakwa 1 n'elu. Ị nwere ike ilele site n'itinye na vertex bụ (−2, 1). Ya mere focus bụ (−4, 1) directrix bụkwa x = 0.

n-m-h3-diffc-01.title: Kedu ka anyị kwesịrị isi gụọ mkpọda nke onye na-ekewa ya bụ 0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.topic: Mkpụrụ: mkpụrụ implicit na ahịrị emetụta n'ebe a na-akọwaghị mkpọda
n-m-h3-diffc-01.goal: Nyochaa ma ahịrị emetụta dị n'ebe onye na-ekewa mkpọda e nwetara site na mkpụrụ implicit bụ 0, ma chọta ma mezie nkwubi okwu na-ezighi ezi n'ngwọta.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta Hayoon maka ịchọta ahịrị emetụta na ntụpọ P(2, −1) dị n'akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ C: x²+xy+y²=3. (x² na y² pụtara x square na y square. A lelere na ntụpọ P dị na C site na 4−2+1=3.)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.thinking.1: Kọwaa ahịrị emetụta ebe a na-akọwaghị mkpọda dị ka ọdịdị nke eserese
n-m-h3-diffc-01.thinking.2: Họrọ ọnọdụ ndị a ga-elele tupu ikwubi
n-m-h3-diffc-01.prereq.0: Mkpụrụ implicit (were y dị ka ọrụ nke x ma mepụta akụkụ abụọ n'ihe gbasara x)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.prereq.1: Ịchọta nhata ahịrị emetụta na ntụpọ dị n'akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighi ezi n'ngwọta Hayoon.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.hint.0: Gụọ ahịrị ọ bụla site n'elu ma lelee site n'ịgbakọ ozugbo ma ọ si n'ahịrị tupu ya pụta.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tụnyere ma nkwubi okwu dị n'ahịrị ikpeazụ na-ekwu otu ihe ahụ dị ka eziokwu e nwetara n'ahịrị mbụ (ihe a na-akọwaghị).
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.0: Imepụta akụkụ abụọ n'ihe gbasara x na-enye 2x + (y + x·y′) + 2y·y′ = 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.1: Idozi maka y′ na-enye y′ = −(2x + y)/(x + 2y).
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.2: Itinye P(2, −1), onye na-ekewa x+2y bụ 2+2·(−1)=0, ya mere a naghị akọwa mkpọda.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.3: Ya mere ahịrị emetụta adịghị na ntụpọ P.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 4 adịghị mma. Mgbakọ ndị dị n'ahịrị 1 ruo 3 ziri ezi. Ma "a naghị akọwa okwu mkpọda" pụtara "enweghị ọnụọgụ a na-akpọ mkpọda," ọ bụghị na enweghị ahịrị emetụta. Onye na-agụta 2x+y=3 abụghị 0, ya mere mkpọda nwere ike ito na-enweghị oke, ya bụ, ahịrị emetụta kwụ ọtọ na axis y nwere ike ịpụta.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na e nwere ahịrị emetụta n'akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ C na ntụpọ P, dee nhata ya, ma dee ihe mere ị ji kpebie otú ahụ.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.hint.0: Gbakọọ uru onye na-agụta na-ewere mgbe onye na-ekewa bụ 0, ma chee otú mkpọda na-abụ nnukwu.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sere otú ahịrị nke mkpọda ya na-eto na-enweghị oke dị n'ime mpaghara nhazi, ma dee nhata nke ahịrị ahụ na-agafe na ntụpọ P.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.placeholder: dịka. Ịlele ntụzi nke ahịrị emetụta ...
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: I lelere na onye na-ekewa bụ 0 ma onye na-agụta abụghị 0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: I tinyere x=2 n'ime nhata akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ ma lelee otú akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ na ahịrị si ezute?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị nwere ike ikwu ọdịiche dị n'agbata "enweghị mkpọda" na "enweghị ahịrị emetụta"?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.model.0: Onye na-ekewa bụ 0 ma onye na-agụta bụ 3, ya mere mkpọda na-eto na-enweghị oke. Ya mere ahịrị emetụta bụ ahịrị x=2, kwụ ọtọ na axis y. Itinye x=2 n'akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ na-enye y²+2y+1=0, ya mere y=−1 bụ naanị ngwọta, nke pụtara na ahịrị na-emetụ akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ naanị na ntụpọ P, nke dabarakwa.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.model.1: E nwere ahịrị emetụta. A naghị akọwa mkpọda n'ihi na ahịrị emetụta kwụ ọtọ, nhata ya bụ x=2. Elerekwa m na onye na-agụta 2x+y bụ 3, ọ bụghị 0, ya mere ọ bụghị ụdị 0/0.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ọ zuru ezu ilele onye na-agụta, ọbụna na-ejighị usoro itinye x=2 n'akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.prompt: Kedu ihe ị ga-elele tupu ikwubi "e nwere ahịrị emetụta kwụ ọtọ" n'ebe onye na-ekewa nke okwu mkpọda bụ 0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.hint.0: N'ụdị y′ = (onye na-agụta)/(onye na-ekewa), tụnyere ka ahịrị si dị iche mgbe onye na-ekewa bụ 0 na uru onye na-agụta dị iche.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ụdị 0/0 na 3/0 ọ bụ otu ọnọdụ? Chee ihe nke ọ bụla na-ekwu.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.a: Ma mgbe onye na-ekewa bụ 0, onye na-agụta abụghị efu kwa (ya bụ, ọ bụghị ụdị 0/0)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.a: I chere echiche ilele onye na-agụta kwa.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.b: Ma uru y abụghị nke adịghị mma mgbe ntụpọ dị n'akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.b: Akara y enweghị njikọ na ma ahịrị emetụta dị. Ị nwere ike ịgwakọta akara nhazi na ntụzi ahịrị emetụta.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.c: Ma uru e mepụtara ugboro abụọ y″ abụghị 0
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.c: Mkpụrụ nke abụọ na-agwa gị naanị ntụzi akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ na-agbagọ; ọ naghị ekpebi ma ahịrị emetụta dị.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.d: Ma enwere ike ide akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ n'ụdị y = (okwu n'ime x)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.d: Ahịrị emetụta dị ọbụna ma enweghị ike ide ọrụ implicit n'ụdị y=f(x). A chọghị ọnọdụ a.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.explain: Ọbụna ma onye na-ekewa bụ 0, ọ bụrụ na onye na-agụta abụghị 0, mkpọda na-eto na-enweghị oke ma ahịrị emetụta kwụ ọtọ na-apụta. Ọ bụrụ na onye na-agụta bụ 0 kwa, ọ bụ ụdị 0/0, ya mere okwu a naanị enweghị ike ikpebi ya, ma ị ga-elele ọdịdị akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ n'ebe ahụ site n'ụzọ ọzọ.

n-m-h3-diffc-02.title: N'oge ọsọ bụ 0, ntụpọ ahụ ọ na-atụgharị?
n-m-h3-diffc-02.topic: Mkpụrụ: ọsọ na mmụba ọsọ, ọnọdụ maka mgbanwe ntụzi
n-m-h3-diffc-02.goal: Ghọta, site na mgbanwe akara nke ọsọ, ọdịiche dị n'agbata oge ọsọ bụ 0 na oge ntụzi mmegharị na-agbanwe, ma wuo ma lelee okwu ọsọ nke na-emezu ọnọdụ n'onwe gị.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.material: Ọsọ nke ntụpọ P na-agagharị n'ahịrị ọnụọgụ n'oge t (t≥0) bụ v(t), ma v(1)=0. Minsu kwuru, "N'oge ọsọ bụ 0, ntụpọ ahụ na-agbanwe ntụzi n'ezie." (Ịgbanwe ntụzi pụtara ịga site na ịgagharị n'aka nri gaa n'aka ekpe, ma ọ bụ site n'aka ekpe gaa n'aka nri. Ọ bụrụ na ọsọ dị mma, ọ na-aga n'aka nri; ọ bụrụ na ọ adịghị mma, n'aka ekpe.)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.thinking.0: Họrọ ọnọdụ kpọmkwem maka mgbanwe ntụzi
n-m-h3-diffc-02.thinking.1: Wuo ma lelee okwu ọsọ nke na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ
n-m-h3-diffc-02.thinking.2: Hazie ihe enwere ike ikpe site na uru ọsọ na mmụba ọsọ naanị
n-m-h3-diffc-02.prereq.0: Mmekọrịta n'etiti ọnọdụ, ọsọ, na mmụba ọsọ (ọsọ bụ mkpụrụ nke ọnọdụ, mmụba ọsọ bụ mkpụrụ nke ọsọ)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.prereq.1: Mmekọrịta n'etiti akara ọsọ na ntụzi mmegharị
n-m-h3-diffc-02.prereq.2: Mgbanwe akara nke okwu e kewara ka ọ bụrụ ihe
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nkwupụta nke pụtara otu ihe dị ka "ntụpọ P na-agbanwe ntụzi n'oge t₀."
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee ụzọ ntụpọ ahụ na-aga mgbe ọsọ dị mma na mgbe ọ adịghị mma.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.hint.1: Chee ihe akara ọsọ ga-eme ka ntụzi gbanwee, ma tụnyere na ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-aghọ 0 wee laghachi n'otu akara.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna ma mmụba ọsọ abụghị 0, ọ bụrụ na ọsọ abụghị 0 ntụzi na-anọgide otu. Ị nwere ike ịgwakọta ọsọ na mmụba ọsọ.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.o.b: Ọnọdụ na t₀ buru ibu karịa ọnọdụ n'oge niile tupu na mgbe ya
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.b: Nke a na-atụle naanị mgbe ọnọdụ kacha buru ibu (ọnụ aka nri). Ọ hapụrụ ọnọdụ ịtụgharị n'ọnụ aka ekpe.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.c: v(t₀)=0 bụ naanị otu atụmatụ nke oge ịgbanwe ntụzi, ọ bụghị otu nkwupụta ahụ. Chee ọnọdụ ebe v=0 ma akara na-anọgide otu.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.o.d: Akara ọsọ tupu na mgbe t₀ dị iche
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.d: I hụrụ mgbanwe ntụzi site na mgbanwe akara nke ọsọ.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.explain: Ntụzi na-agbanwe mgbe akara ọsọ gbanwere site na dị mma gaa adịghị mma ma ọ bụ site na adịghị mma gaa dị mma. Ọsọ ịbụ 0 bụ ọnọdụ dị mkpa nke na-apụta n'oge akara gbanwere, ma ọ zughị ezu.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.prompt: Mgbe e nyere ọsọ site na v(t)=(t−1)^m (t−p)^n, tinye ụzụzụ atọ (m, n, p) abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa dị iche nke na-emezu ihe niile ndị a: ntụpọ P anaghị agbanwe ntụzi na t=1, ma na-agbanwe ntụzi na t=p. (m na n bụ ọnụọgụ okike site na 1 ruo 6, p bụkwa ọnụọgụ okike site na 2 ruo 9.)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.hint.0: Nwaa ọtụtụ uru m na n ma mee tebụl nke akara (t−1)^m na (t−p)^n tupu na mgbe t=1 na t=p.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kewaa n'ọnọdụ ebe onye na-egosi ike bụ nke abụọ-abụọ na nke na-abụghị, ma tụnyere ma akara bụ otu ma ọ bụ dị iche tupu na mgbe ebe ahụ.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c1: m, n, na p bụ ọnụọgụ okike n'ime oke ndị ahụ.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Akara ọsọ bụ otu tupu na mgbe t=1.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Akara ọsọ na-agbanwe tupu na mgbe t=1, ya mere ntụpọ ahụ na-agbanwe ntụzi.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Akara ọsọ dị iche tupu na mgbe t=p.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Akara ọsọ bụ otu tupu na mgbe t=p, ya mere ntụpọ ahụ anaghị agbanwe ntụzi.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.explain: Ọ bụrụ na onye na-egosi ike nke (t−1) bụ nke abụọ-abụọ, ihe a nwere otu akara tupu na mgbe t=1, ma ọ bụrụ na onye na-egosi ike nke (t−p) bụ nke na-abụghị abụọ-abụọ, akara dị iche tupu na mgbe t=p. Ihe ndị ọzọ anaghị agbanwe akara nso ebe ahụ (p≥2). Maka (1, 1, 3), akara na-agbanwekwa na t=1, ma maka (2, 2, 3), ọ naghị agbanwe na t=3.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Họrọ otu n'ime ihe atụ ị chọtara ma dee ihe mere ntụpọ ahụ anaghị agbanwe ntụzi na t=1 ọ bụ ezie na v(1)=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Dee v(t) site na (m, n, p) i họrọ, ma tụnyere akara mgbe ị tinye uru nke dị ntakịrị pere mpe karịa 1 na uru dị ntakịrị buru ibu karịa 1.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Jikọọ ma (t−1)^m dị mma ma ọ bụ adịghị mma tupu na mgbe t=1 na ma m bụ nke na-abụghị abụọ-abụọ ma ọ bụ abụọ-abụọ.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.placeholder: dịka. Tupu na mgbe t=1, akara nke (t−1)^m bụ ...
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: N'ihe atụ i họrọ, i gbakọrọ n'ezie akara ọsọ tupu na mgbe t=1?
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: I tụnyere na ọnọdụ ebe onye na-egosi ike bụ nke na-abụghị abụọ-abụọ?
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Ahọrọ m (2, 1, 3). N'v=(t−1)²(t−3), (t−1)² bụ opekata mpe 0 n'akụkụ abụọ nke t=1, ya mere akara ya anaghị agbanwe, ma (t−3) na-anọgide adịghị mma. Ya mere v bụ 0 na t=1 ma akara ya na-anọgide otu, ya mere ntụzi anaghị agbanwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Onye na-egosi ike m bụ nke abụọ-abụọ, ya mere (t−1)^m anaghị abụ nke pere mpe karịa 0 mgbe t na-agafe 1. Ọsọ na-emetụ 0 ma laghachi n'otu akara, ya mere ntụzi na-anọgide otu.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Ọ gụnyere onye na-egosi ike nke abụọ-abụọ na eziokwu na akara anaghị agbanwe abụọ.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.prompt: Mgbe ọsọ v bụ ọrụ nwere ike ịmepụta ma mmụba ọsọ bụ a(t)=v′(t), họrọ nkwupụta ziri ezi niile.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tọọ okwu ọsọ dị mfe n'onwe gị, dị ka v=(t−1)² na v=(t−1)³, gbakọọ v′(1) nke ọ bụla, ma tụnyere ma ntụzi na-agbanwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.hint.1: Maka nkwupụta ọ bụla, chọta otu ihe atụ na-emegide iji lelee ma ọ "na-adị mgbe niile."
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.a: Ọ bụrụ na v(t₀)=0 na a(t₀)≠0, ntụpọ ahụ na-agbanwe ntụzi na t₀
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.a: I chere na ọ bụrụ na mmụba ọsọ abụghị 0, eserese ọsọ na-agafe 0 ma akara ya na-agbanwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.b: Ọ bụrụ na v(t₀)=0 na a(t₀)=0, ntụpọ ahụ anaghị agbanwe ntụzi na t₀
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.b: Ọbụna ma a(t₀)=0, n'ọnọdụ dị ka v=(t−1)³ ntụzi na-agbanwe. I hapụrụ na ma mmụba ọsọ bụ 0, nke a naanị enweghị ike ikpebi ya.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.c: Ọ bụrụ na v(t₀)=0 na a(t₀)=0, ntụpọ ahụ na-agbanwe ntụzi na t₀ n'ezie
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.c: Ọbụna ma a(t₀)=0, n'ọnọdụ dị ka v=(t−1)² ntụzi na-anọgide otu.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.d: Ọ bụrụ na ntụpọ ahụ na-agbanwe ntụzi na t₀, mgbe ahụ v(t₀)=0 n'ihe dị mkpa
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.d: I chere na ka ntụzi gbanwee, ọsọ ga-agbanwe n'ụzọ na-aga n'ihu ma gafee 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.explain: Ọ bụrụ na v(t₀)=0 na v′(t₀)=a(t₀)≠0, mgbe ahụ v na-agafe 0 ma gbanwee akara. N'ụzọ megidere, ọ bụrụ na a(t₀)=0, akara nwere ike ghara ịgbanwe, dị ka (t−1)², ma ọ bụ nwee ike ịgbanwe, dị ka (t−1)³, ya mere ị ga-elele akara ọsọ ozugbo. Ka ntụzi gbanwee, v na-aga n'ihu ga-agbanwe akara, ya mere v=0 n'oge ahụ.

n-m-h3-diffc-03.title: Anyị nwere ike ịchọta mkpọda nke ọrụ jikọtara ọnụ site na uru dị n'tebụl?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.topic: Mkpụrụ: mkpụrụ nke ọrụ jikọtara ọnụ na tebụl uru ọrụ na uru mkpụrụ
n-m-h3-diffc-03.goal: Mgbe ị na-achọta mkpụrụ nke ọrụ jikọtara ọnụ, kpebie ebe a ga-agụ mkpụrụ nke ọrụ mpụga, ma hazie ihe enwere ike ịchọta site na uru dị n'tebụl naanị.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.material:
Uru nke ọrụ abụọ nwere ike ịmepụta f na g dị ka n'tebụl dị n'okpuru. Uru ndị na-adịghị n'tebụl amaghị. (f∘g)(x) pụtara f(g(x)), ma (g∘f)(x) pụtara g(f(x)).
 x=1: f(1)=3, f′(1)=4, g(1)=2, g′(1)=−3
 x=2: f(2)=5, f′(2)=7, g(2)=1, g′(2)=6
n-m-h3-diffc-03.thinking.1: Kewapụ ihe enwere ike ịchọta na ihe enweghị ike
n-m-h3-diffc-03.thinking.2: Kọwaa ihe kpatara mgbakọ na-ezighi ezi
n-m-h3-diffc-03.prereq.0: Iwu agbụ maka ọrụ jikọtara ọnụ (f∘g)′(x)=f′(g(x))g′(x)
n-m-h3-diffc-03.prereq.1: Ịgụ tebụl ka ị chọta uru ọrụ
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ uru niile e ji chọta (f∘g)′(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.hint.0: Dee mkpụrụ nke ọrụ jikọtara ọnụ f(g(x)) dị ka ngwaahịa nke akụkụ mpụga na akụkụ ime, ma lee uru akụkụ mpụga na-ewere dị ka ntinye ya.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.hint.1: Jiri eziokwu na mgbe x=1, nsonaazụ itinye 1 n'ime g na-aghọ ntinye nke f iji kpebie ntinye ndị a ga-agụ n'tebụl.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.a: I gụrụ mkpọda nke f na x=1. Ọrụ mpụga f ga-eji mkpọda ya na uru nke ọrụ ime, g(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.b: I gụrụ mkpụrụ nke ọrụ mpụga na uru nke ọrụ ime, g(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.c: A chọrọ g(1) iji kpebie n'isi ebe ole a na-eweta derivative nke ọrụ dị n'èzí.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.d: I chere banyere akụkụ ebe a na-amụba derivative nke ọrụ dị n'ime.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.e: g′(2) bụ mkpọda na x=2, ya mere a naghị eji ya n'uru a na-achọ na x=1.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.f: Uru ọrụ f(2) bụ elu, ọ bụghị mkpọda, ya mere a naghị eji ya n'ịgbakọ derivative.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.explain: (f∘g)′(1)=f′(g(1))·g′(1). Ebe ọ bụ g(1)=2, gụọ f′(2)=7 ma mụbaa site na g′(1)=−3 ka ị nweta −21. Isi ihe bụ iji f′(g(1)), ọ bụghị f′(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.acc.0: g(1)=2 bụ uru e ji kpebie n'isi ebe ole ka a ga-agụ f′, ya mere ọ naghị apụta ozugbo n'ịmụba, mana ịmụba naanị f′(2) na g′(1) bụ otu ngụkọta.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.prompt: Họrọ uru niile a na-ekpebi site n'uru ndị dị na tebụl naanị.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.hint.0: Maka ọrụ ejikọtara ọ bụla, buru ụzọ chọta ma dee uru nke ọrụ dị n'ime.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.hint.1: Lelee ma derivative nke ọrụ dị n'èzí n'ntinye ahụ dị na tebụl.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.a: Anyị chọrọ mkpọda g′(3) na g(f(1))=g(3), mana ọ nọghị na tebụl. Iji g′(1) sitere na tebụl na-eji isi ebe ntinye dị iche.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.b: Mkpọda f′(2) na ntinye ọrụ dị n'èzí g(1)=2 dị na tebụl.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.c: Anyị chọrọ mkpọda g′(5) na g(f(2))=g(5), mana ọ nọghị na tebụl.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.d: Mkpọda f′(1) na ntinye ọrụ dị n'èzí g(2)=1 dị na tebụl.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.explain: A pụrụ ịchọta derivative nke ọrụ ejikọtara naanị ma tebụl nwere mkpọda nke ọrụ dị n'èzí a gụrụ na uru nke ọrụ dị n'ime. Maka (f∘g)′, uru nke g, 2 na 1, abụọ bụ uru x dị na tebụl, ya mere ọ kwere omume, ma maka (g∘f)′, uru nke f, 3 na 5, bụ uru x na-adịghị na tebụl.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.prompt: Chọta uru nke (f∘g)′(2). Dekwa ihe mere ịgbakọ f′(2)·g′(2)=42 ji ezighị ezi.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.hint.0: Buru ụzọ gụọ uru nke g(2) site na tebụl ma kpebie n'isi ebe ole a na-eweta derivative nke ọrụ dị n'èzí.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.hint.1: N'ngụkọta nke nyere 42, tụnyere isi ebe ị gụrụ derivative nke f na uru na-abanye n'ezie n'f.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị buru ụzọ chọta g(2) ma kpebie isi ebe ị ga-agụ n'ọrụ dị n'èzí?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị kwuru mkpọda nke isi ebe ole ka agwakọtara n'uru 42?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.model.0: g(2)=1, ya mere a ga-agụ f′ na 1, na-enye (f∘g)′(2)=f′(1)·g′(2)=4×6=24. f′(2)·g′(2) na-agụ mkpọda nke f na x=2, mana uru na-abanye n'f abụghị 2 kama ọ bụ g(2)=1, ya mere ọ ezighị ezi.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.model.1: Derivative nke ọrụ ejikọtara bụ f′(g(2))g′(2). Ebe ọ bụ g(2)=1, f′(1)=4 na g′(2)=6, ma ngwaahịa bụ 24. 42 ezighị ezi n'ihi na ọ jiri f′(2)=7.

n-m-h3-dist-01.title: Ịlele ngwọta variance nke Gayoung
n-m-h3-dist-01.topic: Probability distributions: expected value na variance nke discrete random variable
n-m-h3-dist-01.goal: Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n'ngwọta maka variance, chọta uru ziri ezi, ma lelee ma nsonaazụ ahụ nwere ezi uche.
n-m-h3-dist-01.material: Random variable X na-ewere uru 0, 1, 2, 3 nwere probabilities 0.1, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2 n'usoro. Gayoung dozie dịka n'okpuru iji chọta variance V(X). (E(X²) bụ "expected value nke X squared," {E(X)}² bụkwa "square nke expected value.")
n-m-h3-dist-01.thinking.0: Soro ahịrị nke ngwọta otu otu ma chọta ahịrị na-ezighị ezi
n-m-h3-dist-01.thinking.1: Lelee ma nsonaazụ ahụ kwekọrọ n'udi nkesa
n-m-h3-dist-01.prereq.0: Expected value E(X) nke discrete random variable
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n'ngwọta Gayoung.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.hint.0: Lelee n'usoro site n'elu ma ahịrị ọ bụla sitere n'ahịrị tupu ya n'ụzọ ziri ezi.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.hint.1: Dee nkọwa nke E(X) na E(X²) n'okwu, ma tụnyere ma e gbakọrọ ahịrị ọ bụla dịka nkọwa ndị ahụ si dị.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.line.1: A na-achọta variance site na V(X)=E(X²)−{E(X)}².
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.line.2: E(X²) bụ naanị E(X) squared, ya mere E(X²)=1.6²=2.56
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 3 ezighị ezi. E(X²) abụghị "square nke expected value"; ọ bụ uru e nwetara site n'ibu ụzọ gbaa uru X ọ bụla square, mgbe ahụ ịmụba site na probabilities ma gbakwunye. Ahịrị 4 na 5 na-aga n'ihu site n'nsonaazụ nke ahịrị 3, ya mere mgbakọ ndị ahụ n'onwe ha ziri ezi, ma mmechi ezighị ezi.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.prompt: Dozie ahịrị na-ezighị ezi ma chọta uru E(X²) na V(X). Dee kwa n'otu ahịrịokwu ihe mere nsonaazụ Gayoung V(X)=0 enweghị ezi uche maka nkesa a.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.hint.0: Gbaa uru 0, 1, 2, 3 nke X nke ọ bụla square ma mụbaa site na otu probabilities.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tinye n'okwu ihe variance nke 0 pụtara banyere uru nke X.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ gbakọrọ E(X²) ozugbo site n'iji square nke uru ọ bụla?
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ nwere ike ikwu na E(X²) na {E(X)}² bụ ọnụọgụ dị iche?
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ nwere ike ikwu maka ụdị nkesa kedu ka variance nke 0 ga-ekwe omume?
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.model.1: Ị ga-agba uru ọ bụla square, mụbaa site na probability, ma gbakwunye, ya mere E(X²)=3.4 (=17/5) na V(X)=0.84. Variance nke 0 ga-apụta na X na-ewere mgbe niile naanị otu uru, ma nke ahụ abụghị otú ahụ ebe a.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.model.2: E(X²)=3.4 na variance bụ 0.84. Variance nke 0 pụtara na uru niile bụ otu, nke na-abụghị ikpe ebe a.

n-m-h3-dist-02.title: Mgbe anyị nwere ike ikpọ ya binomial distribution ma anyị dọpụta bọọlụ atọ?
n-m-h3-dist-02.topic: Probability distributions: ọnọdụ ka binomial distribution dị
n-m-h3-dist-02.goal: Họpụta ozi dị mkpa kpọmkwem iji kpee ikpe ma enwere ike were ya dịka binomial distribution, gosikwa site n'ọnụọgụ otu probability si agbanwe mgbe ozi ahụ gbanwere.
n-m-h3-dist-02.material: Igbe nwere bọọlụ ọcha 3 na bọọlụ ojii 2. Seoyun kwuru, "Ọnụọgụ X nke bọọlụ ọcha mgbe a dọpụtara bọọlụ 3 na-eso binomial distribution B(3, 3/5)." Enweghị ike ịmata ma Seoyun ziri ezi site n'ihe e dere ruo ugbu a.
n-m-h3-dist-02.thinking.0: Kewaa ozi dị mkpa maka ikpe na nke na-adịghị mkpa
n-m-h3-dist-02.thinking.1: Lelee site n'ịgbakọ ọdịiche na-apụta mgbe ọnọdụ ahụ gbajiri
n-m-h3-dist-02.prereq.0: Ihe binomial distribution B(n,p) pụtara: rụọ nnwale n nọọ onwe ha, nke ọ bụla nwere otu probability nke ihe ịga nke ọma p
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị ka ị ga-amata iji kpee ikpe ma Seoyun ziri ezi?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ chetụ ihe onwunwe nnwale ga-enwe iji jiri binomial distribution.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kpebie otu otu ma nhọrọ ọ bụla na-elele onwunwe ahụ, ma ọ bụ naanị na-ajụ banyere ihe a maralarị.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.a: Gụọkwa ọzọ ka ị lelee na igbe ahụ nwere bọọlụ ọcha 3 na bọọlụ ojii 2 n'ezie
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.a: E nyelarị ọnụọgụ bọọlụ. A na-eji ya chọta probability 3/5, ma ọ naghị agwa gị ma a na-edebe otu probability mgbe niile.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.b: Lelee ma ịdọpụta bọọlụ 3 bụ ọnụọgụ nnwale buru ibu zuru ezu
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.b: Binomial distribution adịghị adị n'ihi na ọnụọgụ nnwale buru ibu. Ọbụlagodi na ọ dị nta, dịka n=3, ọ bụ binomial distribution ma ọ bụrụ na e mezuru ọnọdụ ndị ahụ.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.c: Lelee ma a na-ebugharị bọọlụ ọ bụla e dọpụtara n'igbe tupu a dọpụta bọọlụ na-esote
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.c: Ị na-enyocha ma ihe dị n’ime igbe ahụ na-adị otu oge ọ bụla. Nke a bụ ọnọdụ bụ isi nke nkesa binomial.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.d: Lelee ma e buru ụzọ kpebie usoro bọọlụ ọcha ga-esi apụta.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.d: Usoro apụta adịghị mkpa maka nkesa ọnụ ọgụgụ X nke bọọlụ ọcha. Ihe na-ekpebi ma ọ bụ binomial bụ ma nnwale ọ bụla na-emetụta ibe ya.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.explain: Maka B(3,3/5), ohere ịdọpụta bọọlụ ọcha aghaghị ịbụ 3/5 oge ọ bụla, n’enweghị mmetụta n’etiti ịdọpụta. Ọ bụrụ na e tinye bọọlụ ọ bụla azụ, nke a bụ eziokwu; ma ọ bụrụ na e tinyeghị ya, nsonaazụ gara aga na-agbanwe ohere ndị na-esote. A maralarị ọnụ ọgụgụ bọọlụ; nnwale ahụ ekwesịghị ịbụ ọtụtụ. (3 3)
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.prompt: Were ya na a dọpụtara bọọlụ 3 n’etinyeghị ha azụ. Ọ bụrụ na bọọlụ mbụ bụ ọcha, chọta ohere na nke abụọ bụ ọcha; jiri nke a dee ihe mere X enweghị ike ịbụ B(3,3/5) n’ọnọdụ a. (3 3)
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.hint.0: Dee bọọlụ ole fọdụrụ n’igbe na bọọlụ ọcha ole fọdụrụ mgbe e dọpụtara nke mbụ.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tinye ohere ahụ n’akụkụ ohere nke ịdọpụta nke mbụ, tụnyere ha.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.placeholder: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na nke mbụ bụ ọcha, bọọlụ fọdụrụ bụ ...
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị gụrụ bọọlụ fọdụrụ (4) na nke ọcha (2) n’onwe gị?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị nwere ike ikwu otú mgbanwe ohere si jikọta na “ha anaghị akwụghị onwe ha”?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị nwere ike ịkọwa ihe na-eme ma e tinye bọọlụ ndị ahụ azụ?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na nke mbụ bụ ọcha, n’ime bọọlụ 4 fọdụrụ, 2 bụ ọcha; ya mere ohere bụ 2/4=1/2. Ọ dị iche na 3/5 mbụ, ya mere ọnọdụ ohere ahụ ịdị otu oge ọ bụla dara; nkesa ahụ abụghị B(3,3/5). (3 3)
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na e tinyeghị bọọlụ azụ, nsonaazụ ịdọpụta mbụ na-agbanwe ohere nke ọzọ. Ọ bụrụ na e dọpụtara ọcha mbụ, ohere nke ọzọ ịbụ ọcha bụ 2 n’ime 4 (0.5), dị iche na 3/5; ya mere nnwale ndị ahụ anaghị akwụghị onwe ha, ọ pụghịkwa ịbụ nkesa binomial.

n-m-h3-dist-03.title: Egwuregwu abụọ nwere otu mean: mgbasa ha hà nhata kwa?
n-m-h3-dist-03.topic: Nkesa probability: variance nke nchikọta na nke otutu variable random
n-m-h3-dist-03.goal: Tụnyere nkesa n’onwe ya iji kpebie ma otu mean ọ pụtara otu mgbasa. Kọwaa ihe kpatara ya site na variance.
n-m-h3-dist-03.material: Ka X bụrụ ọnụọgụ pụtara mgbe a tụgharịrị dice nwere akụkụ isii. Egwuregwu abụọ dị: n’Egwuregwu A, tụgharịa ya otu ugboro, akara bụ okpukpu abụọ nke ọnụọgụ pụtara (2X); n’Egwuregwu B, tụgharịa ya ugboro abụọ, akara bụ nchikọta ọnụọgụ abụọ ahụ (X₁+X₂).
