Mean akara ha abụọ bụ isi 7. Youngsu kwuru, “Ebe mean hà nhata, mgbasa akara kwesịrị ịdịkwa otu.”
n-m-h3-dist-03.thinking.0: Họrọ ụzọ ntụnyere na-anwale nkwupụta ahụ.
n-m-h3-dist-03.thinking.1: Jiri probability akọwapụtara wuo ihe akaebe maka ihe atụ na-agbagha.
n-m-h3-dist-03.thinking.2: Jiri iwu variance si agbanwe mee nchịkọta izugbe.
n-m-h3-dist-03.prereq.0: Uru a tụrụ anya ya na variance nke variable random discrete
n-m-h3-dist-03.prereq.1: Variance nke nchikọta variable random abụọ anaghị emetụta ibe ha: V(X+Y)=V(X)+V(Y)
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.prompt: Olee ntụnyere kacha dabara adaba iji nwalee nkwupụta Youngsu?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nkwupụta Youngsu na-ekwu maka “mgbasa,” ọ bụghị mean. Data dị aṅaa ga-egosi nke ahụ?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.hint.1: Maka nhọrọ nke ọ bụla, chee ma ọ ga-ekpughe ọdịiche n’etiti egwuregwu abụọ ahụ.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.a: Gbakọọ ọzọ iji lelee na mean egwuregwu abụọ ahụ bụ n’ezie isi 7.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.a: E nyelarị na mean ha hà nhata. Ịlele otu uru ahụ ọzọ agaghị agwa gị banyere mgbasa.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.b: Jiri eziokwu na mean otu ntụgharị dice bụ 3.5 tụnyere egwuregwu abụọ ahụ.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.b: Nke a na-agwa naanị na mean isi 7 n’egwuregwu abụọ sitere n’uru a. Ọ naghị ekpughe mgbasa.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.c: Dee akara nwere ike ịpụta na egwuregwu abụọ ahụ na probability nke akara ọ bụla n’akụkụ ibe ha.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.c: Ị na-atụnyere nkesa akara dum. Nke a na-egosi ozugbo ma ọdịdị nkesa nwere ike ịdị iche ọbụna ma mean hà nhata.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.d: Tụgharịa dice ọtụtụ ugboro, lelee ma mean akara egwuregwu abụọ ahụ na-abịaru isi 7 nso.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.d: Nke a na-egosi ma mean na-agbakọta nso 7, ma ọ naghị agwa gị ihe gbasara mgbasa.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.explain: Mean bụ nchịkọta nkesa n’otu uru. I tinye akara na probability ha n’akụkụ ibe ha, ị ga-ahụ ma ọdịdị nkesa nwere ike ịdị iche n’agbanyeghị mean hà nhata. Ịgụ mean ọzọ ma ọ bụ ile naanị ma ọ na-agbakọta nso mean anaghị anwale nkwupụta Youngsu.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.prompt: Chọta probability akara bụ 2 ma ọ bụ 12 n’egwuregwu nke ọ bụla (ngụkọta ohere abụọ ahụ), kọwaa na nkwupụta Youngsu ezighi ezi.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.hint.0: Dee nọmba dice na-enye isi 2 na 12 n’Egwuregwu A.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.hint.1: N’Egwuregwu B, gụọ ụzọ abụọ a haziri nke ọnụọgụ abụọ na-enye isi 2 ma ọ bụ 12; chọta ole n’ime nsonaazụ 36 ha bụ.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.placeholder: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, n’Egwuregwu A iji nweta isi 2 ...
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị gụrụ ụzọ abụọ a haziri ga-enye isi 2 na 12 n’Egwuregwu B n’onwe gị?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: I nwere ike ikwu na ọdịdị nkesa nwere ike ịdị iche ọbụna ma mean hà nhata?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: I nwere ike ịkọwa etu ọdịiche probability abụọ ahụ si egosi ọdịiche mgbasa?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.model.0: N’Egwuregwu A, ịtụ 1 ma ọ bụ 6 na-enye isi 2 ma ọ bụ 12, ya bụ 2/6=1/3. N’Egwuregwu B, naanị nsonaazụ abụọ bụ (1,1) na (6,6), ya bụ 2/36=1/18. Ọbụna ma mean hà nhata, ohere akara oke dị iche nke ukwuu; ya mere mgbasa ha abụghị otu.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.model.1: Ohere inweta isi 2 ma ọ bụ 12 bụ otu ụzọ n’ime atọ na A, otu ụzọ n’ime iri na asatọ na B. Ọ bụ ezie na mean ha abụọ bụ 7, A na-enye akara oke ọtụtụ ugboro karịa, ya mere variance dị iche.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.prompt: Ka V bụrụ variance nke ọnụọgụ X pụtara n’otu ntụgharị dice. Gịnị bụ variance akara 2X nke Egwuregwu A na X₁+X₂ nke Egwuregwu B (ntụgharị abụọ ahụ anaghị emetụta ibe ha)?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.hint.0: 2X bụ otu nsonaazụ e mụbara okpukpu abụọ; X₁+X₂ bụ nchikọta nsonaazụ abụọ dị iche. Chee ha iche.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.hint.1: Tinye ọnụọgụ dị mfe maka V (dịka V=1), chọta variance abụọ maka nhọrọ nke ọ bụla, lelee ma ha kwekọrọ na mgbasa egwuregwu abụọ i hụrụ n’usoro gara aga.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.a: I were 2X dịka “X gbakwunyere ugboro abụọ.” Ịgbakwunye otu uru ahụ ugboro abụọ dị iche na ịgbakwunye nsonaazụ ntụgharị abụọ dị iche.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.b: Maka 2X, uru ọ bụla mụbara okpukpu abụọ, ya mere variance mụbara na 2². Maka nchikọta nsonaazụ abụọ nọọrọ onwe ha, variance na-agbakọta, ya bụ okpukpu 2.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.c: I tinyere iwu na ịmụba na constant na-eme ka variance mụbaa na square factor n’ime nchikọta ntụgharị abụọ kwa. Maka nchikọta nọọrọ onwe ha, variance na-agbakọta naanị.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.d: I gbanwere variance nke otutu na nke nchikọta.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.explain: V(2X)=2²V=4V; maka nchikọta variable random abụọ nọọrọ onwe ha, V(X₁+X₂)=V+V=2V. Mean ha abụọ bụ 7, ma variance dị iche: 4V na 2V. (Variance otu ntụgharị dice bụ V=35/12, ya mere ha bụ 35/3 na 35/6.)

n-m-h3-dist-04.title: Uru a tụrụ anya ya ọ bụ uru na-apụta ọtụtụ ugboro?
n-m-h3-dist-04.topic: Nkesa probability: ihe uru a tụrụ anya ya pụtara
n-m-h3-dist-04.goal: Hazie nkọwa na ihe uru a tụrụ anya ya pụtara. Mepụta ma lelee nkesa ebe uru a tụrụ anya ya abụghị uru nwere ike ịpụta, ọ bụghịkwa uru nwere probability kacha ukwuu.
n-m-h3-dist-04.material: E nwere variable random X nwere uru 0,1,2. Ozugbo i kpebiri probability atọ ahụ na tebụl nkesa, a na-ekpebi expected value E(X). (0 1)
n-m-h3-dist-04.thinking.0: Hazie nkwupụta gbasara expected value ka ọ bụrụ eziokwu na ụgha.
n-m-h3-dist-04.thinking.1: Mepụta nkesa mezuru ọnọdụ, jiri ya dịka ihe atụ na-agbagha.
n-m-h3-dist-04.prereq.0: Tebụl nkesa probability nke variable random discrete
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nkwupụta ziri ezi niile gbasara expected value E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.hint.0: Maka nkwupụta nke ọ bụla, chee ma i nwere ike ịnwale ya site n’ime tebụl nkesa probability.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.hint.1: Buru ụzọ nwalee nkesa dị mfe ebe uru bụ naanị 0 na 1, probability ha hà nhata.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.a: E(X) bụ otu n’ime uru X nwere ike inweta.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna ma X na-ewere naanị ọnụọgụ integer, E(X) nwere ike ịbụ ọnụọgụ ntụpọ. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, mean isi pụtara n’ịtụ mkpụrụ ego nwere ike ịbụ 0.5.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.b: E(X) bụ ngụkọta uru nke ọ bụla mụbara na probability ya.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.b: I kwuru nkọwa ahụ nke ọma.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.c: E(X) bụ uru X nwere probability kacha ukwuu.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.c: I were expected value na “uru nwere probability kacha ukwuu” dịka otu ihe. Uru yikarịrị bụ echiche dị iche, ha abụọ na-adịkarị iche.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.d: Ọ bụrụ na a na-eme nnwale ọtụtụ ugboro, mean uru a hụrụ na-agbakọta nso E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.d: I kọwara nke ọma ebe mean na-akwụsị ka nnwale na-emegharị.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.explain: E(X) bụ nchikọta uru×probability, ọ bụkwa uru mean na-abịaru mgbe a na-eme nnwale ọtụtụ ugboro. Enweghị nkwa na ọ bụ uru X nwere ike iburu, enweghịkwa nkwa na ọ bụ uru nwere probability kacha ukwuu.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.prompt: Ka X were uru 0,1,2. Họrọ probability ha dịka pasent integer (p0,p1,p2). Ọnọdụ: ① probability atọ ọ bụla dịkarịa ala 1%, ngụkọta 100% ② naanị uru nwere probability kacha ukwuu bụ 2 ③ E(X)≤1.2 (expected value dịkarịa ala 0.8 ala karịa 2, uru yikarịrị). Mepụta ihe atụ 3 dị iche (p2 dị iche). (0 1)
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ họrọ p0,p1,p2 nke ngụkọta ha bụ 100, mee p2 ka ọ bụrụ nke kacha ukwuu.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.1: Gbakọọ E(X)=(p1+2·p2)/100, lelee ma ọ bụ 1.2 ma ọ bụ ala. Ọ bụrụ na o buru ibu, nwaa ịbawanye p0 ma ọ bụ p1.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.2: Gbanwee p2 ka ọ bụrụ uru dị iche dịka 45 na 39, họrọ p0 na p1 ọzọ oge ọ bụla.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Probability bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu pasent dịkarịa ala 1%, ngụkọta ha bụ 100%.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Probability atọ ahụ ga-abụ ọnụọgụ integer pasent dịkarịa ala 1%, ngụkọta ha ga-abụ 100%.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Naanị uru 2 nwere probability kacha ukwuu.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.fail.c2: P(X=2) ga-adị ukwuu karịa probability abụọ ndị ọzọ (ọ gaghị ha nhata na nke ọ bụla).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.ok.c3: E(X) bụ 1.2 ma ọ bụ ala karịa.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.explain: E(X)=(p1+2·p2)/100. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, maka (40,15,45), E(X)=1.05, uru nwere probability kacha ukwuu bụ 2. E(X)=1.05 abụghị uru X nwere ike iburu, ọ dịkwa iche na 2. Ihe atụ ndị na-agbanwe naanị usoro (p0,p1,p2) agaghị agụta dịka ihe atụ dị iche. (15 40)
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.prompt: Họrọ otu ihe atụ gị, jiri ọnụọgụ ya kọwaa ihe mere o ji ezighi ezi ịgụ E(X) dịka “uru na-apụta ọtụtụ ugboro” ma ọ bụ “uru na-apụta n’ezie.”
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.hint.0: Chọta E(X) maka ihe atụ gị, tụnyere ya na uru X nwere ike ịbụ: 0,1,2. (0 1)
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.hint.1: Dee etu uru nwere probability kacha ukwuu si metụta E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị gbakọrọ E(X) n’onwe gị maka ihe atụ i họọrọ?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: I kwuru ihe mere E(X) ji bụrụ uru na-apụghị ime n’ezie?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: I kwuru etu uru probability ya kacha ukwuu si dị iche na E(X)?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.0: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, maka (40,15,45), E(X)=0.15+0.9=1.05. Nke a abụghị uru X nwere ike iburu, uru nwere probability kacha ukwuu bụ 2. Ya mere E(X) abụghị uru na-apụta ọtụtụ ugboro, ọ bụghịkwa uru nwere ike ịpụta. (15 40)
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.1: Maka (37,24,39), E(X)=1.02, ma X nwere ike ịbụ naanị 0,1,2; ya mere 1.02 agaghị apụta. Uru nwere probability kacha ukwuu bụ 2, na 39%, ọ dị iche na expected value. (0 1 24 37)
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.2: Maka (25,36,39), E(X)=1.14 abụghị uru X nwere ike iburu, ọ dịkwa iche na 2, uru yikarịrị. (25 36)

n-m-h3-dist-05.title: Ọ bụrụ Probability bụ 0, ọ pụtara n’ezie na ihe agaghị eme?
n-m-h3-dist-05.topic: Nkesa probability: probability nke otu isi maka variable random continuous
n-m-h3-dist-05.goal: Kpebie ma uru nwere ike ịpụta mgbe probability otu isi ya bụ 0 n’ime variable random continuous. Kọwaa mkpebi ahụ na mmetụta itinye ma ọ bụ iwepụ nsọtụ, n’okwu enyi ga-aghọta.
n-m-h3-dist-05.material: Ụgbọ ala bọs nwere otu ohere ịbịa n’oge ọ bụla n’etiti ugbu a na nkeji 10. Oge ichere X (nkeji) nwere ike ịbụ uru ọ bụla site na 0 ruo 10 tinyere nsọtụ. Probability oge dị n’etiti kwekọrọ n’ogologo ya: P(a≤X≤b)=(b−a)/10. Jia dere ihe ndị a. (0)
n-m-h3-dist-05.thinking.1: Jiri okwu na ihe atụ dị mfe kọwaa echiche siri ike.
n-m-h3-dist-05.thinking.2: Kpebie ma itinye ma ọ bụ iwepụ nsọtụ ọ̀ na-agbanwe probability.
n-m-h3-dist-05.prereq.0: Ihe continuous random variable na probability density function pụtara (probability bụ mpaghara n’elu oge)
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị ezighi ezi n’ihe Jia dere.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.hint.0: Lelee n’usoro ma ahịrị nke ọ bụla esite n’ụzọ ziri ezi n’ahịrị bu ya ụzọ.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.hint.1: Chọta ahịrị na-ekwu “probability bụ 0” na “ọ gaghị eme.” Nyochaa ma njikọ echiche dị n’etiti ha ziri ezi site n’iche banyere bọs na-abịa n’ezie.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.0: X nwere ike ịbụ uru ọ bụla site na 0 ruo 10, P(a≤X≤b)=(b−a)/10.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.1: P(X=4) bụ probability nke oge ogologo ya bụ 0; ya mere (4−4)/10=0.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.2: Ebe probability bụ 0, bọs ịbịa kpọmkwem na nkeji 4 agaghị ekwe omume.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 3 ezighi ezi. Maka variable random continuous, ọbụna ma probability otu isi bụ 0, nke ahụ apụtaghị na uru ahụ agaghị ekwe omume. E nwere uru enweghị njedebe n’etiti 0 na 10, nke ọ bụla nwere probability 0, ma uru ụfọdụ ka na-apụta. Ahịrị 4 na 5 ziri ezi.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.prompt: Dee Jia ozi ederede na-akọwa. Kwuo akụkụ echiche ya a ga-edozi, tụnyere P(X≤4) na P(X<4) site n’okwu dị mfe na ihe atụ.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.hint.0: Chee obere ohere ịhọrọ kpọmkwem otu uru n’etiti 0 na 10.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kwughachi otu echiche ahụ dịka mpaghara: mpaghara otu ahịrị na-enweghị obosara bụ ole?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.placeholder: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, probability ịbịa kpọmkwem na nkeji 4 bụ ...
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: I jiri okwu na ihe atụ enyi ụlọ akwụkwọ etiti ga-aghọta?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: I kwuru na “probability 0” apụtaghị “agaghị ekwe omume”?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: I kwuru ihe mere probability ji bụrụ otu ma e tinye nsọtụ ma ọ bụ na etinyeghị?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.0: E nwere uru enweghị njedebe n’etiti nkeji 0 na 10, ya mere ohere ịbịa kpọmkwem na nkeji 4 pere mpe nke ukwuu, nso 0 nke na ọ na-abụ 0. Ma nke ahụ apụtaghị na bọs agaghị abịa na nkeji 4; ọ na-abịa n’oge ụfọdụ. Ma e tinyere nkeji 4 ma ọ bụ na etinyeghị, probability ọ na-agbakwunye bụ 0; ya mere P(X≤4) na P(X<4) hà nhata.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.1: Ebe nkesa na-aga n’ihu, ọbụna ma otu isi nwere probability 0, bọs ka nwere ike ịbịa n’oge ahụ. Ọ dị ka isi n’ahịrị nwere mpaghara 0 ma ahịrị ahụ ka nwere isi. Itinye ma ọ bụ iwepụ otu isi anaghị agbanwe probability; ya mere P(X≤4)=P(X<4)=0.4.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.2: P(X=4)=0, ma oge mbata bụ otu uru akọwapụtara; ya mere ọ gaghị ekwe omume ka uru ahụ pụta abụghị eziokwu. Otu isi enweghị obosara, ya mere itinye ma ọ bụ iwepụ ya anaghị agbanwe probability; probability abụọ hà nhata.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.prompt: N’ime ndị a, nke ziri ezi?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.hint.0: Chee etu nkwupụta nke ọ bụla si dabere na uru P(X=a).
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.hint.1: Maka dice X (discrete), chọta P(X≤3) na P(X<3), tụnyere ha.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.a: Ọbụna maka variable random continuous, P(X≤a) na-adịkarị ukwuu karịa P(X<a).
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.a: I chere na “≤” gụnyere ọnọdụ karịa, ya mere probability ga-akarị. Maka variable continuous, probability otu isi bụ 0; ya mere ha hà nhata.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.b: Maka variable random continuous, ọ bụrụ P(X=a)=0, X agaghị abụ a.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.b: I were probability 0 dịka “agaghị ekwe omume.” Maka variable continuous, uru nwere probability 0 ka nwere ike ịpụta n’ezie.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.c: Maka variable random continuous, probability bụ otu ma e tinye ma ọ bụ ewepụ nsọtụ oge.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.c: Probability otu isi bụ 0, ya mere itinye ma ọ bụ iwepụ nsọtụ anaghị agbanwe probability.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.d: Maka variable random discrete kwa, P(X≤a)=P(X<a) na-adị mgbe niile.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.d: Maka variable discrete, P(X=a) nwere ike ghara ịbụ 0; ya mere ha nwere ike ghara ịdị nhata.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.explain: Maka variable continuous, P(X=a)=0; ya mere P(a≤X≤b)=P(a<X<b)=P(a≤X<b)=P(a<X≤b). Maka variable discrete, P(X=a)>0 nwere ike ịdị; ya mere itinye ma ọ bụ iwepụ nsọtụ nwere ike ịgbanwe probability.

n-m-h3-dist-07.title: Iwu Nkesa Binomial site n'Nkezi na Ọdịiche
n-m-h3-dist-07.topic: Nkesa puru ihe: nkezi na ọdịiche nke nkesa binomial
n-m-h3-dist-07.goal: Jiri mmekọrịta dị n'etiti nkezi na ọdịiche nke nkesa binomial wepụ nchikota ndị na-ekwe omume, ma wuo nkesa binomial na-emezu ọnọdụ e nyere iji chọta iwu.
n-m-h3-dist-07.material: Ị chọrọ ịkọwa ụfọdụ data site n'nkesa binomial B(n,p). Ebe a n bụ ọnụọgụ okike ma p bụ ọnụọgụ n'etiti 0 na 1. Nkezi nke nkesa binomial bụ np ma ọdịiche bụ np(1−p).
n-m-h3-dist-07.thinking.0: Lelee ọnọdụ zoro ezo (n bụ ọnụọgụ okike, 0<p<1)
n-m-h3-dist-07.thinking.1: Wuo ihe atụ nke gị nke na-emezu ọnọdụ ma chọta iwu
n-m-h3-dist-07.prereq.0: Nkezi np na ọdịiche np(1−p) nke nkesa binomial B(n, p)
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.prompt: Kedu n'ime ụzọ nkezi na ọdịiche ndị a nwere ike ịdị n'ezie maka nkesa binomial B(n, p)?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.hint.0: Debe nkezi hà nhata np na ọdịiche hà nhata np(1−p), wee lee ihe fọdụrụ mgbe ị kewara ọdịiche site na nkezi.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.hint.1: Lelee maka nhọrọ ọ bụla ma p ị chọtara dị n'etiti 0 na 1 ma n bụ ọnụọgụ okike.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.a: Ebe a ọdịiche buru ibu karịa nkezi. Ebe ọdịiche bụ np(1−p), ọ pụghị ịkarịa nkezi np.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na ị chọta p ma n=np÷p, n abụghị ọnụọgụ okike. I leghaara anya n'ọnọdụ na n bụ ọnụọgụ okike.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na ọdịiche hà nhata nkezi, mgbe ahụ 1−p=1, yabụ p=0. Mgbe ahụ nkezi ga-abụ 0, nke na-adabaghị.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.d: Ọdịiche ÷ nkezi = 1−p na-ekpebi p, ma n na-apụtakwa dị ka ọnụọgụ okike, yabụ nke a ga-ekwe omume.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.explain: Ọdịiche ÷ nkezi = 1−p. Maka (8, 6), 1−p=3/4, p=1/4, na n=8÷(1/4)=32, yabụ ọ ga-ekwe omume. Maka (10, 12), 1−p>1 yabụ p<0; maka (8, 5), p=3/8 na n=64/3, nke abụghị ọnụọgụ okike; ma maka (6, 6), p=0.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.prompt: Wuo nkesa binomial B(n, p) 3 dị iche nwere nkezi 12 na ọdịiche opekata mpe 8. Dee n dị ka ọnụọgụ okike ma p dị ka pasent ọnụọgụ zuru ezu (p%). (dịka ọmụmaatụ maka p=25%, dee 25)
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.hint.0: Malite site n'ide ụzọ n na p na-emezu nkezi np=12 (p dị ka pasent ọnụọgụ zuru ezu).
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.hint.1: Maka ụzọ ọ bụla, gbakọọ ọdịiche 12(1−p) ma lelee ma ọ bụ opekata mpe 8.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.var.q: Puru ihe ịga nke ọma p (%)
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.ok.c1: n bụ ọnụọgụ okike ma p dị n'etiti 1% na 99%.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.fail.c1: n ga-abụ ọnụọgụ okike ma p ga-abụ pasent ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na 1 ruo 99.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.explain: Site n'np=12, p=q/100. Ka ọdịiche np(1−p)=12(1−p) bụrụ opekata mpe 8, p ga-abụ opekata mpe 1/3. Ihe atụ ebe n na p abụọ dabara n'ọnọdụ ndị ahụ bụ (30, 40%), (25, 48%), (24, 50%), (20, 60%), (16, 75%), na (15, 80%).
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.prompt: Ilele nkesa atọ gị, dee mmekọrịta dị n'etiti p na ọdịiche mgbe nkezi hà nhata.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.hint.0: Dee p na ọdịiche maka nkesa atọ ahụ n'akụkụ ibe ha, dị ka tebụl.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.hint.1: Lee ma ọdịiche na-abawanye ma ọ bụ na-ebelata ka p na-abawanye.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.placeholder: dịka ọmụmaatụ, Mgbe nkezi bụ otu, 12, ka p na-abawanye ọdịiche ...
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị gbakọrọ n'ezie ọdịiche nke nkesa atọ ahụ?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị kwuru mmekọrịta dị n'etiti p na ọdịiche tinyere ọnọdụ na nkezi hà nhata?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ị jiri eziokwu na enwere ike ide ọdịiche dị ka 12(1−p)?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.model.0: Mgbe nkezi np bụ otu, 12, ọdịiche bụ 12(1−p), yabụ ka p buru ibu, ka ọdịiche pere mpe. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, p=40% na-enye 7.2 ma p=75% na-enye 3.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.model.1: Nkesa atọ ahụ niile nwere nkezi 12, ma ọdịiche belatara ka p na-abawanye. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, 6 mgbe p=50% na 2.4 mgbe p=80%: ka puru ihe ịga nke ọma dị elu, ka ọ na-agbasa ntakịrị.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.model.2: Mgbe nkezi hà nhata, ka p buru ibu, ka ọdịiche 12(1-p) na-adị ntakịrị.

n-m-h3-dist-08.title: Azịza Nyere Puru Ihe 2: Ahịrị Kedu Gbagoro?
n-m-h3-dist-08.topic: Nkesa puru ihe: domain nke ọrụ njupụta puru ihe
n-m-h3-dist-08.goal: Ghọta na ị pụghị ijikọta n'èzí oge ebe ọrụ njupụta puru ihe abụghị efu, chọta ahịrị gbagoro, ma chọta puru ihe ziri ezi.
n-m-h3-dist-08.material: Mgbanwe na-aga n'ihu X nwere ọrụ njupụta puru ihe f(x)=kx (0≤x≤2), ma f(x)=0 maka x ndị ọzọ niile. Nke a bụ azịza Minjun maka ichọta ihe kwụsiri ike k na P(1≤X≤3).
n-m-h3-dist-08.thinking.0: Chọta ahịrị mbụ n'azịza nke na-agbagọ
n-m-h3-dist-08.thinking.1: Lelee ma nsonaazụ dị n'oke puru ihe nwere ike ịbụ
n-m-h3-dist-08.prereq.0: Àgwà nke ọrụ njupụta puru ihe (mpaghara niile bụ 1)
n-m-h3-dist-08.prereq.1: Integral kpọmkwem ma ọ bụ mpaghara nke udi
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighi ezi n'azịza Minjun.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.hint.0: Lelee site n'elu ma ahịrị ọ bụla sitere n'ụzọ ziri ezi n'ahịrị tupu ya.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.hint.1: Maka ahịrị ọ bụla, tụnyere eserese e ji n'oge x ahụ na f(x) e nyere n'nsogbu ahụ.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.line.0: f(x)=kx (0≤x≤2) na f(x)=0 n'ebe ọzọ, ma mpaghara niile bụ 1.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.line.2: P(1≤X≤3) bụ mpaghara dị n'etiti eserese y=x/2 na x-axis site na x=1 ruo x=3.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 3 na-ezighi ezi. Maka ọrụ njupụta puru ihe, f(x)=0 mgbe x buru ibu karịa 2, yabụ a na-eji eserese y=x/2 naanị ruo x=2. Yabụ ekwesịghị ịgbakwunye mpaghara site na x=2 ruo 3. Ahịrị 4 na 5 na-ebu naanị oge na-ezighi ezi site n'ahịrị 3.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.prompt: Dozie ahịrị na-ezighi ezi ma chọta uru P(1≤X≤3). Dekwa ihe mere azịza Minjun nke 2 enweghị ike ịbụ puru ihe.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ sere ebe eserese ahụ abụghị efu.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.hint.1: Chee oke uru puru ihe nwere ike inwe.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.placeholder: dịka ọmụmaatụ, f(x) abụghị efu naanị mgbe x bụ ..., yabụ ...
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị lelere oge ebe f(x) abụghị efu tupu ịdozi?
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị gbakọrọ 3/4 n'onwe gị (site n'ijikọta ma ọ bụ dị ka trapezoid)?
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị lelere azịza gị site n'iji eziokwu na puru ihe enweghị ike ịkarịa 1?
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe x buru ibu karịa 2, f(x)=0, yabụ ị chọrọ ịgbakọ naanị site na x=1 ruo 2, ma mpaghara bụ (1/2)×(1/2+1)×1=3/4. Azịza Minjun nke 2 enweghị ike ịdị n'ihi na puru ihe enweghị ike ịbụ nke buru ibu karịa 1, ma ọ karịrị 1.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.model.1: P(1≤X≤3)=P(1≤X≤2)=∫₁² x/2 dx=3/4. Ebe mpaghara niile bụ 1, mpaghara oge enweghị ike ịbụ 2.

n-m-h3-prob-01.thinking.0: Chọta ahịrị mbụ n'azịza nke na-agbagọ
n-m-h3-prob-01.title: Opekata Mpe Otu Bụ Nwa Nwanyị: Kedu Probability Na Abụọ Bụ Ụmụ Nwanyị?
n-m-h3-prob-01.topic: Probability: conditional probability, ịnọ onwe na ịdabere, echiche udi Bayes, ịtọ sample space
n-m-h3-prob-01.goal: N'ngwọta conditional probability, chọta ma dozie ebe a gụrụ ikpe ndị na-enweghị otu ohere dịka ndị nwere otu ohere, ma kwenye na ikpe fọdụrụ na-agbanwe dabere n'otu e si kwuo ọnọdụ ahụ.
n-m-h3-prob-01.material: Naanị ihe anyị maara bụ na ezinụlọ nwere ụmụ abụọ. Nwa ọ bụla bụ nwa nwanyị site na probability 1/2, anyị na-ewerekwa na mkpụrụ ụmụ abụọ ahụ anaghị emetụta ibe ha. Seungwoo dozie "probability na ụmụ abụọ ahụ bụ ụmụ nwanyị, ebe opekata mpe otu bụ nwa nwanyị" dịka e gosiri n'okpuru.
n-m-h3-prob-01.thinking.1: Wughachi sample space site n'ikpe a pụrụ ịkewa
n-m-h3-prob-01.thinking.2: Tụnyere probabilities na-agbanwe site n'otu e si kwuo ọnọdụ ahụ
n-m-h3-prob-01.prereq.0: Ihe conditional probability pụtara (oke nke ikpe ụfọdụ n'etiti ikpe kwekọrọ n'ọnọdụ ahụ)
n-m-h3-prob-01.prereq.1: Ịgụ nsonaazụ mgbe a na-ekewa usoro
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n'ngwọta Seungwoo.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.hint.0: Lelee site n'elu, otu ahịrị n'otu oge, ma ahịrị ọ bụla sitere n'ahịrị tupu ya nke ọma.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.hint.1: Dee ikpe ndị a na-akpọ "nwere otu ohere" n'onwe gị, na-ekewa nwa mbụ na nwa nke abụọ, ma tụnyere ma ha hà otu nha n'ezie.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.0: N'okpuru ọnọdụ na opekata mpe otu n'ụmụ abụọ bụ nwa nwanyị, chọta probability na ụmụ abụọ ahụ bụ ụmụ nwanyị.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.1: Nhazi nke ụmụ abụọ ahụ bụ otu n'ụdị atọ, "ụmụ nwanyị 2," "nwa nwanyị 1 na nwa nwoke 1," na "ụmụ nwoke 2," ụdị atọ ahụ nwekwara otu ohere.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.2: Iwepụ "ụmụ nwoke 2," nke na-akwekọghị n'ọnọdụ na opekata mpe otu bụ nwa nwanyị, na-ahapụ ụdị abụọ.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.3: N'ụdị abụọ fọdụrụ, e nwere otu ebe ụmụ abụọ ahụ bụ ụmụ nwanyị.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 2 bụ ebe mbụ na-agbaji. "Nwa nwanyị 1 na nwa nwoke 1" nwere ma ikpe ebe nwa mbụ bụ nwa nwanyị ma ikpe ebe nwa nke abụọ bụ nwa nwanyị, ya mere mgbe a kewara nke mbụ na nke abụọ, ọ naghị enwe otu ohere na "ụmụ nwanyị 2" ma ọ bụ "ụmụ nwoke 2." Ahịrị 3 ruo 5 na-eso ụdị atọ site n'ahịrị 2 n'ịtụkwasị obi, ya mere mgbakọ dị n'ime ha ziri ezi ma nsonaazụ ezighị ezi.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.prompt: Jiri ngwọta e dozitere, chọta probability na ụmụ abụọ ahụ bụ ụmụ nwanyị, ma dee ihe mere uru ahụ ji dị iche na nke Seungwoo. (Nwa ọ bụla bụ nwa nwanyị site na probability 1/2, a na-ewerekwa na abụọ ahụ anaghị emetụta ibe ha.)
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kewaa ụmụ ahụ dịka nke mbụ na nke abụọ, ma dee nchikota niile nke mmekọahụ. Ole ka e nwere, ha ọ̀ nwere otu ohere?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.hint.1: Gụọ naanị ikpe ndị kwekọrọ n'ọnọdụ ahụ, ma tụnyere ole n'ime ha nwere ụmụ nwanyị abụọ.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.placeholder: dịka, Ọ bụrụ na anyị ekewa nwa mbụ na nke abụọ, ...
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ depụtara ikpe niile ga-ekwe omume, na-ekewa nwa mbụ na nke abụọ?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ debere naanị ikpe ndị kwekọrọ n'ọnọdụ ahụ ma chọta oke ikpe nwanyị abụọ n'etiti ha?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ kwuru na "nwa nwanyị 1 na nwa nwoke 1" abụghị otu ikpe?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na anyị ekewa nwa mbụ na nke abụọ, (nwa nwanyị, nwa nwanyị), (nwa nwanyị, nwa nwoke), (nwa nwoke, nwa nwanyị), na (nwa nwoke, nwa nwoke) niile nwere otu ohere. N'ikpe 3 ebe opekata mpe otu bụ nwa nwanyị, 1 nwere ụmụ nwanyị abụọ, ya mere probability bụ 1/3.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.model.1: Otu nwa nwanyị na otu nwa nwoke na-ekewa n'ikpe abụọ, (nke mbụ nwa nwanyị, nke abụọ nwa nwoke) na (nke mbụ nwa nwoke, nke abụọ nwa nwanyị), ya mere a ghaghị ịgụ ya dịka otu ikpe. Ya mere e nwere ikpe 3 kwekọrọ n'ọnọdụ ahụ, naanị otu n'ime ha nwere ụmụ nwanyị abụọ, ya mere probability bụ otu n'ụzọ atọ.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ịdepụta site n'iji akara dịka G na B dị mma.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na ọnọdụ ahụ abụghị "opekata mpe otu bụ nwa nwanyị" kama "nwa mbụ bụ nwa nwanyị," kedu probability ga-abụ na ụmụ abụọ ahụ bụ ụmụ nwanyị?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.hint.0: Dee ikpe ndị fọdụrụ n'okpuru ọnọdụ a, na-ekewa nwa mbụ na nke abụọ.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.hint.1: Tinye ndepụta ikpe ndị fọdụrụ site n'nsogbu gara aga n'akụkụ ndepụta a ma chọta ihe gbanwere.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.a: Ị gụrụ ikpe ndị kwekọrọ n'ọnọdụ ahụ n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi, ma ọ bụ ị gwakọtara "opekata mpe otu nwa nwanyị" na "ụmụ nwanyị abụọ."
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.b: Ị nyere probability n'elu ihe niile mbụ n'ejighị ọnọdụ ahụ. Mgbe e nwere ọnọdụ, ikpe ndị fọdụrụ na-agbanwe.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.c: Ị lere ọnọdụ nke nsogbu gara aga na nke a dịka otu. Oge a naanị mmekọahụ nwa nke abụọ ka a hapụrụ ọtọ.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.explain: Ọ bụrụ na nwa mbụ bụ nwa nwanyị, ikpe ndị fọdụrụ bụ (nwa nwanyị, nwa nwanyị) na (nwa nwanyị, nwa nwoke), ndị nwere otu ohere. N'ime ha, otu nwere ụmụ nwanyị abụọ, ya mere probability bụ 1/2. "Opekata mpe otu bụ nwa nwanyị" na-ekwekwa (nwa nwoke, nwa nwanyị), ya mere e nwere ikpe 3 fọdụrụ na probability bụ 1/3. Sample space fọdụrụ na-adabere n'otu e si kwuo ọnọdụ ahụ.

n-m-h3-est-01.title: Ilele Azịza maka Puru Ihe na Karama 9 Nwere Nkezi Opekata mpe 503 mL
n-m-h3-est-01.topic: Atụmatụ ọnụ ọgụgụ: nkesa nke nkezi nlele
n-m-h3-est-01.goal: Tụnyere nkezi na ọdịiche ụkpụrụ nke nkesa nkezi nlele na uru ndị ọnụ ọgụgụ zuru ezu, chọta ma dozie ahịrị na-ezighi ezi n'azịza, ma kọwaa ihe mere puru ihe maka nkezi nlele ji dị iche na puru ihe maka uru otu.
n-m-h3-est-01.material: N'ụlọ ọrụ ihe ọṅụṅụ, olu nke otu karama na-eso nkesa nkịtị nwere nkezi 500 mL na ọdịiche ụkpụrụ 6 mL. Haeun, onye na-arụ ọrụ n'nlekọta àgwà, wepụtara karama 9 n'enweghị usoro ma chọta puru ihe na nkezi olu X̄ bụ opekata mpe 503 mL. Akụkụ nke tebụl nkịtị ụkpụrụ: P(0≤Z≤0.5)=0.1915, P(0≤Z≤1.5)=0.4332, P(0≤Z≤3)=0.4987. (Z bụ mgbanwe ọbịbịa na-eso nkesa nkịtị nwere nkezi 0 na ọdịiche ụkpụrụ 1.)
n-m-h3-est-01.thinking.0: Gụọ nke ọma iji kewaa otu uru na nkezi nlele
n-m-h3-est-01.thinking.1: Tụnyere nkezi na ọdịiche ụkpụrụ nke nkezi nlele na uru ndị ọnụ ọgụgụ zuru ezu
n-m-h3-est-01.thinking.2: Kọwaa otú puru ihe e dozichara si dị iche, na n'ntụzịaka kedu, na puru ihe maka uru otu
n-m-h3-est-01.prereq.0: Otú e si eme ka nkesa nkịtị bụrụ ụkpụrụ ma gụọ tebụl nkịtị ụkpụrụ
n-m-h3-est-01.prereq.1: Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti nkezi na ọdịiche ụkpụrụ nke nkezi nlele na nke ndị ọnụ ọgụgụ zuru ezu
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighi ezi n'azịza Haeun.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.hint.0: Gụọ ahịrị ọ bụla ma kewaa ma ọ gbasara "otu karama" ma ọ bụ "nkezi nke karama 9."
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tụnyere uru abụọ ahụ, nkezi na ọdịiche ụkpụrụ nke nkesa X̄, otu otu na uru maka nkesa otu karama.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.line.0: Ndị ọnụ ọgụgụ zuru ezu bụ nkịtị nwere nkezi 500 na ọdịiche ụkpụrụ 6, ma nkezi nlele nke karama 9 bụ X̄.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.line.1: Nkezi nke X̄ bụ 500, otu ahụ na nkezi ndị ọnụ ọgụgụ zuru ezu.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.line.2: Ọdịiche ụkpụrụ nke X̄ bụ 6, otu ahụ na ọdịiche ụkpụrụ ndị ọnụ ọgụgụ zuru ezu.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 3 na-ezighi ezi. Ọdịiche ụkpụrụ nke nkezi nlele X̄ bụ ọdịiche ụkpụrụ ndị ọnụ ọgụgụ zuru ezu kewaa site na mgbọrọgwụ square nke nha nlele: 6/√9=2. Yabụ X̄ na-eso nkesa nkịtị nwere nkezi 500 na ọdịiche ụkpụrụ 2, ma P(X̄≥503)=P(Z≥1.5)=0.5−0.4332=0.0668. Ahịrị 4 na 5 na-ebu 6 site n'ahịrị 3, yabụ nsonaazụ ha na-ezighi ezi (0.3085 kwekọrọ na puru ihe na otu karama bụ opekata mpe 503).
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.prompt: Jiri azịza e dozichara chọta P(X̄≥503). Mgbe ahụ n'otu ahịrịokwu ma ọ bụ abụọ kọwaa otú puru ihe a si dị iche na puru ihe na olu otu karama bụ opekata mpe 503 mL, na ihe kpatara.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee ọdịiche ụkpụrụ nke X̄, wee chọta uru ụkpụrụ nke 503.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tụnyere ya na uru ụkpụrụ maka otu karama, ma chee otú mgbasa si gbanwee.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.placeholder: dịka ọmụmaatụ, Ọdịiche ụkpụrụ nke X̄ bụ ..., yabụ ... ma e tụnyere otu karama ...
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị jikọtara ọdịiche ụkpụrụ e dozichara ịbụ 2, ọ bụghị 6, na √9?
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị kọwara, na ihe kpatara, ihe mere puru ihe ji ghọọ nke pere mpe karịa maka otu karama (ihe dị ka 0.31)?
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị kwuru n'okwu echiche na mgbe ị na-ewere nkezi karama 9, ndị dị elu na ndị dị ala na-akagbu ibe ha?
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.model.0: Ọdịiche ụkpụrụ nke nkezi nlele bụ 6÷√9=2. P(X̄≥503)=P(Z≥1.5)=0.5−0.4332=0.0668. Mgbe ị na-ewere nkezi karama 9, karama dị elu na karama dị ala na-akagbu ibe ha, yabụ nkezi na-agbasa ntakịrị karịa otu karama, ma puru ihe ịbụ opekata mpe 503 pere mpe nke ukwuu.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.model.1: X̄ na-eso N(500, 2²), yabụ Z=(503−500)/2=1.5 ma puru ihe bụ ihe dị ka 6.68%. Maka otu karama ọdịiche ụkpụrụ bụ 6, ma maka nkezi ọ na-ebelata ruo 2 ma na-agbakọta nso 500, yabụ puru ihe ịbụ opekata mpe 503 dị ntakịrị.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Isi ihe bụ nkwupụta na ọdịiche ụkpụrụ belatara site na 6 ruo 2.

n-m-h3-est-04.topic: Atụmatụ ọnụ ọgụgụ: nkesa nke nkezi nlele
n-m-h3-est-04.title: Oge Ichere nke Gbagọrọ Ọ̀ Pụrụ Iwere Dịka Normal Ozugbo A Weere Nkezi Ya?
n-m-h3-est-04.goal: Kpee ikpe, ka a na-ekpughe ozi otu otu, mgbe enwere ike iji normal distribution maka sample mean ma ọ bụrụ na population abụghị normal, kọwaakwa ihe mere ikpe ahụ na-agbanwe.
n-m-h3-est-04.material: N'ebe a na-ere nri nta, oge ichere (n'nkeji) site n'iwu ịtụ ruo mgbe nri bịaru nwere nkezi nkeji 10 na standard deviation nkeji 10. Ọtụtụ ndị ahịa na-echere obere oge, ma ụfọdụ ole na ole na-echere ogologo oge, ya mere nkesa gbagọrọ nwere ọdụ aka nri dị ogologo ma ọ bụghị normal. Akụkụ nke standard normal table: P(0≤Z≤1)=0.3413, P(0≤Z≤1.2)=0.3849.
n-m-h3-est-04.thinking.0: Gbanwee ikpe mgbe ozi ọhụrụ pụtara
n-m-h3-est-04.thinking.1: Kewaa usoro maka nkezi na standard deviation nke sample mean na udi nkesa ya
n-m-h3-est-04.thinking.2: Kọwaa ọnọdụ e nwere ike inwe normal approximation
n-m-h3-est-04.prereq.0: Nkezi na standard deviation nke sample mean (m, σ/√n)
n-m-h3-est-04.prereq.1: Otu esi agụ standard normal table
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.prompt: A na-ekpughe ozi otu otu. N'nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, họrọ ikpe site n'iji naanị ihe ị maara ruo ugbu a.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.hint.0: N'nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, buru ụzọ lelee ma ihe a na-agbakọ bụ "oge ichere nke otu onye ahịa" ma ọ bụ "nkezi nke ọtụtụ ndị ahịa."
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kewaa ihe usoro nwere ike ịgwa gị (nkezi na standard deviation) na ihe metụtara udi (ma ọ bụ normal).
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Otu onye ọrụ na-ekwu, "Ka anyị were oge ichere dịka N(10, 10²) ma gbakọọ probability na otu onye ahịa na-echere nkeji 20 ma ọ bụ karịa dịka P(Z≥1)=0.5−0.3413=0.1587."
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kedu ikpe kacha kwesị ekwesị banyere mgbakọ a?
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kedu ikpe kacha kwesị ekwesị banyere mgbakọ a?
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Nkesa oge ichere abụghị normal, ya mere 0.1587 site n'normal table bụ naanị atụmatụ, ọ bụghị uru n'ezie, e nwekwa obere ihe kpatara ịtụkwasị ya obi.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 0.1587 bụ nke ziri ezi n'ihi na anyị maara nkezi na standard deviation.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ị chere na ịmara nkezi na standard deviation na-agwa gị udi nkesa kwa. Na udi dị iche, probability nwere ike ịdị iche ọbụlagodi n'otu nkezi na standard deviation.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ọ bụghị normal, ya mere ọ siri ike ịtụkwasị 0.1587 obi dịka ọ dị.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ọ bụghị normal, ya mere enweghị ike ịchọta probability a site n'ụzọ ọ bụla.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na ị maara udi, ị nwere ike ịchọta ya n'ụzọ ọzọ. Isi ihe ugbu a bụ na uru e gbakọrọ site na normal distribution siri ike ịtụkwasị obi dịka ọ dị.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Oge a, ọ bụ banyere X̄, nkezi oge ichere nke ndị ahịa 36 e họrọ n'enweghị usoro. Nkezi nke sample mean bụ 10 ma standard deviation ya bụ 10/√36=5/3. Onye ọrụ ahụ na-ekwu, "Ka anyị gbakọọ probability na X̄ bụ opekata mpe nkeji 12 dịka P(Z≥1.2)=0.5−0.3849=0.1151."
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Ọbụlagodi na population abụghị normal, mgbe nha sample n buru ibu zuru ezu (n'ozuzu 30 ma ọ bụ karịa), nkesa nke sample mean X̄ dị nso na normal distribution nwere nkezi m na standard deviation σ/√n. Ya mere enwere ike iji 0.1151 dịka atụmatụ.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Population abụghị normal, ya mere nkesa X̄ enweghịkwa ike ịbụ normal.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ị lere nkesa nke otu onye ahịa na nkesa nke nkezi nke 36 dịka otu. Iwere nkezi nwere ike ịgbanwe udi nkesa.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ọbụlagodi na 36, udi gbagọrọ nke population na-anọgide dịka ọ dị n'nkesa X̄.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ọbụlagodi mgbe sample na-abawanye, nkesa nke uru n'otu n'otu na-anọgide otu, ma nkesa nke nkezi na-agbanwe udi.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Sample buru ibu zuru ezu ka nkesa X̄ dị nso na normal.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Onye ọrụ ahụ na-atụ aro iji otu ụzọ ahụ maka nkezi nke ndị ahịa 3: "Ka anyị kwuo na X̄ na-eso normal distribution nwere nkezi 10 na standard deviation 10/√3."
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kedu ikpe kacha kwesị ekwesị banyere atụmatụ a?
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Nkezi m na standard deviation σ/√n nke sample mean na-ejide ọbụlagodi mgbe n dị nta. Ma nkwupụta na udi dị nso na normal na-emetụta mgbe n buru ibu zuru ezu, ya mere na population gbagọrọ na n=3, atụmatụ ahụ nwere ike ịdị ike.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Enwere ike iji usoro ndị ahụ, ma iwere ya dịka normal ka siri ike ịtụkwasị obi.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ọ bụrụhaala na n karịrị 1, iwere ya dịka normal ezuola.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ị mere ka "atụmatụ na-adị mma ka sample na-abawanye" dị mkpụmkpụ ka ọ bụrụ "nke ntakịrị buru ibu zuru ezu." Nkesa gbagọrọ chọrọ sample buru ibu karịa.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: n dị nta, ya mere ọbụlagodi usoro nkezi na standard deviation enweghị ike iji.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Usoro nkezi na standard deviation na-ejide ọbụlagodi maka sample dị nta. Ihe na-agbanwe bụ udi nkesa.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.reflect: Na mbụ ị nwere ike ichee na ị nwere ike ịgbakọ site n'nkezi na standard deviation naanị. Lee azụ ma lelee ma ikpe gị gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ nke a: maka otu uru, udi bụ nsogbu; mgbe sample na-abawanye, nkesa nke nkezi na-abịaru normal nso; ma mgbe sample dị nta, ị chọrọ ịkpachapụ anya ọzọ.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s2.prompt: Chịkọta, site na ihe kpatara, mgbe ọ dị mma iji normal distribution gbakọọ probabilities maka sample mean X̄ mgbe population abụghị normal.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tụnyere ihe mere ikpe ji dị iche n'nzọụkwụ gara aga maka ndị ahịa 36 na maka ndị ahịa 3.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s2.hint.1: Dee n'otu ahịrịokwu ihe ga-abụ nnukwu ka udi nkesa nke sample mean gbanwee.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s2.placeholder: dịka, Ọ bụrụ na nha sample bụ ..., nkesa nke ... bụ ...
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ kwuru ọnọdụ banyere nha sample nke ọma?
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru na population enweghị ihe ọ ga-abụ normal?
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ kewara uru otu onye na sample mean?
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s2.model.0: Ọbụlagodi na population abụghị normal, mgbe nha sample buru ibu zuru ezu (n'ozuzu 30 ma ọ bụ karịa), sample mean dị nso na normal distribution nwere nkezi m na standard deviation σ/√n, ya mere ị nwere ike iji normal table chọta uru dị nso.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ị were sample buru ibu, nkesa nke nkezi na-abịaru udi normal nso. Ya mere mgbe n buru ibu enwere ike iji ya n'agbanyeghị udi population, mgbe n dị nta udi gbagọrọ na-anọgide, ya mere ọ siri ike ịtụkwasị obi.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s2.model.2: Ka n buru ibu, ka nkesa sample mean na-abịaru normal nso, ya mere nkezi nke ndị ahịa 36 nwere ike iji normal approximation, ma n'ihi ole na ole dịka 3 ọ siri ike ịtụkwasị obi.

n-m-h3-est-06.topic: Atụmatụ ọnụ ọgụgụ: nkesa nke nkezi nlele
n-m-h3-est-06.title: Ịdọta bọọlụ abụọ: Kedu puru omume nkezi sample bụ opekata mpe 5?
n-m-h3-est-06.goal: Maka sample nha 2 e dọtara na-eweghachi, depụta ụzụzụ nwere usoro niile nke nkezi sample ha na-emezu ọnọdụ na-ahapụghị ihe ọ bụla, ma kọwaa ihe mere ị ga-eji kewapụ usoro iji gbakọọ puru omume n'ụzọ ziri ezi.
n-m-h3-est-06.material: Akpa nwere bọọlụ 4 akara 1, 3, 5, na 7, otu ọnụọgụ n'otu bọọlụ. Ị na-adọta otu bọọlụ, dekọọ ọnụọgụ ya, tinyeghachi ya, wee dọta ọzọ ma dekọọ ya. Ka a bụrụ ọnụọgụ mbụ e dọtara na b nke abụọ, ma kpọọ (a, b) otu sample; nkezi sample bụ X̄=(a+b)/2. N'ịdọta ọ bụla, bọọlụ 4 niile nwere otu puru omume.
n-m-h3-est-06.thinking.1: Kewapụ ọnọdụ nwere otu puru omume
n-m-h3-est-06.thinking.2: Lelee njehie nke ịgụta na-eleghara usoro anya
n-m-h3-est-06.prereq.0: Ịnara sample na-eweghachi na ịgụta nsonaazụ
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.prompt: Mee sample 4 dị iche (a, b) ebe ọnụọgụ mbụ na nke abụọ dị iche ma nkezi sample bụ opekata mpe 5, ma tinye ha. ((a, b) na (b, a) nwere usoro e gbanwere na-agụ dị ka sample dị iche.)
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.hint.0: Were a dị ka 1, 3, 5, 7 otu otu, ma chọta b nke a+b bụ opekata mpe 10.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.hint.1: Lelee ma ụzụzụ nwere a na b e gbanwere na-emezukwa ọnọdụ ahụ.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.ok.c1: a bụ ọnụọgụ dị n'bọọlụ ndị ahụ (1, 3, 5, 7).
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.fail.c1: a abụghị otu n'ime ọnụọgụ dị n'bọọlụ ndị ahụ: 1, 3, 5, 7.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.ok.c2: b bụ ọnụọgụ dị n'bọọlụ ndị ahụ (1, 3, 5, 7).
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.fail.c2: b abụghị otu n'ime ọnụọgụ dị n'bọọlụ ndị ahụ: 1, 3, 5, 7.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.explain: Ụzụzụ nwere usoro nke a≠b na a+b≥10 bụ kpọmkwem 4: (3,7), (7,3), (5,7), (7,5). (3,7) na (7,3) bụ sample dị iche nke mbụ na nke abụọ gbanwere. (3, 5) nwere nkezi 4, ya mere ọ naghị arụ ọrụ, ma (5, 5) fọdụrụ n'èzí ọnọdụ a n'ihi na ọnụọgụ abụọ ya bụ otu.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.prompt: Tinyere ọnọdụ ebe a na b bụ otu, họrọ puru omume na nkezi sample X̄ bụ opekata mpe 5.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ chọta ngụkọta ọnụọgụ sample enwere ike ime mgbe a tinyere a na b n'usoro.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.hint.1: Lelee ma sample ndị ahụ niile nwere otu puru omume, ma gụọ sample ndị na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ, gụnyere ndị sitere na nzọụkwụ gara aga.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.o.a: 1/4: gụọ naanị sample 4 nwere ọnụọgụ dị iche
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.r.a: I hapụrụ sample ndị nwere a na b otu, (5,5) na (7,7), ndị nkezi ha bụkwa opekata mpe 5. Nsogbu ahụ kwuru ka etinye ọnọdụ ndị bụ otu.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.o.b: 2/5: 4 n'ime sample 10 mgbe a na-eleghara usoro anya
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.r.b: Nke a bụ nsonaazụ nke ileghara usoro anya na ịgụta {3,7} dị ka otu ọnọdụ. Ọnọdụ 10 ndị a anaghị apụta na otu puru omume.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.o.c: 3/8: 6 n'ime sample 16 mgbe a na-ekewapụ usoro
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.o.d: 1/2: ọkara nke sample nwere nkezi buru ibu karịa nkezi ndị mmadụ 4
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.r.d: I chere na elu na ala nkezi ndị mmadụ 4 bụ kpọmkwem ọkara na ọkara. E nwekwara sample nwere X̄=4, ma ị ga-ewepụ òkè ha.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.explain: Sample 16 nwere usoro (a, b) niile nwere otu puru omume, nke ọ bụla 1/16. Ndị nwere nkezi opekata mpe 5 bụ 4 dị n'elu gbakwunyere (5,5) na (7,7), 6 n'ozuzu, ya mere 6/16=3/8. Ọ bụrụ na ị leghara usoro anya ma gụọ ọnọdụ 10, {3,7} na-agụ ọnọdụ abụọ (3,7) na (7,3) dị ka otu, puru omume na-apụta n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.prompt: Kọwaa ihe mere puru omume ji agbanwe ma ị leghara usoro anya ma gụọ {3, 7} dị ka otu ọnọdụ, site n'ikwu puru omume nke (3, 7) na (7, 3) nke ọ bụla na-apụta.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.hint.0: Chọta puru omume nke inweta 3 mbụ na 7 nke abụọ dị ka ngwaahịa nke puru omume ịdọta bọọlụ ọ bụla.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.hint.1: Chọtakwa puru omume nke 7 mbụ na 3 nke abụọ, ma tụnyere na puru omume nke inweta {5,5}.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: I dere puru omume nke (3,7) na (7,3) nke ọ bụla?
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: I kwuru puru omume ọnọdụ kedu na-efu mgbe a na-agụ {3,7} dị ka otu ọnọdụ?
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: I kwuru na puru omume nke {3,7} buru ibu karịa nke (5,5)?
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.model.0: (3,7) na (7,3) bụ sample dị iche, ọnụọgụ mbụ na nke abụọ dị iche, nke ọ bụla na-apụta na puru omume 1/16. Ya mere otu ọnọdụ {3,7} nwere puru omume 2/16. Ọ bụrụ na ị leghara usoro anya ma gụọ ya dị ka ọnọdụ 1, ị na-ewere ya otu ihe ahụ dị ka {5,5} na 1/16, puru omume na-apụta n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.model.1: Ọnọdụ 16 nwere usoro niile nwere otu puru omume. Ịdọta 3 mbụ na 7 nke abụọ bụ ọnọdụ dị iche karịa nke megidere, ya mere puru omume nke inweta {3,7} dị ka ọnọdụ abụọ jikọtara bụ 1/8, okpukpu abụọ nke puru omume (5,5).

n-m-h3-est-02.title: Gịnị ka ịchọrọ ịmata iji chọta ogologo oge ntụkwasị obi?
n-m-h3-est-02.topic: Atụmatụ ọnụ ọgụgụ: oge ntụkwasị obi maka nkezi ndị ọnụ ọgụgụ zuru ezu
n-m-h3-est-02.goal: Kewaa ihe na-ekpebi ogologo oge ntụkwasị obi maka nkezi ndị ọnụ ọgụgụ zuru ezu na ihe na-ekpebi ọnọdụ ya, ma wuo atụmatụ nyocha nke gị nke na-emezu ọnọdụ ogologo.
n-m-h3-est-02.material: Ị chọrọ ịtụ atụmatụ population mean m nke oge nkezi kwa ụbọchị ụmụ nwata na-agụ akwụkwọ (n'awa). Population na-eso normal distribution ma a maara population standard deviation σ. Ọ bụrụ na nha sample bụ n na sample mean bụ x̄, 95% confidence interval bụ x̄−1.96×σ/√n ≤ m ≤ x̄+1.96×σ/√n. Otu nyocha ahụ amalitebeghị nyocha ahụ, ma buru ụzọ chọọ ịgbakọ naanị "ogologo nke confidence interval."
n-m-h3-est-02.thinking.0: Kewaa ozi dị mkpa na nke na-adịghị mkpa
n-m-h3-est-02.thinking.1: Kewaa ihe na-emetụta ogologo na ndị na-emetụta ọnọdụ
n-m-h3-est-02.thinking.2: Wuo ọtụtụ atụmatụ na-emezu ọnọdụ ma lelee ha
n-m-h3-est-02.prereq.0: Usoro confidence interval maka population mean site na normal distribution nwere population standard deviation a maara
n-m-h3-est-02.prereq.1: Uru z maka ọkwa nkwenye e nyere n'standard normal distribution (ihe dị ka 1.96 maka 95%)
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.prompt: Tupu e malite nyocha, họrọ ozi niile ị ga-amata iji gbakọọ ogologo nke 95% confidence interval. (Ọ bụghị họrọ ihe na-adịghị mkpa.)
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.hint.0: Wepụ njedebe dị ala site na njedebe dị elu ozugbo ma buru ụzọ dee nkwupụta maka ogologo.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kewaa mkpụrụedemede ndị fọdụrụ n'nkwupụta ahụ na ndị na-apụ.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.r.a: x̄ na-ekpebi etiti nke interval. Ị nwere ike ilele ma x̄ fọdụrụ n'ebe dị n'etiti njedebe abụọ site n'iwepụ njedebe dị ala site na nke dị elu n'nkwupụta ahụ.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.r.b: n pụtara n'σ/√n ma na-agbanwe ogologo nke interval. Chee otu interval si agbanwe mgbe sample buru ibu.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.o.c: Standard deviation s e gbakọrọ site na sample
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.r.c: A maralarị population standard deviation σ, ya mere s anaghị apụta n'nkwupụta maka ogologo. Lelee mkpụrụedemede ndị pụtara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.r.d: σ na-apụta n'nkwupụta ogologo σ/√n. Ọ bụrụ na ị maghị mgbasa, ị pụghị ikwu otú interval buru ibu.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.r.e: Population mean bụ uru n'onwe ya anyị na-anwa itụ atụmatụ, ya mere amabeghị ya, ọ naghịkwa apụta n'nkwupụta maka ogologo nke interval.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.explain: Iwepụ njedebe dị ala site na njedebe dị elu na-eme ka x̄ pụọ ma hapụ naanị 2×1.96×σ/√n. Ọkwa nkwenye 95% edoziela, ya mere σ na n na-ekpebi ogologo, sample mean na-ekpebikwa naanị ọnọdụ nke interval. Population mean m bụ uru a na-atụ atụmatụ, sample standard deviation s anaghị eji n'nkwupụta ogologo n'ihi na a maara σ.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s2.prompt: Were na σ bụ opekata mpe 4, ma mee atụmatụ nyocha ka ogologo nke 95% confidence interval bụrụ awa 2 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị. Tinye σ na nha sample n maka nke ọ bụla. Atụmatụ abụọ ahụ ga-enwe uru σ dị iche; mee atụmatụ 2. (n bụ ọnụọgụ okike 400 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị.)
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s2.hint.0: Gbanwee ọnọdụ na ogologo 2×1.96×σ/√n bụ 2 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị ka ọ bụrụ enweghị nha n'√n.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s2.hint.1: Buru ụzọ họrọ σ, mgbe ahụ họrọ n na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ. Mee ya ọzọ otu ugboro ya na σ dị iche.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s2.ok.c2: n bụ ọnụọgụ okike 400 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s2.fail.c2: n abụghị ọnụọgụ okike 400 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Ogologo nke interval bụ 2 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s2.explain: Ka ogologo 2×1.96×σ/√n bụrụ 2 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị, √n ga-abụ opekata mpe 1.96σ. Na σ=5, n=100 ogologo bụ 1.96, na σ=10, n=400 ogologo bụ 1.96. Mgbe σ buru ibu, n ga-adị nnukwu karịa. σ=5, n=25 na-enye ogologo 3.92, nke anaghị arụ ọrụ.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.prompt: Na otu atụmatụ ahụ (σ=2, n=64, nkwenye 95%), e mere nyocha ugboro abụọ ma sample means bụ 2.7 na 3.2. Chọta confidence intervals abụọ ahụ, ma tụnyere ogologo na ọnọdụ ha.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.hint.0: Maka sample mean ọ bụla, gbakwunye ma wepụ uru 1.96×2/√64 ka ị dee interval ahụ.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.hint.1: Chọta ọdịiche dị n'etiti njedebe dị elu na dị ala maka interval ọ bụla, mgbe ahụ tụnyere etiti ha kwa.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.placeholder: dịka, Maka 2.7 ọ bụ ... ruo ..., maka 3.2 ọ bụ ... ruo ..., ogologo bụkwa ...
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ gbakọrọ interval 2.21 ruo 3.19 n'onwe gị maka sample mean 2.7?
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ tụnyere ogologo intervals abụọ ahụ site n'ọnụọgụ?
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ jikọtara eziokwu na σ, n, na ọkwa nkwenye na-ekpebi ogologo, ebe x̄ na-ekpebi naanị ọnọdụ?
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.model.0: Maka sample mean 2.7, 2.7±1.96×2/8=2.7±0.49, ya bụ, 2.21 ruo 3.19, maka 3.2 ọ bụkwa 2.71 ruo 3.69. Intervals abụọ ahụ nwere otu ogologo, 0.98, dabere n'sample mean naanị ọnọdụ na-agbanwe, site na 0.5.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.model.1: Ogologo bụ otu, ihe dị ka 0.98, naanị etiti (sample mean) dị iche, ya mere interval na-akwaga 0.5 n'aka nri. Ogologo na-ekpebi naanị site na σ, n, na ọkwa nkwenye, sample mean na-ekpebikwa naanị ọnọdụ interval ahụ.

n-m-h3-est-08.topic: Atụmatụ ọnụ ọgụgụ: oge ntụkwasị obi maka nkezi ndị ọnụ ọgụgụ zuru ezu
n-m-h3-est-08.prereq.0: Otu esi agụ standard normal table
n-m-h3-est-08.title: Ilele uru z n'ngwọta maka ọkara obi ntụkwasị 90%
n-m-h3-est-08.goal: Lelee mmekọrịta n'etiti ọkwa obi ntụkwasị na puru omume n'tebụl nkịtị ọkọlọtọ, chọta ma mezie ahịrị na-ezighi ezi n'ngwọta, ma gosi njehie site n'ịgbakọ ọkwa obi ntụkwasị uru z na-ezighi ezi kwekọrọ n'ezie.
n-m-h3-est-08.material: Site na ndị mmadụ nwere nkesa nkịtị nwere mgbasa ọkọlọtọ ndị mmadụ σ=8, sample na-enweghị usoro nke 64 nwere nkezi sample x̄=50. Jiho chọtara ọkara obi ntụkwasị 90% maka nkezi ndị mmadụ m. Akụkụ nke tebụl nkịtị ọkọlọtọ: P(0≤Z≤1.28)=0.3997, P(0≤Z≤1.645)=0.4500, P(0≤Z≤1.96)=0.4750, P(0≤Z≤2.58)=0.4950. (Z bụ mgbanwe amaghị ama nke na-eso nkesa nkịtị nwere nkezi 0 na mgbasa ọkọlọtọ 1.)
n-m-h3-est-08.thinking.1: Tụgharịa ọkwa obi ntụkwasị ka ọ bụrụ puru omume etiti iji nweta uru z
n-m-h3-est-08.thinking.2: Soro uru na-ezighi ezi azụ ma lelee ya
n-m-h3-est-08.prereq.1: Usoro ọkara obi ntụkwasị maka nkezi ndị mmadụ
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighi ezi n'ngwọta Jiho.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ sere foto nke akụkụ nkesa nkịtị ọkọlọtọ ọkwa obi ntụkwasị 90% na-ezo aka na ya.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.hint.1: Kewaa akụkụ ahụ n'ọkara na 0 ma tụnyere ya na ụdị tebụl P(0≤Z≤z).
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.line.0: Mgbasa ọkọlọtọ nke nkezi sample bụ σ/√n=8/√64=1.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.line.1: Ọkwa obi ntụkwasị bụ 90%, ya mere jiri z nke P(Z≤z)=0.90.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.line.2: P(0≤Z≤z)=0.90−0.50=0.40, ya mere site na tebụl z=1.28.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 2 adịghị mma. Ọkwa obi ntụkwasị 90% pụtara puru omume n'agbata −z na z: P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90. Site na nhata aka ekpe na aka nri, P(0≤Z≤z)=0.45, ma site na tebụl z=1.645. Ahịrị 3, 4, na 5 na-esote ahịrị 2, ya mere nsonaazụ ha na-ezighi ezi. Ọkara ziri ezi bụ 50±1.645×1, ya bụ, 48.355 ≤ m ≤ 51.645.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.prompt: Chọta ọkara obi ntụkwasị 90% site n'ngwọta e mezuru. Mgbe ahụ, site n'iji tebụl, gbakọọ P(−1.28≤Z≤1.28) maka z=1.28 nke Jiho, dee ọkwa obi ntụkwasị uru a kwekọrọ na ya, ma gosi ihe mere ọkara Jiho abụghị ọkara 90%.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee uru P(0≤Z≤z) ka P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90, mgbe ahụ chọta z n'tebụl.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.hint.1: Maka 1.28, gbakwunye P(0≤Z≤1.28) ugboro abụọ (otu maka akụkụ ọ bụla).
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.placeholder: dịka. P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90, ya mere z=..., ọkara ahụ bụ ... Site na z=1.28 nke Jiho, ...
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: I nwetara ọkara nke puru omume etiti 0.90, nke bụ 0.45, ma chọta z=1.645?
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: I gbakọrọ ngwụcha ndị ahụ n'ụzọ ziri ezi dị ka 50±1.645×1?
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: I gbakọrọ akụkụ abụọ maka 1.28 (2×0.3997) ma kwenye na ọ bụ ihe dị ka 80%?
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90, mgbe ahụ P(0≤Z≤z)=0.45, ya mere z=1.645. Ọkara bụ 50±1.645×1, ya mere 48.355 ruo 51.645. Maka z=1.28 nke Jiho, P(−1.28≤Z≤1.28)=2×0.3997=0.7994, ihe dị ka 80%, ya mere ọ bụghị ọkara obi ntụkwasị 90%.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.model.1: z bụ 1.645 ma ọkara obi ntụkwasị bụ [48.355, 51.645]. Ọ bụrụ na ị jiri 1.28, puru omume jikọtara maka akụkụ abụọ bụ 0.7994, naanị ihe dị ka 80%, ya mere ọkara ahụ dị warara nke ukwuu ma ọkwa obi ntụkwasị ya adịghị eru 90%.

n-m-h3-est-07.topic: Statistical estimation: ịkpa oke n'nyocha sample
n-m-h3-est-07.title: Nyocha na-ahọrọ klas dum: Ị nwere ike ịtụkwasị nkezi sample obi?
n-m-h3-est-07.goal: Ghọta na ọ bụ nwa akwụkwọ ọ bụla inwe otu ohere ka a họrọ ya dị iche na sample na-anọchite anya ndị mmadụ nke ọma, ma wuo ma kọwaa ọnọdụ echiche nke na-ekpughe adịghị ike.
n-m-h3-est-07.material: Otu ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị nwere klas 20 nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 30 nke ọ bụla, ụmụ akwụkwọ 600 n'ozuzu. Ị na-eme atụmatụ otú ị ga-esi họrọ ụmụ akwụkwọ 30 ka a nyochaa nkezi oge ụra kwa ụbọchị.
n-m-h3-est-07.thinking.1: Wuo ọnọdụ ihe atụ na-emegide nke na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ
n-m-h3-est-07.thinking.2: Kọwaa adịghị ike nke usoro nlele na otú e si emezi ya
n-m-h3-est-07.prereq.0: Ihe nlele na-enweghị usoro na ndị mmadụ pụtara
n-m-h3-est-07.prereq.1: Na nkezi sample bụ uru e ji atụ nkezi ndị mmadụ
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ usoro niile ebe ụmụ akwụkwọ 600 niile nwere otu puru omume ka a họrọ ha maka sample.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.hint.0: Họrọ otu nwa akwụkwọ ma dee, dị ka okwu, puru omume na nwa akwụkwọ ahụ na-abanye n'sample n'okpuru usoro ọ bụla.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.hint.1: Were nwa akwụkwọ afọ mbụ, afọ nke abụọ, na afọ nke atọ n'usoro ma lelee na puru omume bụ otu.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.a: Tinye nọmba n'ndepụta zuru ezu nke ụmụ akwụkwọ ma họrọ 30 site n'iji ọnụọgụ na-enweghị usoro.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.a: A na-ahọrọ nwa akwụkwọ ọ bụla na puru omume 30/600, niile otu. Lelee ma i hapụrụ usoro a.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.b: Dọta otu klas n'enweghị usoro site na klas 20 ma họrọ ụmụ akwụkwọ 30 niile dị na ya.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.b: A na-ahọrọ nwa akwụkwọ ọ bụla na puru omume 1/20, ohere ka a họrọ klas ya, niile otu. Lelee ma i hapụrụ usoro a.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.c: Dọta 30 n'enweghị usoro site na ụmụ akwụkwọ afọ nke atọ 200.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.c: Ụmụ akwụkwọ afọ mbụ na nke abụọ enweghị ohere ọ bụla ka a họrọ ha. Ọ ziri ezi naanị n'ime afọ nke atọ, ọ bụghị maka ụmụ akwụkwọ niile.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.d: Họrọ ụmụ akwụkwọ 30 mbụ ị zutere n'ụzọ ụlọ n'oge nri ehihie.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.d: Ụmụ akwụkwọ ndị na-anọkarị n'ụzọ ụlọ nwere ike ka ọ zute ha karịa, ya mere puru omume ịhọrọ dị iche site na nwa akwụkwọ gaa nwa akwụkwọ.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.explain: N'A, a na-ahọrọ 30 n'ime 600, ya mere nwa akwụkwọ ọ bụla nwere puru omume 30/600, ma n'B, a na-ahọrọ otu klas n'ime 20, ya mere a na-ahọrọ nwa akwụkwọ ọ bụla na puru omume 1/20=30/600. N'C puru omume maka ụmụ akwụkwọ afọ mbụ na nke abụọ bụ 0, ma n'D puru omume nke izute dị iche site na nwa akwụkwọ. Ma, B na-enye ohere hà ma ụmụ akwụkwọ e họrọ ọnụ nwere ike ịdị ka ibe ha, ya mere enweghị ike iwere ya dị ka otu usoro dị ka A.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.prompt: Were ya na ụlọ akwụkwọ ahụ nwere naanị klas abụọ nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 30 nke ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ị dọta otu klas n'enweghị usoro ma jiri ụmụ akwụkwọ 30 ya dị ka sample, ma klas ọ bụla ka e họrọ, sample ga-agafe nkezi oge ụra ụlọ akwụkwọ dum site na opekata mpe elekere 1. Mee ụzụzụ 2 dị iche nke nkezi oge ụra nke klas abụọ ahụ a na b (n'elekere, site na 4 ruo 10 gụnyere) ma tinye ha.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.hint.0: Mgbe klas abụọ ahụ nwere otu ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ, buru ụzọ dee nkezi ụlọ akwụkwọ dum n'ihe gbasara a na b.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.hint.1: Chọta ọdịiche n'etiti nkezi klas e họrọ na nkezi ụlọ akwụkwọ dum, ma họrọ ọdịiche n'etiti a na b ka ọ bụrụ opekata mpe 1.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.ok.c1: a na b dị n'agbata 4 na 10 gụnyere.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.fail.c1: a ma ọ bụ b adịghị n'agbata 4 na 10 gụnyere.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Ma klas ọ bụla ka e họrọ, ọ na-agafe nkezi ụlọ akwụkwọ dum site na opekata mpe elekere 1.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Dabere n'klas e họrọ, e nwere ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-agafe nkezi ụlọ akwụkwọ dum site na erughị elekere 1.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.explain: Ebe klas abụọ ahụ nwere otu ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ, nkezi ụlọ akwụkwọ dum bụ (a+b)/2, ma klas ọ bụla ka e họrọ, ọnụọgụ ọ na-agafe bụ otu, |a−b|/2. Ka nke a bụrụ opekata mpe 1, |a−b|≥2. Dịka ihe atụ, ọ bụrụ na klas ndị ahụ nwere nkezi elekere 6 na elekere 8, nkezi ụlọ akwụkwọ dum bụ elekere 7, ịhọrọ otu klas na-enye elekere 6 ma ọ bụ 8, nke ọ bụla na-agafe 7 site na elekere 1.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.prompt: Tụnyere usoro klas dum na usoro ịhọrọ 30 n'ime ụmụ akwụkwọ 600 site n'iji ọnụọgụ na-enweghị usoro. Jiri ihe atụ ị mere n'elu, kọwaa adịghị ike nke ịhọrọ klas dum, ma dee otu ụzọ isi belata adịghị ike a.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.hint.0: N'ihe atụ ị mere, dee site n'iji ọnụọgụ ka nkezi sample si agbanwe dabere n'klas e họrọ.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.hint.1: Chee klas ole ụmụ akwụkwọ na-abanye n'otu sample mgbe a na-ahọrọ 30 site n'iji ọnụọgụ na-enweghị usoro.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.placeholder: dịka. Ụmụ akwụkwọ n'otu klas ... ya mere ... Iji belata nke a ...
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: I kọwara adịghị ike site n'iji nkezi klas abụọ i mere n'elu?
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: I kwuru na ọbụna ma ohere ịhọrọ hà, nkezi sample nwere ike ịdị anya?
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Imeziwanye gị ọ na-aga n'ntụzi nke ịgwakọta ụmụ akwụkwọ sitere n'ọtụtụ klas?
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.model.0: Ụmụ akwụkwọ n'otu klas nwere omume yiri ibe ha, ya mere ọ bụrụ na ị họrọ klas dum, nkezi sample nwere ike ịdị anya site na nkezi ụlọ akwụkwọ dum dabere n'klas e họrọ. Dịka ihe atụ, ya na klas elekere 6 na klas elekere 8, ma nke e họrọ na-agafe site na elekere 1. Ị nwere ike ibelata nke a site n'ịhọrọ site n'iji ọnụọgụ na-enweghị usoro site n'ndepụta zuru ezu, ma ọ bụ site n'ịhọrọ ụmụ akwụkwọ ole na ole site na klas ọ bụla.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.model.1: Ụmụ akwụkwọ n'ime otu klas na-adị ka ibe ha, ya mere ọbụna ma ị họrọ 30, ozi ahụ abụghị uru ụmụ akwụkwọ 30. Ọ bụrụ na klas ndị ahụ nwere nkezi dị iche, nsonaazụ na-agbanwe nke ukwuu dabere n'klas e họrọ (njehie na-abawanye), ọ na-emekwa nke ọma ma ị họrọ n'enweghị usoro na n'otu n'otu site n'ọtụtụ klas.

n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.prompt: A na-ekpughe ozi otu otu. N'nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, họrọ ikpe site n'iji naanị ihe ị maara ruo ugbu a.
n-m-h3-integc-04.title: Integral Kpọmkwem N'enweghị Antiderivative
n-m-h3-integc-04.topic: Ijikọta: integral kpọmkwem site n'iji nnọchi na symmetry nke etiti (ịchọta uru n'enweghị antiderivative)
n-m-h3-integc-04.goal: Ka ozi na-abawanye, gbanwee ikpe gị, ma kwado na mmekọrịta symmetry enwetara site n'nnọchi na-ekpebi uru nke integral kpọmkwem n'enweghị ịchọta antiderivative.
n-m-h3-integc-04.material: Soro, nzọụkwụ site n'nzọụkwụ, usoro ịchọta uru nke integral kpọmkwem I=∫_0^{π/2} sin x/(sin x+cos x) dx. (∫_0^{π/2} bụ integral kpọmkwem site na 0 ruo π/2.)
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.0: Tụọ nha nke nsonaazụ n'ụzọ dị mkpụmkpụ
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.1: Gụọ ọnụọgụ akụkụ ọtụtụ na ọnụọgụ ndị amaghị
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.2: Lee nduzi nke etiti mgbe nnọchi gasịrị
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.3: Kpee ikpe ọnọdụ ebe otu usoro na-arụ ọrụ
n-m-h3-integc-04.prereq.0: Ijikọta site n'nnọchi (ịgbanwe oke n'integral kpọmkwem)
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.hint.0: Oge ọ bụla ozi ọhụrụ pụtara, gụọ "ndị amaghị ole na akụkụ ọtụtụ ole dị."
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tụnyere ma ntụ ọnụọgụ mbụ gị na uru chọtara mgbe e mesịrị adịghị anya.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Ị chọrọ ịchọta I=∫_0^{π/2} sin x/(sin x+cos x) dx. Ọ siri ike ichọta antiderivative nke okwu ọtụtụ a ozugbo. Uru nke integrand h(x)=sin x/(sin x+cos x) bụ h(0)=0, h(π/4)=1/2, h(π/2)=1, ma ogologo etiti bụ π/2 (ihe dị ka 1.57).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kedu ntụ ọnụọgụ nke nha I kacha dabara?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Elu na-arị site na 0 ruo 1 nwere uru etiti 1/2, ya mere mpaghara dị ihe dị ka (1/2)×1.57≈0.8. Enwere ike iji ntụ ọnụọgụ a mgbe e mesịrị lelee ma uru ị chọtara ziri ezi.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: I dị ihe dị ka 1.57: n'ihi na ị na-eweta elu dị ka 1 ma mụbaa ya site n'ogologo 1.57
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Elu bụ 1 naanị na njedebe nke etiti. Ntụ ọnụọgụ a na-ewere elu dị ka 1 n'etiti dum.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: I dị ihe dị ka 0.8: n'ihi na elu na-agbanwe site na 0 ruo 1, nkezi dị ihe dị ka 1/2
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: I tụrụ mgbanwe nke elu site na nkezi. Ọ bụghị uru kpọmkwem, mana enwere ike iji ya tụọ nha.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: I bụ 0: n'ihi na h(0)=0 n'isi ebe mmalite
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uru ịbụ 0 n'otu isi ebe anaghị eme ka integral kpọmkwem bụrụ 0. Lee uru n'etiti dum.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Lelekwa J=∫_0^{π/2} cos x/(sin x+cos x) dx. Ịgbakwunye ụmụ ọnụọgụ abụọ ahụ na-eme ka onye na-agụ hà nhata onye na-ekewa, ya mere I+J=∫_0^{π/2} 1 dx=π/2.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: A pụrụ ikpebi I site n'ozi a naanị?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.after: E nwere naanị otu akụkụ ọtụtụ, I+J=π/2, ya mere I na J enweghị ike ikpebi iche. Ị chọrọ ichọta otu mmekọrịta ọzọ n'etiti I na J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: A pụrụ ikpebi ya: I+J=π/2, ya mere I=π/4.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: I kewara ya n'ọkara n'enweghị ilele ma I=J. I+J=π/2 bụ naanị otu mmekọrịta n'etiti I na J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Enweghị ike ikpebi ya: I+J=π/2 anaghị enyere aka ma ọlị n'ịchọta I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uru nke I+J bụ ozi bara uru. O nyere otu mmekọrịta n'etiti I na J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ọ ka zughị ezu: ị chọrọ ịmara otu mmekọrịta ọzọ n'etiti I na J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: I chọpụtara na e nwere ndị amaghị abụọ, I na J, mana naanị otu akụkụ ọtụtụ.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.info: N'J, ka x=π/2−t. Mgbe ahụ dx=−dt, ma ka x na-aga site na 0 ruo π/2, t na-aga site na π/2 ruo 0. Ebe ọ bụ sin(π/2−t)=cos t na cos(π/2−t)=sin t, J=∫_{π/2}^{0} sin t/(sin t+cos t)·(−dt)=∫_0^{π/2} sin t/(sin t+cos t) dt, nke hà nhata I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ugbu a, gịnị bụ uru I?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.after: I=J na I+J=π/2, yabụ I=π/4 (ihe dị ka 0.785). Nke a kwekọrọ nke ọma na atụmatụ mbụ nke 0.8.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: I=π/4: n'ihi na J=I na I+J=π/2
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: I jiri nha abụọ I=J na I+J=π/2 ọnụ. Ọ kwekọkwara na atụmatụ mbụ nke 0.8.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: I weere uru I+J ka ọ bụrụ uru I. J nwekwara otu ọnụọgụ ahụ.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: I weere ịdị elu n'otu ebe etiti ka ọ bụrụ uru integral kpọmkwem. Ị ga-amụba ịdị elu site n'ogologo oge ahụ.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.reflect: Na mbụ naanị atụmatụ ga-ekwe omume, ọbụlagodi mgbe e nwetara nha maka I+J, ọ dị mkpa na "ịkewa n'ọkara" ka dị ntakịrị oge. Naanị mgbe nnochi nyere mmekọrịta J=I ka e kpebiri I. Site n'iji symmetry nke oge n'integral kpọmkwem, ị nwere ike ịchọta uru n'ejighị ichọta antiderivative.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.prompt: Mgbe ị dochie x=π/2−t n'J, dx=−dt, ma J na-aghọ +I kama −I. Kọwaa ihe mere, na-elekwasị anya n'oke ijikọta (elu na ala).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.hint.0: Chọta uru t kwekọrọ na x=0 na x=π/2, ma dee oke elu na ala nke integral ọhụrụ.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.hint.1: Dee ihe na-eme akara mgbe ị na-ebugharị integral kpọmkwem nke oke elu ya pere mpe karịa oke ala ya na ntụzịaka nkịtị.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.placeholder: dịka ọmụmaatụ, Akara minus sitere n'dx=−dt ...
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị dere n'onwe gị na mgbe nnochi, oke ala bụ π/2 ma oke elu bụ 0?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị dere nzọụkwụ nke ịgbanwe ∫_{π/2}^{0} ka ọ bụrụ −∫_0^{π/2}?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.model.0: Ka x na-esi na 0 gaa π/2, t na-esi na π/2 gaa 0, yabụ oke elu na ala nke integral gbanwere ebe. Ịtụgharị oge na-agbanwe akara, ma tinyere minus sitere n'dx=−dt akara ndị ahụ na-akagbu ibe ha, yabụ J=+I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe nnochi, oge ahụ tụgharịrị, site na π/2 ruo 0. Idozi oge e tụgharịrị ọzọ na-emepụta otu akara minus, ma nke ahụ na akara minus sitere n'dx=−dt na-ewepụ ibe ha, yabụ akara ahụ na-abụ nke dị mma.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.prompt: Họrọ integral kpọmkwem nke enwere ike ịchọta uru ya site n'otu usoro e ji chọta I (dochie x site n'π/2−x ma gbakwunye okwu a na-ejikọta ya).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.hint.0: Maka nhọrọ ọ bụla, dee ihe na-eme oge ahụ na denominator mgbe e dochiri x site n'π/2−x.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.hint.1: Lelee ma numerator na denominator na-aghọ hà nhata mgbe ị gbakwunye okwu mbụ na okwu e dochiri.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na oge bụ [0,π/3], mgbe ahụ x na π/2−x anaghị ejikọta n'otu oge, yabụ usoro dị n'elu anaghị arụ ọrụ dị ka ọ dị.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.b: Denominator anaghị agbadata, yabụ ọbụlagodi na ị gbakwunye okwu a na-ejikọta, akụkụ nkeji anaghị aghọ otu ọnụọgụ.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.c: I hụrụ na ịdochi x site n'π/2−x na-agbanwe sin³ na cos³, na ngụkọta okwu abụọ ahụ bụ 1.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.d: Denominator na-aghọ 0 n'ime oge ahụ (na x=3π/4), yabụ integral kpọmkwem enweghị ọbụna nkọwa.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.explain: Na c, oge [0,π/2] na-ese onwe ya n'okpuru x→π/2−x, ma denominator sin³x+cos³x na-agbadata, yabụ ịgbakwunye okwu a na-ejikọta na-enye 1. Yabụ uru bụ π/4. Nsogbu dị na a bụ oge ahụ, na b bụ symmetry nke denominator, na d bụ ebe denominator bụ 0 (3π/4).

n-m-h3-est-05.title: Ịkọwa Ọdịiche Dị n'etiti Sample Means nke Obodo Abụọ n'Ụzọ Ziri Ezi nye Enyi
n-m-h3-est-05.goal: Mgbe sample means abụọ dị iche ntakịrị naanị, gbakọọ confidence intervals iji lelee ma ha na-agbakọta, mgbe ahụ degharịa nkwupụta n'okwu na-ekwughị onye mmeri ma kọwaara enyi.
n-m-h3-est-05.material: Akụkọ akwụkwọ akụkọ mpaghara: "Ụmụ akwụkwọ elu n'Obodo A na-eji smartphone ha nkezi awa 3.4 kwa ụbọchị, ogologo karịa Obodo B (awa 3.1). Ụmụ akwụkwọ Obodo A na-eji nke ha ogologo oge." N'obodo abụọ ahụ, e họrọ ụmụ akwụkwọ 100 n'enweghị usoro, oge ojiji na-eso normal distribution, a makwara population standard deviation dịka awa 1.5 n'obodo abụọ ahụ.
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.0: Gbakọọ confidence intervals n'onwe gị ma tụnyere ha
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.1: Kewaa ọdịiche nke point estimates na ịgbakọta nke intervals
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.2: Degharịa mkpa nhazi ka ọ kwekọọ onye na-anata ya
n-m-h3-est-05.prereq.0: Confidence interval maka population mean site na normal distribution nwere population standard deviation a maara
n-m-h3-est-05.prereq.1: Uru z maka nkwenye 95%, ihe dị ka 1.96
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.prompt: Chọta 95% confidence interval maka population mean nke obodo ọ bụla ma tinye uru ndị e gbagharịrị n'ebe decimal nke atọ (ya mere, ruo decimal abụọ). (Obodo A: oke dị ala na dị elu; Obodo B: oke dị ala na dị elu)
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ chọta standard deviation nke sample mean maka otu obodo, 1.5/√100.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.hint.1: Mụbaa uru ahụ site na 1.96 iji nweta njehie oke, mgbe ahụ gbakwunye ma wepụ ya site na sample mean maka obodo ọ bụla.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.var.aL: Oke dị ala nke Obodo A
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.var.aU: Oke dị elu nke Obodo A
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.var.bL: Oke dị ala nke Obodo B
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.var.bU: Oke dị elu nke Obodo B
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.fail.c1: Interval Obodo A ezighị ezi. Lelee 3.4 ± 1.96×1.5/√100.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.fail.c2: Interval Obodo B ezighị ezi. Lelee 3.1 ± 1.96×1.5/√100.
